༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi sgrub thabs phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa dgyes rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI182_kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi sgrub thabs phyi nang bskyed rim rnam bshad/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi sgrub thabs phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa dgyes rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya mahā tsakra nā tha he badz+ra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'khor lo'i mgon po kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam thar zhal ldan stong nyid phyag gi yal gas mdzes/ /bsdu dngos zhabs kyis bdud bzhi'i steng na gar mdzad pa'i/ /bde stong rang bzhin rang sems rgyu yi kye rdo rje/ /lam dang 'bras bu ro gcig gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi lha lam yangs pa la/ /paṇa grub rgyu skar dbang po bgrang yas kyang / /ri bong 'dzin ltar kun gyis 'gran bral ba'i/ /stobs bcu'i dbang phyug bir+wa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i zhal dkyil zla ltar rgyas/ /dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin thugs rgyud bde stong ngang / /snying po'i lam gyis 'gro kun grol mdzad pa'i/ /sa skya'i bla chen yon tan bsam bzhin dad/ /de sras bsod nams ye shes rtser son dang / /grags pa mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad zhabs/ /sa skya paṇa chen dpal ldan 'phags pa yi/ /rnam thar bka' drin dran pas phyag bgyi 'o/ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag de rnams kyi/ /bzhed gzhung dri med phyogs kun rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu'i mchog /rim par byon pa kun kyang phyag gi gnas/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i khang bzang che/ /rmang nas bslangs je mthor brtsigs pa'i tshul gyis te phyogs kun gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen de/ /sprul pa'i skyes bur yid ches dang bas 'dud/ /gang de'i rigs sras bsod nams bye ba'i gter/ /grub pa'i sar bzhugs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / /snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling kun gsal ba'i/

/blo gros mtshungs med sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal/ /'das dang ma 'das da ltar dus nyid kyi/ /rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas pa rnams/ /lus pa med pa kun gyi spro ba'i gzhi/ /rje btsun mus pa'i zhabs zung spyi bos mchod/ /dpal ldan mthu stobs mgon po las 'ong ba'i/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun yab chos mchog /dpal ldan dgyes rdor sgrub thabs rnam bshad 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'chad la spro/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i man ngag lugs kyi dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi sgrub pa'i thabs phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa gong ma'i gsung rab dgyes rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i bsgom don bshad pa/ nang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sgom don bshad pa/ lam de dag nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu sa lam bgrod tshul gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rje btsun yab kyi bskyed rim bshad pa dang / de dang thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dres pa'i tshul gyis yum gyi bskyed rim bshad pa gnyis/ de'i dang po la gnyis te bshad bya'i chos ngos bzung ba/ ngos zin pa de ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gang la brten pa'i rgyud ngos bzung ba/ gang nas brgyud pa'i brgyud pa ngos bzung ba/ de las byung ba'i sgrub thabs dngos ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul/ byon nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsungs tshul/ de'i nang nas gang la brten nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dus nam gyi tshe byon pa dang / byon pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub kha cig sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu byon par bzhed/ kha cig gnyis ldan gyi dus byon par bzhed kyang / 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed pa rtsod dus de'i tshe rtsod pa byas pas shi ba'i ro rnams phyogs mtshams su bskyal bas dur khrod brgyad chags/

de la brten nas gdul bya 'khor bcas byung ba'i phyir/ mgo zug pa'i dus su sprul sku 'bras bu'i he ru ka byon par bzhed do/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi nang nyid du/ /bcom ldan mtha' yas pas 'di gsungs/ /shākya seng ges gsungs pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor phal cher gson pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la gdul bya drag po dbang phyug chen po'i byon tshul/ 'dul byed he ru ka'i byon tshul/ des ji ltar btul ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni khams gsum las gzugs med khams la ni bdag po med la/ gzugs khams kyi bdag po lha tshangs pa/ 'dod khams rgya che ba'i bdag po dbang phyug chen po/ rgya chung ba'i bdag po gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdud sdig to can/ bye brag tu ri rab kyi rtse mo man chad gling bzhi'i bdag po dbang ldan na gnas pa'i drag po dbang phyug chen po ste dregs pa'i gtso bo bzhi/ gau rī la sogs pa de dag gi chung ma brgyad/ 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa la sogs pa 'khor dregs pa can brgyad/ de dag las gzhan pa'i 'khor sprul pa dang yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa/ de dag kyang 'dod chags shas che bas dus bzhir chung ma dang snyom par 'jug zhe sdang shas che bas mi rnams kyi sha khrag la longs spyod/ gti mug shas che bas las 'bras dang de kho na nyid kyi don la rmongs pas nyon rmongs pa dug lnga la rang dgar longs spyod cing rang nyid kyang lam log pa la zhugs/ gzhan rnams kyang log pa'i lam la sbyor/ dregs pa'i rlom tshig kyang smra bar byed do/ gnyis pa ni de'i tshe drag po dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa 'dul ba'i ched du longs sku rgyu'i he ru ka dgongs pa sna tshogs pa dam tshig chen po'i rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyom par bzhugs nas sku'i ba spu'i bu ga nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar spros/

khyad par 'dzam bu gling du sprul sku 'bras bu'i he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa sprul lo/ /gsum pa ni drag po dbang phyug rang dang / de bas che ba'i lha gsum ste dregs pa'i gtso bo bzhi ni/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi gdan du mdzad/ 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa lha chen thig le mchog ma la/ /chags pa skyes pas gdong bzhi byung / /zhes tshangs pa la chags bral gyis ma khyab/ la sogs pa dregs pa can brgyad ni lha mo brgyad kyi gdan du byas/ gzhan 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams ni bran gyi tshul du phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad du bskrad nas de dag gi zhe sdang btul/ 'khyud pa dang tsum+bha la sogs pas bde ba chen po'i rnam rol du mas/ 'dod chags btul/ sngags kyi sgra la sogs pas gti mug btul lo/ /gnyis pa byon nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsungs tshul la/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsungs tshul dngos dang / zhar byung de la 'grel byed ji ltar byung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni de'i dus drag po dbang phyug chen po 'khor bcas btul rjes de ma thag tu gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar chud pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du ston pa sprul sku 'bras bu'i he ru kas 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa mtha' yas pa la chos dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa/ rtog pa'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa tsan+dan 'dar byed kyi gling zhes sa lha'i yul gcig na yod pa de dang / rgyud phyi ma phyag chen thig le/ phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po/ bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud/ rgyud sde gzhan yang thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud dpal sam+bu ṭi/ snying po'i rgyud grub pa nges par bstan pa'i thig le'i rgyud/ 'bras bu'i rgyud de kho na nyid sgron ma rnams gsungs so/ /slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i shākya seng ge de nyid he ru ka'i tshul bzung nas rtsa rgyud bsdus pa brtag pa gnyis pa'i bdag nyid le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa sh+lo ka bdun brgya lnga bcu pa dang /

bshad rgyud thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyang gsungs so/ /de rnams kyi nang nas rgyud rgyas pa gnyis ni sgra nam mkha' la dengs pa yin te/ shan+ti pas 'grel pa mu tig phreng par/ de bas na bsam gtan gyi bdud rtsi'i ro ma myang bar thos bsam gyi shes rab tsam la chags bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig ces dgongs nas gzhung rgyas pa gnyis ni ched du mi snang bar byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa zhar byung de la 'grel byed ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos rgyud 'grel gyi dkar chag las dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa yi/ /rgyud kyi tshig don 'grel byed pa/ /rdo rje snying po nā ro pa/ /nag po spyod pa bha wa pa/ /ḍaṃ ka da sha pad+ma ba/ /mi thub zla ba shan ti pa/ /dam tshig rdo rje pad myug dang / /ka ma dhi nu chos grags te/ /'phags yul 'grel pa bcu gnyis mthong / /'on kyang chos grags 'grel pa ni/ /bod mar mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed/ /gangs ri'i rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ /dka' 'grel yod mdo sngon ma 'gyur/ /bod na ra rngog dpyal se sogs/ /bshad pa'i bka' srol mang na yang / /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa'i/ /lugs la bla ma mnga' ris pa/ /gsal ba'i snying po'i tshig 'grel dang / /sgyi chu ba yi dka' 'grel yod/ /rje btsun sa chen yab sras kyi/ /dka' 'grel nyi 'od dag ldan dang / /spyi rnam rgyud kyi mngon rtogs sogs/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhung bdun yod/ /shākya grags dang khang ston te/ /gong ma'i rjes 'brang ṭīk+ka gnyis/ /rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug grags/ /chos kyi seng ge gzhon nu 'bum/ /kun dga' 'od zer bkra shis dpal/ /rdo rje tshul khrims 'dre ston te/ /'phags pa'i rjes 'brang ṭīk+ka brgyad/ /chos rje bla ma gnas drug pa/ /'jigs med grags dang bsod nams grags/ /rgyal po dpal dang rgya ston dang /

/kun gzhon kun dga' bkra shis te/ /sna tshogs bsdus pa'i ṭīk+ka brgyad/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gzungs kyi dpal/ /grags rgyal blo gros seng ge ste/ /mchan dang dag chung bsres pa bzhi/ /ye dang gnyan ston gung pa dang / /ston gzhon rdo rje shes rab ste/ /'phags pa'i rjes 'brangs zin bris lnga/ /gzhan yang 'dis byas med pa yi/ /ṭīk+ka zin bris dka' 'grel sogs/ /snga rabs mkhas pas sbyar ba yi/ /yig cha rab tu mang po mthong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa de'i nang nas gang la brten nas bshad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i lnga pa he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u la sogs pa'i snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung rnams la brten no/ /gnyis pa gang nas brgyud pa'i brgyud pa ngos bzung ba la/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul gyi bshad srol ji tsam yod tshul/ de las bod kyi bla ma rnams gang gi rjes su 'brangs dpyad pa/ bye brag tu snying por gyur pa'i lam srol ngos bzung ste bshad pa'o/ /dang po la 'phags yul du lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa drug ste/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyi bshad srol/ grub chen mi thub zla ba'i bshad srol/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa lta bu slob dpon shan+ti pa'i bshad srol/ slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje'i dngos slob nag po shan+ta bha dra'i bshad srol/ kha che snyan grags bzang pos mdzad pa'i nā ro 'grel chen du grags pa'i bshad srol/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i bshad srol te de ltar lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshad srol drug po de tsam du zad la/ gzhan rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa'i 'grel pa bdun tsam dang / byang chub snying po la sogs pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs drug tsam yod kyang lam srol yongs su rdzogs pa ni med do/ /gnyis pa de las bod kyi bla ma rnams gang gi rjes su 'brangs dpyad pa ni/

mnga' bdag mar pa nas rngog gzhung pa la brgyud pa la smin lam yongs su rdzogs pa/ grol lam bskyed rim yan lag drug pa/ rdzogs rim bsre 'pho'i man ngag de dag gi rgyab rten du rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bshad rnams te lam rdzogs par tshang ba yod cing / 'di rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin la/ gzhan rwa pa dang / dpyal se ba dang / gtum ston slob dpon grags dang / ram sding ma rnams ni rgya gar ba'i bshad srol la brten pa yin kyang lam yongs su rdzogs pa med do/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams gang gi rjes su 'brangs pa ni 'og tu rgyas par 'chad do/ /gsum pa snying por gyur pa'i lam srol ngos bzung ba ni/ bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bshad srol 'di nyid yin la/ 'di gang gi rjes su 'brangs snyam na 'di la gnyis te/ gzhung 'grel la brten pa'i bshad srol dang / man ngag gi bshad srol lo/ /dang po ni rje btsun rin po ches kye rdo rje'i chos skor gyi dkar chag las/ snying po don gyi kye rdor ni/ /bir+wa'i rjes 'brangs ḍoṃ bhi'i skor/ /yan lag med ces pad+ma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bir+wa pa'i dngos slob sku lus ma spangs par mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa grub chen ḍoṃbhi pa'i bshad srol dang / yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i rjes 'brangs pad+ma'i bshad srol dang / slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje'i rjes 'brangs nag po shan+ta bha dra'i bshad srol dang gsum mo/ /grub chen de dag gi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i yig sna'i rkang grangs la rje btsun rin po ches gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso che ba'i chos sna sum cu rtsa dgu'i 'dren tshul ni/ grub chen ḍom+bhi pa'i chos skor la rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa ku mu ti/ smin byed dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung /

grol lam bskyed rim dbang po rab la yab kyi sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od/ dbang po tha ma la yab kyi sgrub thabs dran pa gcig pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs dpa' mo gcig pa/ thun mong du rdzogs rim gtum mo'i 'grel chung / lam gyi yan lag de nyid bcu pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ gtor ma'i cho ga phyag mtshan gyi dag pa/ sngags don/ sbyin sreg man ngag ro sreg de dag gi don bsdus sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba rnams so/ /pad+ma'i chos skor la rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa pad+ma can/ smin byed dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas gling ma/ bskyed rim sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ tshogs 'khor cho ga dam tshig lnga pa/ bstod pa nyi shu pa/ bshad srol de gnyis la thun mong du phan 'dogs pa'i gur gyi bshad sbyar/ phyag bcu drug pa dkar po'i mngon rtogs/ gzhan yang skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad la gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa/ rtsa ba'i mngon rtogs che chung / dur khrod kyi 'grel pa che chung / brda'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje'i glu'i 'grel pa che chung gnyis rnams so/ /slob dpon shan+ta bha dra'i chos skor la rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rnal 'byor rin po che'i sbyor ba'i phreng ba/ smin byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nag po gzhung 'grel/ grol lam bskyed rim dbang po rab la yab kyi sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba/ 'bring la phyag bcu drug pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ tha ma la phyag gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ lam gyi yan lag tshogs 'khor/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg ro bsreg rnams te/ de ltar ḍom+bhi pa'i yig sna bco lnga/ pad+ma'i yig sna lnga/ de gnyis thun mong du phan 'dogs pa'i yig sna bcu/ shan+ta bha dra'i skabs su yig sna dgu ste kun 'dril sum cu rtsa dgu'o/ /chos sna 'di rnams kyi rkang grangs la 'dren tshul mi 'dra ba ches mang zhing / 'dir bkod pa ni rje btsun gyi dngos slob gnyis kyi zin bris kyi dpe sgo rum dpe khang na yod pa bden blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gzigs pa'i nang bzhin yin pas shin tu khungs btsun par shes par bya'o/

/gnyis pa man ngag gi bshad srol ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i bar yi ge med pas snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yin kyang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams snyan rgyud 'dzin par mi nus pas nub kyi dogs nas yi ger bkod pa'i rkang grangs la don gnyis te/ rgyud 'chad pa'i skabs su dgos pa'i chos sna dang / man ngag nyams su len pa'i skabs su dgos pa'i chos sna gnyis las/ dang po la rgyud spyi la dgos pa'i chos sna/ rgyud so so la dgos pa'i chos sna/ rdo rje theg pa spyi dang bye brag rgyud 'di'i rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa'i chos sna/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa'i chos sna dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni rje btsun rin po ches 'grel pa dag ldan las/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam gzhag mngon rtogs dang / /stong thun gnyis kyi don bsdus bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang po rje btsun sa skya pas mdzad pa'i rgyud sde'i dum bu/ gnyis pa slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag gsum pa mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing / bzhi pa stong thun gnyis kyi bsdus don sa bcad/ lnga pa yab kyi bstod pa daṇ+ḍaka drug pa yum gyi bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba rnams rje btsun rin po ches mdzad/ bdun pa bdag med bstod 'grel rje btsun sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa rnams so/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel don bsdus bcas/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya zhing / /de ltar bcu gsum legs par rab bltas na/ /rnam par phye bas rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dag ldan/ de'i bsdus don/ gur gyi 'grel pa gur rgyan/ de'i bsdus don/

sam+bu ṭi'i 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed/ de'i bsdus don te rgyud gcig shes par 'dod na gnyis dang / gnyis shes par 'dod na bzhi dang / gsum char shes par 'dod na drug char blang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni rje btsun rin po ches/ smin byed ltung ba'i rnam gzhag sgrub thabs bzhi/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blug dang / /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten bsgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i las can nas/ /brtsams te gang zag kun gyis gzung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i smin byed kyi dbang gi chu bo chen mo/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i ltung ba'i rnam gzhag 'khrul pa spong ba/ yab kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i yab kyi sgrub thabs 'bring po yan yag drug pa dang / yab kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs gnyis rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ rab gnas bzang po drug pa dang / zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtse mos mdzad pa/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi kha skong las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dang / tshogs 'khor tshim pa drug pa gnyis rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ dril bu bgrang phreng gi rnam gzhag 'grel pa gnad kyi gsal byed du gsal/ dgang blug gi rnam gzhag zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi yi ger gsal/ dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan phan bdud rtsi rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga ni/ gur rgyan du gsal bas der shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i chos sna ni rje btsun rin po ches/ lus rgyan btung ba'i snod dang gzung bya'i rdzas/ /rol mo'i cha byad stan dang bgo ba'i gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye bas bcu bzhir 'gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bcu bzhir 'gyur tshul la/ rgyan la bzhi ste btung ba'i snod dang lnga/

/lag cha gnyis dang rol mo'i cha byad gsum/ /gos dang stan la gnyis gnyis de ltar na/ /drug las phye bas bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu ste lus rgyan bzhi/ btung ba'i snod thod pa ste gcig gri gug dang kha ṭāṃ ga ste gzung bya'i rdzas gnyis/ ḍā ma ru dang / gsang ba'i rnga chung dang / mi rkang gi gling bu ste rol mo'i yo byad gsum/ stag lpags dang mi lpags kyi stan gnyis/ stag gi sham thabs dang nā ro'i chos gos te bgo ba'i gos gnyis so/ /de dag gi rnam gzhag ni rje btsun rin po ches he ru ka'i chas drug ston pa'i rnam bshad yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa man ngag nyams su len pa'i skabs su dgos pa'i chos sna rnams ni rje btsun rin po ches lam 'bras kyi glegs bam dkar chag na bzhugs pa'i chos sna drug cu po rnams dang / phra mo'i glegs bam dang bcas pa'o/ /de rnams kyi brgyud pa la ring brgyud dang nye brgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni ding sang yongs su grags pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni rje btsun rin po ches stong thun sa bcad du/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgos/ /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa de las byung ba'i sgrub thabs dngos ngos bzung ba ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la brgyud pa kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi chos skor gyi nang tshan rje btsun gong ma dang rjes 'brang tshad ldan gyis mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs kyi yi ge rnams 'dir bshad bya'i chos dngos so/ /gnyis pa ngos zin pa de ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul la don gnyis te spyi don dang gzhung don no/

/dang po la gsum ste bsgrub bya lha'i rnam par gzhag pa/ sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi dbye ba/ des ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po la'ang gsum ste spyir rgyud gsum las bshad pa'i lha'i rnam grangs/ de'i nang nas bye brag tu kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ngos bzung ba/ de las zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gtso bor ston pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po la mchog bsgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor/ las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po la gang la dbye ba'i gzhi/ ji ltar dbye ba'i tshul/ de ltar phye ba'i don la spros pa dpyad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni lha'i rnam pa gang la rnam gzhag khyad par can sbyar du yod pas tha mal gyi rnam rtog mtha' dag sbyang nus shing mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa ni rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis nas bshad pa la he ru ka bzhi/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga ste drug bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje gur nas bshad pa la rigs bsdus dang rigs rkyang gnyis las/ dang po la rgyas pa lha zhe dgu ma dang / bsdus pa lha nyer lnga ma/ gnyis pa la rgyas pa lha dgu ma dang / bsdus pa lha lnga ma/ de re re la rigs lnga lngar 'gyur te lnga bzhi nyi shu'o/ /de re re la he ru ka bzhi bzhir phye bas brgyad cu dang / bdag med lha mo bcu gsum ma/ bco lnga ma ste brgyad cu rtsa gnyis so/ /bshad rgyud thun mong ba dpal sam+bu ṭi las bshad pa la/ he ru ka bzhi/ bdag med ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro drag po gdan can/ rdo rje dbyings la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rigs lngar 'phos pas dkyil 'khor lngar 'gyur te bcu gnyis/ kun dril bas rgyud gsum nas bshad pa'i mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya tham pa yod do/ /gsum pa la 'o na gtso bo du ma 'phos pas dkyil 'khor de bas mang du mi 'gyur ram snyam na mi 'gyur te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rigs lnga las gzhan 'pho bar mi bzhed la/

gzhan rnams las rgyas pa'i lha yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skud du yang sam+bu ṭi'i brtag pa bdun pa las zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi las rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po rgyal mo rnam par bsgom par bya ste zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te gang la dbye ba'i gzhi/ ji ltar dbye ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni lha'i rnam pa gang la rnam gzhag khyad par can ma gsungs pas tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyang bar mi nus shing / thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gsum pa la rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas bshad pa la las tshogs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i drag po sngags kyi lha bdun/ ku ru kul+le'i char dbab bzlog gi lha gnyis te dgu rdo rje gur nas bshad pa la le'u gnyis pa nas 'byung po 'dul byed dang stobs po che gnyis/ le'u bzhi pa nas sgrol ma dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ le'u brgyad pa nas khro bo bcu sbags te bsgrub pa/ le'u bcu gnyis pa nas rdo rje lus med rnams dang / le'u bco lnga pa nas ku ru kul+le/ spyan ras gzigs/ so sor 'brang ma la sogs pa zhi ba'i lha bcu gcig dpal rdo rje nag po chen po rnams gsungs/ dpal sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud nas bshad pa la brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab byed bzhi pa nas sgrol ma/ ku ru kul+le/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rigs bzhi/ yum bzhi/ brtag pa bdun pa dang brgyad pa nas las tshogs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lha bcu bdun/ brtag pa lnga pa'i rab byed gnyis pa nas bgrang phreng dang rjes su 'brel ba dang / rdzogs rim dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lha ste kun dril pas rgyud gsum nas bshad pa'i las rgyas pa'i lha drug cu rtsa drug yod do/ /gnyis pa de las bye brag tu kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ngos bzung ba ni rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las dkyil 'khor drug

rdo rje gur nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis/ sam+bu ṭi nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor dang po lnga ste kun dril pas kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dgu bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /gsum pa de las zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gtso bor ston pa'i rgyu mtshan la gang la dogs pa'i gnas/ de la dogs pa skyes nas rdo rje snying pos zhus pa/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gsungs pa'i tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni bcom ldan 'das kyis brtag pa dang po'i rdo rje rigs kyi le'u las/ rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /dngos po nyid kyis rnam grol zhing / /dngos po'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /de yongs shes pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don tha mal gyi dngos po'i rnam rtog gis khams gsum 'khor bar 'ching zhing tha mal gyi rnam rtog de nyid lha'i dngos por bsgoms pas grol bar gsungs la/ lha gang gis grol bar ma gsungs pa la dogs pa skyes so/ /gnyis pa ni rdo rje snying pos/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kun la/ /rgya mtsho ku ba ji lta bar/ /rang 'dod lha'i gzugs kyi ni/ /sems can dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes zhus pa'i don chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba nam mkha' ltar brjod du med pa yin kyang de ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis ji ltar na shing thog ku ba rgya mtshor lhung ba rlung gis ded nas phyogs bzhir gtol med du 'gro ba bzhin/ dge mi dge'i las kyi bag chags kyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i gting dpag dka' bar rigs drug so so'i gnas su cha med du 'khyams pa'i sems can rang gi 'dod pa'i lha gang gi gzugs kyi rnam par bsgoms pas tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob par ji ltar 'gyur zhes zhus pas so/ /gsum pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa 'am/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /gzhan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang /

/dngos grub 'dod pas mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bdag med gnyis kyi yon tan dang ldan zhing rgyud gsung ba'i ston pa dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma dang / chos sku'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon nus pa'i he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas mchog gi dngos grub 'grub la/ de las gzhan pa'i thabs kyi lha sku rdo rje phyag gnyis pa sogs dang / shes rab kyi lha ku ru kul+le la sogs pa rnams kyis ni ma yin te/ 'bras bu 'byung ba med pa'i phyir dang / dpal gyi 'os ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu 'byung ba med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa rnams 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed cing rgyu 'dra bas 'bras bu 'dra ba bsgrub dgos pa la/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /dpal gyi 'os ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dpal gyi don/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ni stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin la/ de lta bu'i stong pa nyid bcu drug rtogs pa'i khyad par rnam par thar pa brgyad zhal brgyad/ snying rje'i khyad par bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi zhabs bzhir sprul bas/ de lta bu'i 'bras dus kyi stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni chos sku he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa 'di kho nas mtshon nus pa yin la/ gzhan ku ru kul+le la sogs pas mtshon mi nus pas na dpal gyi 'os ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na he ru ka rigs lnga'i nang nas gang gtso bor byed snyam na mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi he ru ka gtso bor byed la/ de'i rgyu mtshan sbyang gzhi phung po lnga'i nang nas mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi rnams sems kyi phung po gtso che ste rdo rje gur las/

rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nang nas zhe ldang gtso che ste/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sbyong byed lam la'ang chu'i dbang ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang rdo rje slob ma'i dbang thams cad la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i phyir/ de ltar sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo sbyong byed lam gyi gtso bos sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras kyi gtso bo thob pa las 'os ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sgrub byed mngon rtogs kyi dbye ba la gsum las/ spyir slob dpon so so'i lugs kyi mngon rtogs kyi dbye ba/ rang lugs mngon rtogs tsam la bcu bzhir dbye ba/ bye brag tu bskyed rim gyi mngon rtogs la tshul bcu bzhir dbye ba'o/ /dang po la bdun te ting nge 'dzin gyis 'ching ba/ yan lag drug gis 'ching ba/ de gnyis char gyis 'ching ba/ gnas pa bzhis 'ching ba/ yan lag bzhis 'ching ba/ rnal 'byor bzhis 'ching ba/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub thabs so/ /dang po ni slob dpon shan+ti pas/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog ste ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching bar bzhed/ gnyis pa ni/ grub chen mi thub zla bas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag la sogs pa yan lag drug gis 'ching bar bzhed/ gsum pa ni mnga' bdag mai tri pas de gnyis char gyis 'ching bar bzhed/ bzhi pa ni grub chen mtsho skyes kyis/ gong bu chu dang gzugs su gnas/ /gzugs las 'das pa bzhis rtogs bya/ /zhes pa ltar gnas pa bzhis 'ching bar bzhed/ lnga pa ni slob dpon bha wa bha dras/ bsnyen pa/ nye bar sgrub pa/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po ste yan lag bzhis 'ching bar bzhed/ drug pa ni slob dpon dza lan+dha ri ka pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor/

rnal 'byor chen po/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ rjes su rnal 'byor te rnal 'byor bzhis 'ching bar bzhed/ bdun pa ni slob dpon a bh+ya ka ras rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'ching bar bzhed do/ /gnyis pa rang lugs mngon rtogs tsam la bcu bzhir dbye ba la gsum ste/ gtso bor mchog bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ mchog dang thun mong gnyis ka bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ de gnyis la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa'o/ /dang po la dbye na rtogs pa'i lta ba/ bskyed pa'i rim pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ spyod pa/ nye rgyu dang lnga/ gnyis pa la dbye na rab gnas/ sbyin sreg bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ las tshogs la phyi nang gi las tshogs gnyis te drug go /gsum pa la dbye na las dang po pa'i dam tshig brtan pa thob pa'i dam tshig brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig dang gsum ste kun dril bas mngon rtogs bcu bzhi'o/ /gsum pa bye brag tu bskyed rim gyi mngon rtogs la tshul bcu bzhir dbye ba la bzhi ste/ las dang po pa'i gang zag gi nyams len/ bde ba cung zad skyes pa'i gang zag gi nyams len/ bde stong gi nyams skyes pa'i gang zag gi nyams len/ bde stong gi nyams cher skyes pa'i gang zag gi nyams len no/ /dang po ni a li ka li la ltos pa'i mngon sbyang gis bskyed pa ste/ de la dbye na rgyas pa yan lag bzhis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs/ 'bring po yan lag drug gis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs te gnyis/ dang po la mi mnyam sbyor dang mnyam sbyor ro/ /de re re la thig le'i 'gros dang sa bon 'gros gnyis gnyis te bzhi/ gnyis pa la'ang mi mnyam sbyor dang mnyam sbyor ro/ /de re re la sa bon 'gros dang lha mo 'gros te gnyis gnyis te bzhi'o/ /dril bas brgyad/ gnyis pa bde ba cung zad skyes pa'i gang zag gi nyams len ni a li ka li la ma ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor gyi mngon sbyang las bskyed pa ste/ de la gnyis te yan lag bzhis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs dang /

drug gis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs so/ /dang po la thig le'i 'gros dang sa bon 'gros gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang sa bon 'gros dang lha mo 'gros te bzhi dril bas bcu gnyis/ gsum pa bde stong gi nyams skyes pa'i gang zag gi nyams len ni sa bon las bskyed pa'i yan lag drug gis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs so/ /bzhi pa bde stong gi nyams cher skyes pa'i gang zag gi nyams len ni skad cig gis bskyed pa'i yan lag bzhis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs te kun dril bas mngon rtogs tshul bcu bzhi'o/ /rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs kyi mngon par rtogs pa la khyab pa gsum ste/ rgyu 'bras kyi he ru ka 'khor bcas mngon byang kho na las bskyed pas khyab/ mkha' nang nas lha mo mi spro bas khyab/ lha la dri za 'jug pa med pas khyab bo/ /mkha' nang nas lha mo mi spro ba'i rgyu mtshan phyogs mtshams kyi nyi zla rnams lha mo'i rgyu yin pas so/ /'bring po yan lag drug pa'i phyogs kyi mngon rtogs la khyab pa bzhi ste/ rgyu'i he ru ka nag po mi byed pas khyab/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa mngon byang las mi bskyed pas khyab/ mkha' nang nas thig le mi spro bas khyab/ lha la dri za 'jug pas khyab/ mkha' nang nas thig le mi spro ba'i rgyu mtshan tshang med par sgo nga mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /mnyam sbyor la nges pa brgyad yod de mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi rgyu a li ka li la ltos par nges/ rnam pa zla bar nges/ dbyibs gru gsum du nges/ de la a li ka lis mtshan par nges/ mngon byang gsum pa bar du mi sgom steng du sgom par nges/ de la sa bon gyis ma mtshan par nges/ 'od zer 'phro bar nges/ de las byung ba'i lha dkar por nges so/ /mi mnyam sbyor gyi mngon rtogs la nges pa drug yod de/ mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi rgyu nyi zla ya ma zung du nges/ dbyibs zlum por nges/ a li ka lis ma mtshan par nges/

mngon byang gsum pa steng du mi sgom bar du sgom par nges/ de la sa bon gyis mtshan par nges/ 'od zer mi 'phro bar nges so/ /de la ma nges pa gnyis yod de/ mngon byang dang po gnyis rgyu a li ka li la ltos par ma nges/ de las byung ba'i lha dkar nag tu ma nges so/ /rje btsun rin po ches gsung ngag glegs bam gyi phyi bskyed rim gyi yig chung du/ mngon par rtogs pa tshul bcu bzhi'am bco lngar snang mod kyi/ zhib par ni rgyud nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa tshul bco lnga pa'i ngos 'dzin la kha cig rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed pa'i mngon rtogs la 'dod pa dang / kha cig rigs bsdus kyi mngon rtogs la 'dod pa dang / kha cig yum gyi mngon rtogs la 'dod pa dang / kha cig 'grel pa lugs kyi 'khrugs chen gyi mngon rtogs rnams la 'dod pa yod kyang / bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed pa'i lugs ni rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i lnga par mngon par rtogs pa ston pa'i gzhung rnams 'khrugs can du byas nas mngon rtogs gcig dang / dang po'i brgyad pa dang sbyar nas 'khrugs med kyi mngon par rtogs pa bcu bzhir byas pa gnyis las dang po yin cing / 'di ni man ngag lugs kyi snying po kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang snying po kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yin pa gcig dgos te/ rje btsun yab la rdo rje bdag med mas yab nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ji ltar yin zhus pa'i lan gsungs pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ man ngag lugs yin pa gcig dgos te rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i gsung ngag glegs bam nas bshad pa'i man ngag lugs kyi bskyed rim mngon rtogs bgrang ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gnad kyi zla zer du slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i lugs ltar mngon rtogs gcig tu bya ba dang /

zhes mi thub zla ba'i lugs de nyid dper gsungs pas so zhes bdag chen nyid bzhed pa yin no/ /'o na mngon par rtogs pa de tsam du gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na gdul bya'i gang zag gi dbang du byas te/ sngar bshad pa'i gang zag bzhi po de rnams kyis dang por mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa sgom/ de nas ting nge 'dzin la blo zhugs pa nas mngon rtogs rnams je bsdus la gtong zhing / de bzhin du bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin la dang por yun thung ba dang / de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi sna zin nas je ring je ring la gtong ba ni bskyed rim gyi cha dbri bskyed kyi gdam ngag ces gzhan las ches zab pa zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /yan lag drug gi mngon rtogs ni spros pa la dga' na yan lag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs sgom/ spros pa la mi dga' na yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs sgom pas chog pa yin gyi/ rim can du sgom dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /gang zag de dag gis mngon rtogs de rnams sa mtshams gang gi bar du sgom snyam na/ las dang po nas gzhal yas khang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa yud tsam res 'char mi nus shing rim gyis gsal bar nus pa'i bar ni gang zag dang po yin pas/ des a li ka li la ltos pa'i mngon byang gi mngon rtogs de rnams sgom/ de nas rags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams yud tsam gyis 'char nus na'ang / phra ba mig sogs la bkod pa'i lha rnams skad cig gis 'char mi nus shing / rim gyis gsal btab na 'char bar nus kyi bar ni gang zag gnyis pa yin te/ des a li ka li spangs pa'i mngon byang gi mngon rtogs rnams sgom/ de nas phra ba mig sogs la bkod pa'i lha rnams yud tsam gyis 'char bar nus pa nas/ snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'char nus kyi bar ni gang zag gsum pa yin pas/ des sa bon las bskyed pa'i mngon rtogs rnams sgom/ de nas snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yud tsam gyis 'char nus pa ni gang zag bzhi pa yin pas/

des skad cig gis bskyed pa'i mngon rtogs sgom mo/ /gsum pa des de ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ mngon rtogs de dag gis lha de rnams tshul ji ltar sgrub snyam na rim pa gnyis kyi sgo nas sgrub dgos te bla med kyi nyams len thams cad rim pa gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thams cad stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med par 'dus pa dang / smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis su 'dus pa dang / thabs dang shes rab gnyis su 'dus par rdo rje gur nas bshad cing / sngon byung ston pas rdo rje can gyi chos thams cad rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas gsungs pa ltar rjes 'jug sgrub pa po rnams kyis kyang rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas nyams su len dgos pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/ /rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid/ /rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyis chos 'chad do/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang / /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /'o na sbyang gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi chos rnams rim pa gnyis su 'dus sam snyam na 'dus te/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud dang de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos rnams smin byed dbang gi skabs su lhar bskyed cing bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid kyi rgyun lam dus su goms par byed pa la rim gnyis sgom par 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'bras dus kyi chos rnams kyang rim gnyis su 'dus pa yin te/ lam rim gnyis sgom pa mthar phyin pa las 'bras bu sku gnyis thob pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rim pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'chad pa la don drug ste rim pa gnyis kyi ngo bo/

dbye ba/ nges tshig grangs nges/ grol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ go rim nges pa'o/ /dang po la slob dpon ye shes zhabs la sogs pa rnams kyis zab gsal gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor rim gnyis kyi ngo bo yin cing de nyid kyis grol bar bzhed de/ sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ des na zab gsal gnyis med pas/ /nga ni rtag tu mya ngan 'das/ /de don skye bos mi shes pas/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ro/ /des na zab gsal byang chub ni/ /gnyis med rtogs pas nga grol lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pas dbang bzhis smin pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blang byar gyur pa'i zung 'jug gi aṃ de rim gnyis kyi ngo bo yin/ yang na thabs khyad par can gyis mtshan rtog las yid skyob par byed pa la bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po ni/ snang ba khyad par can gyis mtshan rtog las yid skyob pa/ phyi ma ni ye shes khyad par can gyis de las skyob par byed pa'o/ /yang na tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyong bar byed pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor khyad par can dang / gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog sbyong bar byed pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes khyad par can no/ /gsum pa nges tshig la gsum ste gtso bor gzhi la ming du btags pa dang / gtso bor 'bras bu la ming du btags pa dang / gtso bor lam la ming du btags pa'o/ /dang po ni/ klu sgrub yab sras rnams kyi bzhed pa la sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi rim pa gnyis las/ sbyang gzhi bskyed pa ni tha mal pa'i sems can gyi lus grub pa yin la/ rim pa ni skyes gnas bzhi/ bye brag tu mngal skyes ltar na mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga'o/ /de sbyong byed ni bskyed pa'i rim pa lha'i rnam pa'o/ /sbyangs shing rdzogs pa ni tha mal pa'i sems can tshe zad pa nas 'chi ba yin la/ rim pa ni sa chu la thim pa la sogs pa'o/ /de sbyong byed ni rdor bzlas dang 'od gsal ba'o zhes bzhed/

gnyis pa ni/ sems 'grel ba rnams kyi bzhed pa la bskyed pa ni mchog gi dngos grub la brod pa bskyed pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub yin la/ rim pa ni de bsgrub pa'i thabs lha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /rdzogs pa ni de las gong na gzhan med pas mchog gi dngos grub yin la/ rim pa ni de sgrub pa'i thabs sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa yin no/ /zhes bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i bzhed pa la blos kun tu lha'i rnam pa bskyed pas na bskyed pa/ rim pa ni mngon byang lnga la sogs pa rim gyis gsal 'debs pa'o/ /rdzogs pa ni lus ngag yid gsum rdzogs pa yin la/ rim pa ni bdag byin rlabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rim gyis sgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa grangs nges pa ni/ 'o na lam de gnyis ka sgom dgos sam snyam na/ de gnyis ka sgom dgos te spang bya gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang / 'thob bya gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang / rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po spang bya gnyis yin te tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang / gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam par rtog pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bskyed rim gyis sbyong ste/ rdo rje gur las/ phal pa'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ sgom pa yang dag rab tu grags/ /rang bzhin gnas skabs sgom pa las/ sgom pa ma yin mi sgom min/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rtogs pa de bzhin te/ /'on kyang mi gtsang ba yi tshad rnams sbyong ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phal pa'i gnas skabs sam mi gtsang ba'i tshad tha mal gyi rnam rtog la rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dang / 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po bskyed rim gyi sngon 'gro'i tshogs gnyis bsags pas sbyong / gnyis pa la snod bcud gnyis las dang po ni/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pas sbyong /

gnyis pa ni/ lha'i rnam pas sbyong la de yang khro chags kyi rnam pa can gyi bskyed rim ni ches zab pa ste/ des nyon mongs pa dug gsum sbyong bar nus te khro bo'i rnam par bzhugs pas zhe sdang sbyong / yab yum mnyam par sbyar zhing btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pas 'dod chags sbyong / mtshan dpes spras pa'i skur sgom pas gti mug sbyong ba'i phyir te/ rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal ser sna'i skye bo rnams/ bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo las/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gya nom lhar zhen gyi rtog pa ni rdzogs rim gyis sbyong ste/ rgyud las bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa sgom/ /spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /des na tha mal gyi rnam rtog bskyed rim gyis sbyong / gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog rdzogs rim gyis sbyong ba dang / skye ba bskyed rim gyis sbyong zhing 'chi ba rdzogs rim gyis sbyong ba dang / gzhan yang bskyed rdzogs re res kyang skye 'chi dang / snang stong la sogs pa'i rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong bar nus mod/ zhib par ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa 'thob bya'i 'bras bu la sangs rgyas gzugs sku dang / chos sku gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas gzugs sku thob pa yin te rdo rje gur las/ de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /thabs ni bde ba'i sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni myur bar 'grub/ /ston pa sum bcu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de nyid thabs kyi bsgrub bya ste/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ lus can thabs kyi sgom pa'i dgos pa sangs rgyas de rnams thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/

/de'i lus can de ni bden pa/ de'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus nye bar brgyan pa ste me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bskyed rim bsgoms pas gzugs sku thob pa dang / de mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par bstan la/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas la sku dang ye shes med par 'dod pa'i log rtog gzugs sku bem por 'dod pa'i log rtog sangs rgyas thob pa la bskyed rim mi dgos par 'dod pa'i log rtog rnams 'dis bsal ba yin no/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam 'di ni ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa byon tshul dang mthun par rgyal ba sangs rgya ba dang chos mthun sbyar ba/ ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul dang mthun par sbyang gzhi 'khor ba'i rim pa sbyong tshul dang sbyar ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs kyi thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang 'dra/ tshogs bsags gnyis ni bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa dang mtshungs la/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa de yang cung zad phye na tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa nas mchod pa'i bar sbyin pa/ bdun rnam gzhag gi sgo nas sems bskyed pa dang rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bas tshul khrims/ tshad med pa bzhis bzod pa/ de rnams la thun bzhir nan tan tu spro bas 'jug pa brtson 'grus/ de rnams thun bzhir rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa bsam gtan/ gong du don dam sems bskyed de bzung ba dang shu n+ya ta'i sngags don la mnyam par bzhag pas shes rab ste/ phar phyin drug gis ni bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa ni srod la bdud btul ba/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni ma dag pa'i snod 'og min tu byin gyis brlabs nas mngon byang lnga las lha'i tshogs grub pa ni tho rangs mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa/

dbang bskur ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa thig ler gnas pa las lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul te bzhengs pa ni/ zab zhi spros bral la sogs pa gsungs nas sangs rgyas thugs las chung ngus chos mi gsung bar bzhugs pa las/ tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes pa/ bdud rtsi myang ba ni legs skyes mas 'o thug drangs pa gsol ba/ mchod bstod ni tshangs pa dang brgya sbyin la sogs pa lha rnams kyis mchod bstod phul ba/ bzlas pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dngos/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa ni mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las lha skur langs te spyod lam gyi bya ba byed pa ni mdzad pa phrin las kyis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ston pa he ru ka'i byon tshul dang mthun par sbyang gzhi 'khor ba'i rim pa sbyong tshul ni/ zhib par 'og nas 'chad do/ /'bras bu gnyis pa chos sku ni rdzogs rim bsgoms pas thob pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las chos kyi dbyings ni 'od gsal ba/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa de bas na/ /sems can sangs rgyas mnyam par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ rang byung ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /zhes dang / rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /de yi bde ba bde chen brjod/ /rdzogs pa sgom pa med pa ste/ /bskyed pa yis ni ci zhig 'tshal/

/zhes pa'i don bskyed rim rdzogs rim gyis sbyong zhing 'bras bu chos sku 'grub na bskyed rim sgom pa don med do snyam na rdzogs rim de ltar bzang yang / bskyed rim la ma brten par rdzogs rim mi 'byung ste dper na me tog dang dri bzhin rdzogs rim yang bskyed rim la brten dgos pa'i phyir te/ e ma byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams/ /lus kyi dngos med gang las bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ /khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ /bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog dngos med shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med pas/ /bde ba nyid ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa grol ba'i rgyu mtshan la gsum ste rigs sam rgyu yin pa dang / thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir dang / dag pa nyid kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po ni/ lam rim pa gnyis bsgoms pas grol ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na rgyu mtshan yod de/ sbyang gzhi phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos rnams dang / sbyong byed lam rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa de sbyangs 'bras de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid cung zad phye ste bshad na spyir rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags yod de bud shing la me'i rigs su 'jog pa lta bu/ 'bras bu la rgyu'i ming du btags pa yod de gser bum la gser gyi rigs su 'jog pa lta bu/ brten pa la rten gyi rigs su btags pa yod de rgyal pos mngags pa'i pho nya la rgyal po'i skyes bu zhes ming du btags pa lta bu/ rten la brten pa'i ming du btags pa yod de rgyal po nyid kyang grong pa'i rigs zhes ming du btags pa lta bu/ de bzhin du khyab bya la khyab byed kyi rigs su 'jog pa dang / khyab byed la khyab bya'i rigs su 'jog pa sogs sna tshogs yod pa bzhin no/

/sbyangs 'bras la sbyang gzhi'i ming du btags pa yod de/ sam+bu ṭi las/ bud shing bsregs pa'i rigs pa yi/ /dges pa'i rgyal ba gar mkhan mchog /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sbyang gzhi la sbyangs 'bras kyi ming du btags pa yod de/ rdo rje gur las/ thub pa rnam par snang mdzad rmongs/ /zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gang gi yongs su 'dzin pa po ni rigs bdag yin la/ des yongs su bzung ba ni rigs yin te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ mgon des yongs su bzung bas na/ /de yi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phan tshun mi slu ba'am mi 'da' bas na rigs dang rigs bdag gi don no/ /de nyid gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang sbyar te cung zad bshad na/ sbyang gzhi phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos rnams la chos can dang / chos nyid dang / rigs dang / rigs bdag tu 'jog pa dang / sbyong byed lam la rim pa gnyis la rigs dang rigs bdag tu 'jog pa dang / sbyangs 'bras la gzugs sku dang / chos sku la rigs dang rigs bdag tu 'jog pa yod/ skabs 'dir rigs dang rigs bdag gi dbye ba cung zad bshad na/ rigs dang rigs bdag thams cad bsdu na rigs gcig tu 'dus te rtsa rgyud las/ sems ni chen po gcig nyid las/ /zhes dang / thugs kyi bdag po rigs gcig nyid/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gsum du dbye ba la sbyang gzhi'i dbang du byas nas de nyid las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /de rjes rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes pas mtshon nas rje btsun rin po ches/ rang bzhin gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug las/ /nyon mongs rlung dang yi ge rtsa dang khams/ /nad gdon rags pa re re'ang gsum gsum ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi gsum tshan dgu la sogs pa rnams so/ /sbyong byed kyi dbang du byas na rtsa rgyud las/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /phyi nas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhir dbye na sbyang gzhi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi/ sbyong byed dbang lam lta grub bzhi/ sbyangs 'bras sku bzhi rnams ni/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /lngar dbye na/ phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi lnga tshan bco lnga la sogs pa'o/ /drug tu dbye na/ rigs ni rnam pa drug brjod cing / /zhes dang / mi bskyod rnam snang rin chen 'byung / /dpag med phrag dog rdo rje sems/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /brgyar dbye na/ de rnams rigs la rigs ni rnam pa brgyad/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi rgyu'i rigs brgya/ sbyong byed lam gyi rigs brgya/ sbyangs pa 'bras bu'i rigs brgya rnams yod do/ /gzhan yang 'bum dang bye ba dang grangs med pa'i bar 'byung ste/ de rnams la yang 'bum phrag rigs chen rnams/ /bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga la sogs pa sbyangs 'bras de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed lam gyis sbyangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga la sogs pa thob pa las 'os ma 'das shing / sbyangs 'bras de rnams thob pa sbyang gzhi de dag la ltos dgos pa yin te thams cad gsang ba las/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas gdab cing / /'bras bu la'ang rgyu'i rgyas gdab/ /gzhan du bskal pa bye ba ni/ /grangs med par yang grol mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa ni/ 'o na sbyangs 'bras de rnams thob pa sbyang gzhi de rnams la nges par ltos dgos na sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol ba'i skyon yod de/ sems de dag la sbyang gzhi de rnams rang chas su yod pa'i phyir zhe na skyon med de/

thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pa'i nyon mongs pa rang dgar spyad na 'ching ba'i rgyur 'gyur la/ 'di lta bu'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin na grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur te/ rtsa rgyud las/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thabs khyad par can de la smin byed dbang gi thabs khyad par can dang / grol byed lam gyi thabs khyad par can gnyis las dang po ni/ sdom gsum las/ phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa grol byed lam gyi thabs mkhas la gnyis/ bskyed rim gyi thabs mkhas dang / rdzogs rim gyi thabs mkhas so/ /dang po la lhag pa'i lha'i thabs mkhas dang / lha so so'i thabs mkhas gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snang ba thams cad rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sgom pa yin te/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /zhes dang / rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la pha rgyud ltar na phung po lnga rigs lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ dbang po rnams byang chub sems dpa'/ yul rnams lha mo drug tu sgom pa yin te/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin/ /rdo rje skye mched nyid dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba ste/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma ki /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ste/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud 'dir phung po lnga nang gi rnal 'byor ma lngar sgom pa yin te/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /'byung ba bzhi mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi yin te/

sa ni puk+ka si ru bshad/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /skye mched rnams rdo rje ma drug yin te/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma ces gsungs so/ /yul rnams lha mo drug yin te/ gzugs la gau rir rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi thabs mkhas ni snang ba thams cad bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur nas sgom pa yin te rtsa rgyud las/ dman pa 'bring dang mchog rnams dang / /gzhan rnams gang dang gang rnams dang / /ro mnyam de nyid goms pa yi/ /'di kun mnyam pa nyid du lta/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa las/ thabs dang shes rab las byung ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /phung po khams dang skye mched gzugs/ /sngags pas nges par sbyang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di lta bu'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin tshul la rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba/ bzlog pa gnyen por che ba/ sbam pa gnyen por che ba/ bsnan pa gnyen por che ba dang bzhi las dang po gnas pa'i dug gis g.yo ba'i dug 'joms pa ltar/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gyis tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'joms pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gi dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/ rlung nad kyis zin pa la mon sran gyi bza' bas sel ba ltar/ tha mal gyi snod bcud du snang zhing zhen pa'i gnyen por/ dag gsal lha'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa yin te/ ji ltar rlung gis zin pa la/ /mon sran lde'u yi bza' ba byin/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa ni/ rna bar chu nyung ngu zhig zhugs pa la chu mang po blugs nas 'gugs pa ltar/ tha mal pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i gnyen por zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sgom pa la sogs pa yin te/ ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/

/zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ mes tshig pa me la bdug pa ltar tha mal gyi 'dod chags kyi gnyen por 'du shes gsum ldan gyi rdo rje'i chags pa sgom pa yin te/ ji ltar tshad pas tshig pa yang / /me yis yang ni gdung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na lam de dag spang bya dang 'gal bas grol lam mi 'gal bas grol snyam na spang bya de dag dang dngos su mi 'gal la/ rgyu dang brgyud nas 'gal bas grol zhes rje btsun gyis gsungs so/ /gsum pa dag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid yin pas grol ba'i rgyu mtshan la kha cig na re/ sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga la sogs pa rnams thabs kyis ji ltar zin kyang sbyangs 'bras su 'gyur ba mi srid de/ sol ba ji ltar brdar kyang dkar po mi 'byung ba bzhin no zhe na/ sbyang gzhi de dag snang ba ltar bden par grub na khyed bden mod kyi/ sbyang gzhi de thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pas sol ba la dkar po 'byung ba'i nus pa med pa ltar sbyang du mi rung ba ni ma yin/ des mtshon pas sbyong byed lam gyi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pas mu stegs byed pa'i lam ltar sbyang ba min/ sbyangs 'bras kyi chos rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis dag pas lus kyi dri ma bkrus pa ltar slar ldog pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar na gzhi lam 'bras kyi chos thams cad dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid du gnas pa yin la/ de yang rgyu rgyud kyi skabs su snang ba phung khams skye mched kyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa ni de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /zhes dang / phung po lnga dang dbang po lnga/ /skye mched drug dang 'byung chen lnga/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na rang bzhin gyis ma grub par rten med dam snyam na/ med pa ma yin te de snang tsam du mdangs 'gag med du sems can gyi lus zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du snang ba ni lha so so'i dag pa yin te/

de nyid las/ phyi nas so so'i dbye ba yi/ /lha rnams kyis ni brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du snang ba dang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa mi 'gal lam snyam na mi 'gal te/ zhal phyag gi rnam par snang ba de yang spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni rang rig pa'i dag pa yin te/ rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod pa gzhi lam 'bras gsum sems snang tsam gyi chos thams cad sems snang tsam du shes pa la rag las pa yin te/ rtsa shes las/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'di sgrub par byed pa la yid ches pa'i lung tshad mas bsgrub pa/ dngos po stobs shugs kyi rig pas bsgrub pa/ yang dag pa'i sngags kyi man ngag gis bsgrub pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don rnams/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /'di dag thams cad sems su btags/ /sems las ma gtogs pa nyid ni/ /gzhan na yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel las/ dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu dbye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ji ltar phyi rol na/ snang tsam thams cad nang rdo rje'i lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du tshang la/ de thams cad gsang ba sems nyid kyi steng du bag chags kyi tshul du yod pas nang gi rtsa yig tu rlung sems 'dus pa la brten nas phyi rol tu 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba yin la/

des na sems snang tsam gyi sbyang gzhi thams cad sems snang tsam gyi sbyong byed lam gyis sbyangs pa la brten nas sems snang tsam gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas rang gi sems nyid ye shes kyi ngo bor gnas 'gyur ba yin no/ /sbyang gzhi dag pa gsum ldan du gnas pa ltar sbyong byed lam gyi chos rnams kyang dag pa gsum ldan du gnas te/ thog mar rtogs pa'i lta ba ni de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ rnam pa gzugs can sbyong ba'i bskyed rim ni lha so so'i dag pa/ de thams cad rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul du rtogs pa'i thabs rdzogs rim ni rang rig pa'i dag pa yin no/ /des na sbyong byed lam gyi dag pa gsum ldan nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras sku gsum thob pa yin te/ de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa mthar phyin pa las chos sku 'grub/ lha so so'i dag pa mthar phyin pa las gzugs sku 'grub/ rang rig pa'i dag pa mthar phyin pa las ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub par byed pa yin no/ /de ltar na dag pa de ma dag pa zhig dag par byed dam/ dag zin pa zhig dag par byed/ dang po ltar na sbyang du mi rung la/ phyi ma ltar na sbyangs pa la dgos pa med dam snyam na/ rang bzhin gyis dag kyang glo bur du ma dag pa zhig dag par byed pas skyon gnyis ka las grol ba yin te/ rgyu rgyud kyi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag kyang / glo bur dri ma dang bcas pa'i dpe ni chu rnyog ma dang bcas pa'am gser g.ya' dang bcas pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar na sems la dri ma glo bur du byung na phyis sbyong byed lam gyis sbyangs pa'i rjes su'ang 'byung bar 'gyur la/ lhan cig skyes na sbyang du mi rung ngam snyam na skyon med de/ gser dang lhan cig skyes kyang g.ya' sbyang du yod pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas sems las logs su spang rgyu med pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/

dri ma de nyid ye shes kyi ngo bor gnas bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis sbyang pa yin te/ dper na nam mkha' la sprin dengs pas sprin nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na lam dus kyi dag pa gsum gyis sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo dug gsum zhi bar byed pa yin te/ de bzhin nyid du dag pas gzhi dus su lta bas kun tu brtags pa'i dug zhi bar byed/ lha so so'i dag pa bskyed rim gyis kun rtog tha mal snang zhen gyi dug zhi bar byed/ rang rig pa'i dag pa rdzogs rim gyis gya nom lhar zhen gyi dug zhi bar byed pa yin no/ /drug pa go rim nges pa ni klu sgrub yab sras dang grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru ka la sogs pas bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim sgom par bzhed/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis rgyas btab nas sgom par bzhed/ dus 'khor 'bro lugs pa rnams lo bcu gnyis bskyed rim bsgoms nas de nas rdzogs rim sgom par bzhed/ paṇa grub ga ya dhā ra thun stod bskyed rim sgom/ thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom par bzhed/ 'phags pa rin po ches las dang po pas bskyed rim gtso bor sgom la rdzogs rim cung zad sgom/ ting nge 'dzin cung zad brtan nas bskyed rdzogs cha mnyam par sgom/ ting nge 'dzin cher brtan nas bskyed rim cung zad tsam rten du byas nas rdzogs rim gtso bor sgom par bzhed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la lnga ste/ gang gis sgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas/ nam gyi tshe nyams su len pa'i dus/ ji lta bu'i bsam pas nyams su blang ba/ de ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor dngos so/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ skyes bu tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /bde gshegs bka' las mi 'da' zhing / /bla ma bsnyen bkur snying rje can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs pa/

kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang skur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don du kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'dod pa/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod pa zhig dgos te/ rje btsun gyis zhus lan gsal bar/ de tsam gyis kyang blo gros ma gang ba'i/ /blo chen sbyangs pa zab mo dag la mos/ /zhes pa nas/ de ltar snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /bskyed rim lam gyi yan lag bcas bstan nas/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa dang / bde mchog las/ sngags kyi lha ni shes nas sgom/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te gang du sgom pa'i gnas dngos dang / der spyod lam ji lta bur sgom pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la las dang po pa'i gnas/ ting nge 'dzin cung zad brtan pa'i gnas/ ting nge 'dzin cher brtan pa'i gnas dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang por goms par byed dus kyi/ /gnas ni gang du mngags pa'i sems/ /gcig tu mnyam gzhag 'grub 'gyur ba/ /gnas ni bzang po nges par brtag /rang gi khyim du/ zhes gsungs pa ltar chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bde bar sa skyong ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen chung zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa/ dben zhing yid dang mthun par rang gi sgrub khang du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa yin te/ der bsgoms pas ro la sogs pa mthong bas 'chi ba mi rtag pa gsal 'debs shing / lta ba bdag med la bogs 'don/ mi ma yin drag po rgyu bas brtson 'grus la ched du bya ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'am bas mtha' ru/ /sgom pa bzang zhes brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa cher thob pa'i gnas la gnyis te gang zag gi ngos nas bstan pa dang / lha'i ngos nas bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/

gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa phyogs med du nyul ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ snying rje chen po kye rdo rje/ /nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /mtsho skyes rnam pa'i 'gram yid 'ong / /sku gdung zab mo'i mchod rten dang / /rkang 'thung rlon pa'i 'og tu ni/ /nga ni sangs rgyas dngos grub ster/ /tshong 'dus grong rdal nyid dang ni/ /tshong 'dus rnam pa'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma brtan pa dang / bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /glu gar rab tu 'ching ba dang / /chang tshong ma yi khyim du ni/ /'di ltar pad+ma gar dbang nga / /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mgyogs 'gro bzhon gyur te/ /res 'ga' lam du 'gro ba na/ /rta ni don yod brtan pa dang / /dngos grub rdo rje rnams ster ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa der spyod lam ji lta bus sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas shing / /sa phyogs nyams dga' yid 'ong ba/ /dri zhim byugs shing me tog dgram/ /bde ba'i stan la der 'dug ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam gtan gyi khang par byi dor chag chag bya/ dri zhim po byugs shing me tog sil ma dgram/ rdo rje'i mtshan ma bris pa'i steng du rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan par gnas nas sgom la 'dug stangs kyi khyad par rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pas mtshon nas bstan pas rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par 'dug cing / 'di'i thun mong ba'i dgos pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rab bcings na/ /sems kyi dmigs pa rtse gcig 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i dgos pa ni/ khrid kyi man ngag gi skabs su shes par bya'o/ /kha lta phyogs ni/ spyir las bzhi'i dbang du byas na zhi ba shar/

rgyas pa byang / dbang nub/ drag po mngon spyod lhor lta ba yin no/ /lha'i dbang du byas na bde mchog dang 'jigs byed sogs lho/ dpal mchog nub/ rnam sras la sogs pa sgom pa byang du blta bar bshad kyang / 'dir shar la blta ste lam 'di gtso bor sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir nyams su len pa yin pas/ shar nas nyi zla la sogs pa gza' skar mang du 'char ba ltar sgrub pa po'i rgyud la rtogs pa khyad par can mang du 'char ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /gsum pa nam gyi tshe nyams su len pa'i dus la gsum las dang po las dang po pa'i dus ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan dus su zhes pa ltar mtshan mo skye bo rnams nyal ba'i dus su len pa yin te/ dus der rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du dang ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen nyung ba dang mthun rkyen mang ba yin te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ lha yang nyi ma nub pa na/ /nges par byin gyis rlabs kyi 'du/ /zhes dang / bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yul 'di dag gi bu mo gang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mtshan mo 'tshams pa dang / /rtag tu mtshan mo 'du bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sems cung zad brtan pa'i dus ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ thun gsum du byin gyis brlabs te zhes gsungs pa ltar thun gsum mam/ rdo rje gur las/ thun tshod bzhir ni byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thun bzhi'am/ sam+bu ṭir/ nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus drug tu sgom mo/ /gsum pa sems cher brtan pa'i dus ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rkang pa 'khrud dang bza' ba dang / /'thor 'thung so rtsi bza' ba dang / /tsan+dan gyis ni lag nyed dang / /smad g.yogs kyis ni sked 'gebs dang / /'byung dang smra dang 'gro ba dang / /'dug dang khro dang dgod pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das ma bsten pa dang / /shes rab brtul zhugs can nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor ma ni nges par bsgom/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar dus nges pa med par bsgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ji lta bu'i bsam pas nyams su len pa ni/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byed pa'i thabs de bsgrub par bya/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ bdag nyid 'grub pa'i sems kyis ni/ /zhes dang / 'di yis las rnams thams cad byed/ /ces dang / bsam pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /lha'i gzugs su sems pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar tshe 'di'i 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa la sogs pa dgos med kyi sems pa thams cad ring du dor/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing / rnyed dka'i dal ba yun du mi gnas pa dang / lam phyin ci ma log pa ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal ba ches cher dka' ba'i ngang tshul sems te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ bar chad 'byung ngam mi 'byung / 'grub bam mi 'grub la sogs pa'i the tshom yid gnyis log lta thams cad spangs nas sems rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /lnga pa de ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor dngos la gnyis te mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rje sa chen gyis mnyam gzhag dang rjes spyod kyi bsam gtan gnyis nang gses kyis phye nas rnal 'byor bcu gsungs pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis rtsa sngags kyi rnam bshad ltar snying po don gsal du bskyed rim cho ga'i sgo brgyad/ gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ yan lag bcu drug 'ching bzhis bsdus par bshad kyang / 'dir rje btsun rin po ches mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing du don gsum du bsdus nas gsungs pa ltar bshad na/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor/

rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag dang gsum mo/ /dang po la gsum ste rgyas pa dang / 'bring dang / bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa tshogs zhing mchod pa/ gur gyi dgongs pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ sam+bu ṭi'i dgongs pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung / rgyud gsum thun mong gi dgongs pa tshad med bzhi/ ye shes tshogs bsag srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi de nyid kyi steng nas srung 'khor bsgom pa 'dor ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bsod nams tshogs bsag tshad med bzhi bsgom pa la bsdus nas ye shes tshogs bsag stong nyid bsgom pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las dang po rgyas pa la gsum ste/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa yan lag bzhis 'ching ba/ gur gyi dgongs pa yan lag drug gis bcings pa/ sam+bu ṭi'i dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcings pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring po ni/ yan lag bzhis bcings nas mchod bstod mi byed par bzlas pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa la gnyis te/ bsdus pa'i rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa'i bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dam tshig sems dpa'i rigs bdag rang chas su bskyed nas skye mched byin rlabs mi byed par gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes pa dngos su gzhug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig sems dpa' rigs bdag rang chas can du bskyed pa tsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las dang po ni/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad tshang bar nyams su len pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi de nyid kyi steng nas khrus dang rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor dor ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor tsam la bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rje sa chen gyis mngon rtogs tshigs bcad mar/ de la mngon rtogs rnam gnyis te/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang /

/mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam bzhag bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis dang / /ma bzhag rnam pa brgyad yin te/ /nyal dang ldang dang bzlas pa dang / /khrus dang kha zas gtor ma dang / /spyod lam rjes chags rnal 'byor brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bshad na 'di la don gnyis te/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gnyis te bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ thog mar sngon du 'gro ba bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas rtsa sngags kyi bshad pa snying po rgyan las/ sdom gsum cho ga mi ldan par/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /zhes pa dang / dang po skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtag /ces gsungs pa ltar sgrub pa po'i rgyud dam tshig dang sdom par mi ldan par bskyed rdzogs kyi lam ji tsam nyams su blangs kyang ye shes mi skye bas/ rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ni mi dgos kha med kyi lam gyi gzhi chen po yin no/ /de ltar na sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i gang zag des bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nyams su len pa'i tshe rang rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum gyi nyes skyon thams cad 'dag par bya dgos la/ nyes pa chen po rnams ni slar sdom pa blang zhing phyir bcos pa'i sgo nas sbyong / thun bar gyi nyes pa phra mo rnams ni sngon 'gro 'di gsum gyis sbyong ba yin te/ de yang so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir skabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa dang / sngags kyi thun bar gyi nyes pa phra mo rnams sbyong zhing byin gyis brlab pa dang /

ltung ba chen po rnams phyir mi 'phel bar bya ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ skyabs 'gro'i rnal 'byor/ sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyud rgya gzhung las gsungs pa'i tshul/ nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa/ bye brag tu sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa yis/ /shin tu legs par sbyangs nas ni/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /bsam pa thag pas skyabs su song / /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa la bdun te/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten gyi gang zag ngos bzung ba/ rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba/ dus nam gyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba/ yul gang la skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba/ ched du bya ba gang gi phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba/ mthar dngos grub blang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang rang nyid do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'jigs pa dang / dad pa dang / snying rje'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa/ rang don yid byed kyis 'jigs pa/ tha mal snang zhen gyis 'jigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa dad pa ni skyabs yul de rnams kyis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i gnas tshul dang de las skyob pa'i thabs mkhyen pas mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ bskyab par bzhed pa'i thugs rje/ skyob par nus pa'i nus mthu gsum mthong nas dad pa'o/ /gsum pa snying rje ni/ sems can thams cad 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gnas pa la mi bzod pa'i snying brtse ba'o/

/gsum pa ni/ ji srid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ma thob bar du'o/ /bzhi pa yul ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo gtso bo he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam pa ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin/ de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes gsung rab po ti brtsegs pa'i rnam par shar ba gtso bo dang bait+ta li'i bar na bzhugs pa ni chos dkon mchog yin/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgyad cu/ rnal 'byor ma ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa/ gzhan yang sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa yan chad kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i ngo bo lha mo brgyad ni dge 'dun dkon mchog yin no/ /lnga pa tshul ji lta bus skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la 'dren pa/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs zhus nas mtho gtong dma' gtong ci mdzad khyed shes kyi tshul du skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ drug pa ched du bya ba gang gi phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'o/ /bdun pa mthar dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol dkyus bzhin brjod pas/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi ngo bo lha mo brgyad 'od zer dkar por zhu nas spyi bo nas thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo gsung rab po ti rnams 'od zer dmar por zhu nas mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo gtso bo yab yum 'od zer sngon por zhu nas snying khar thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag par byas nas rdo rje gsum mam bzhi'i go 'phang thob par bsam pa yin te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi spros med rdo rje tshig rkang las/

lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa gang / /bag la nyal dang bcas pa grol/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje rnams dang dbyer med gyur/ /ces gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa bye brag tu sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ 'di'i skabs kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ spyir ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad/ khyad par 'jig rten gyi dpon po/ lha klu bdud btsan mthu bo che dang tshangs pa dbang phyug la sogs pa skyabs su 'gro bar mi 'os pa la skyabs su song ba dang / bla ma dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa'i skyabs su 'gro bar 'os pa'i yul la skyabs su ma song zhing ma dad pa dang ma gus pa bgyis pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni sbyong byed kyi lam/ de gnyis dbyer med du nyams su len pa ni skyabs 'gro 'khor 'das dbyer med yin la/ de'i don sbyang gzhi de dag skyabs 'gro byed mkhan sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi rgyud sems nyid skad cig ma gcig gi rnam 'phrul du shes par byas/ de nyid gsal rig tsam du gtan la phab nas de nyid kyi ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du sgom pa de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du rig pa mdangs 'gag med du skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro ba po/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul rnams gsal btab ste zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur la/ /zhes sogs dang / rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyi srid pa dag /ces dang / 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /ces dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i man ngag las/ skyon yon tan du blang ba'i gdam ngag bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdam ngag ces gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor la gsum ste/

rgyud rgya gzhung nas bshad tshul/ nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos/ bye brag tu sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ byang chub sems kyis rnam par sbyang / /zhes dang / snying rjes sems can don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu snying rje ltung bar bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ bdag gis byang chub thob phyir dang / /gang phyir gzhan dag bsgral ba'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /zhes dang / sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las/ de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /ma bskyed pa rnams bskyed bya zhing / /bskyed pa slar yang dran du gzhug /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rang gi pha ma ma byas pa med cing / de yang lan gcig min par lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas shing / pha ma nam byas res kyis phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas 'di rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba snying rje snyam pa yang yang du bsgom pa'o/ /'di lta bu sngon du ma song na sems bskyed rnal ma mi skye ste/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /des na rgyu snying rje chen po sngon du song nas 'bras bu sems bskyed pa dngos ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ thob nas kyang sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i phyir du 'di lta bu'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du bsgom mo/ /de'i dang po smon pa sems bskyed/ phyi ma 'jug pa sems bskyed yin la/ de yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems thams cad smon 'jug gnyis su 'dus pa yin te/

spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems ni mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i skabs kyi ngag 'don gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha che paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga las 'byung ba 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod ma dang / gnyis pa ni/ chos bzhi ston pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma dang / gsum pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du kyai rdo rje'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang gsum las/ dang po gnyis ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'brel ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ phyi ma ni skyabs 'gro sngon du song nas sems bskyed kho na len pa la tshig gtsang zhing bla ma gong ma rnams kyis phyag len yang mdzad pas phyi ma 'di gtso bor gzung ngo / /gsum pa bye brag tu sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ 'di'i skabs kyi spyir btang gi sbyang gzhi ni sngar dang 'dra la/ khyad par gyi sbyang gzhi ni tshe thog ma med pa nas gzhan la bsam ngan bsgoms pa dang / sems bskyed par mi 'os pa bskyed pa dang / bskyed par 'os pa ma bskyed pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad ni sbyang gzhi 'khor ba yin la/ sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ni sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa yin cing / de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa ni sems bskyed 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor la bzhi ste/ lha sgom pa/ sngags bzlas ba/ bshags sdom bya ba/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bsgom bya'i lha rgyud las bstan tshul/
