bstan pa'i lha gnas gang du sgom pa/ der bsgoms nas sdig sgrib sbyong tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'am a bhi dha nar grags pa'i rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /zhes dang / zla ba'i 'od dang 'dra ba'i mdog /zhes dang / rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa/ /ces dang / sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dbus gnas pa/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag tu bzhugs/ /thams cad ral pa'i cod pan can/ /thod pa'i phreng ba de bzhin no/ /thams cad phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo bsgyur drug lhan cig tu/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma 'das bya/ /zhes pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka yab yum sgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha cig rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ru bsgom pa dang / spyi bor sgom pa dang / kha cig snying gar sgom par bzhed kyang 'dir/ a bhi dha na las/ phyi dang nang gi chu khrus bya/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don spyi bor bsgom par bzhed/ gsum pa ni a bhi dha na las/ mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad snying khar brtan byas te/ /bsgoms la thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad spyan drangs shing / 'dren tshul la lha'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / yig 'bru'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang gsum las 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ de yang bdud rtsi kha dog dkar po la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa spyan drangs/ he ru ka yab yum gyi sku zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsgom/ bdud rtsi 'bab tshul la kha cig he ru ka yab yum gyi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'bab par bzhed/ kha cig rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las 'bab par bzhed kyang /

'dir a bhi dha na las/ phyi dang nang gi chu khrus bya/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/ /ces pa'i don yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas 'bab par bzhed/ babs nas sdig sgrib sbyong tshul la thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs kyi dkyus na bzhugs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ a bhi dha na las/ dus bzhi dag gi rim pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa 'khor lo'i gnas su bdud rtsi byon pas dbang bzhi thob par bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngags bzlas pa la lnga ste bzla ba'i dus/ bzlas pa'i grangs/ bzlas pa'i dgos pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi snying bo yin tshul/ bzla bya'i sngags kyi don dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ a bhi dha na las/ thog ma bar dang tha mar ni/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma'i/ /'khor lo dag ni brtan bya'i phyir/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags bzla/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thog mar rgyud sbyang ba'i phyir bzla ba/ bar du lha byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir bzla ba/ tha mar lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir bzla ba dang gsum las/ 'dir dang po nyid gtso bor bzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ /zhes dang / 'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa bzlas pa'i dgos pa ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ ltung sogs byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/ /zhes dang / rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes dang / a bhi dha na las/ gang du dam tshig nyams pa la/ /sbyor ba 'di ni sbyin par bya/ /zhi bar gyur na bla med pa/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi snying po yin tshul ni/

sam+bu ṭa dang a bhi dha na las/ dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /'di ni kun gyi sngags yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / lha rdo rje sems dpa' de yang sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig po/ /pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /ces gsungs so/ /lnga pa bzla bya'i sngags don dngos bshad pa ni/ oṃ ni rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ yi ge oṃ ni ci yin brjod/ /mchog dang nor ster dpal dang dbyangs/ /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis brjod/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don brgyad la 'jug kyang 'dir mchog gi dngos grub ster ba la sbyor/ shrī ni a bhi dha na'i dngos bstan la med kyang / thams cad gsang ba las/ rdo rje slob dpon gang gang gis/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang gang la/ /dpal ni nges par sbyor bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'phags pa rin po ches bcug pa ltar na dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /badz+ra he ru ka ni rdo rje khrag 'thung / sa ma ya dam tshig ma nu pā la ya bdag rjes su skyongs shig gang gis na rang bzhin nges don gyi he ru kas skyong ba'o/ /tshul ji ltar na he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha khrag 'thung bdag la nye bar mnos pa de rang gi bsam pa bzhin du'o/ /gang bsam na ḍi dho me bha wa bdag la brtan pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su to ṭh+yo me bha wa bdag la dga' ba'i rang bzhin du'o/ /a nu rak+to me bha wa bdag la rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su po ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag la mdzes pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha ni bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol cig sarba kar+m+ma su tsa me ni bdag la las thams cad stsol ces pa'o/ /bskyangs nas ci byed na tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/ gang gnas na hūm̐ ni 'gyur ba med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/

ha bzhi ni ye shes gzhan bzhi/ ho ni dbyer med pa/ mdor na dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i nges don gyi he ru ka bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/ de la tha snyad du mtshan ci zhig brjod na/ bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bya/ des bdag ni nam yang gtong bar ma mdzad ces gsol ba ni ma me muñtsa bdag ma gtong zhig ces pa'o/ /he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa khrag 'thung gi rang bzhin dam tshig gi sems dpa' chen po zhes ched du 'bod pa'o/ /a ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pas chos thams cad kyi sgo ste lha dang sngags dang sgrub pa po rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa'o/ /hūm̐ ni don lnga la 'jug pa las 'dir spang bya 'joms pa la sbyor/ phaṭ ni don gsum la 'jug pa las 'dir nyes pa dag pa'am zhig pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ a bhi dha na las 'byung ba ni/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa bstan/ de'i rjes su 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs lhug pa'i don/ sngags kyi dam tshig thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu 'dus pa'am/ yang na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig tu 'dus pa yin te/ sdig pa ni nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa/ sgrib pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyes pa ni rang bzhin gyi nyes pa/ ltung ba ni bcas pa'i ltung ba/ dri ma ni gnas kyi dri ma la sogs pa drug go /bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ spyir nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad/ khyad par du sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa thams cad ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin no/ /sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed de'i ngo bor snang ba bsgyur nas nyams su len pa ni sbyong tshul 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no/

/gsum pa de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sdom pa gsum gyi nyes pa phra mo sbyangs nas/ rang rgyud kyi sdom gsum yongs su dag par byas pa la ni dgos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de/ bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes dang / skyabs gsum bdun cu pa las/ gsum la skyabs 'gro dge bsnyen ni/ /de ni sdom brgyad rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur nas skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'os/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pas/ /dngos grub la ni dogs med de/ /ston pa sangs rgyas sogs bstod cing / /lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bkur/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las dgos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la gsum ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ yul dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag pa/ yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag pa/ zhar byung de dag gi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gang gis tshogs bsag pa'i rten/ gang la tshogs bsag pa'i yul/ ji ltar tshogs bsag pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ lus byin gyis brlab pa/ yid byin gyis brlab pa/ de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dir kha cig sku rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis par sgom pa mdzad pa ni shes byed dang 'brel ci yang med do/ /des na rang lugs la snying po kyai rdo rje yin la/ de la rgyas pa zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug gi nang du srog chags sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/

'bring po phyag drug pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bsdus pa phyag gnyis pa ste/ slob dpon gar pa ri pa'i sgrub thabs dang / gzhung bshad sras don ma gnyis las/ phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin par bshad/ lam dus kyi dbang chog tu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par bshad pa'o/ /des na skabs 'dir zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa rgyas pa nyid lam 'di'i bsgrub bya'i gtso bor ston pa yin pas/ de bsgrub pa la ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor gyi bar du 'di nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis nyams su len dgos shing skabs 'dir sbyar ba ni shin tu 'brel chags pa yin no/ /rtsa rgyud las/ yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni myur bar 'grub/ /ces pa dang / slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang pos skabs 'dir/ zhal brgyad nga rgyal bdag bsgom ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su las bsog pa'i rten rigs drug gi lus ji snyed cig blangs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na las bsog pa'i rten rigs drug gi lus ji snyed cig len par 'gyur ba dang / da ltar gyi las bsog pa'i rten ma dag pa'i lus kyi snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa 'di nyid sbyong byed kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur nas lam byed rnam bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rang gi snying gar re pha sgom/ /de las byung ba'i nyi dkyil 'khor/ /der ni hūm̐ gi rnam pa nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan la nyi ma rkyang pa'i steng du hūm̐ bsgom par bshad pas yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs la de ltar mdzad/ yan lag drug pa'i phyogs la ḍoṃ bhi pas/

paṃ pad raṃ nyi gzhal med las/ /zhes dang / slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis/ paṃ dang raṃ las gsal bar ni/ /pad+ma nyi ma dmar por sgom/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar paṃ la pad+ma/ de yang lha dbang du bsdus pa mtshon pas kha dog dmar po/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ gang du sgom pa'i gnas ni rang gi snying kha ste lus kyi dbus nu ma gnyis kyi bar thad rgal tshigs la cung nye ba'i gnas su bsgom mo/ /de yang hūm̐ gis gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i don ni/ hūm̐/ yi ge kha phral nas bshad na ha'i sgra la gra ha ka bzung ba/ gra ha tsa 'dzin pa/ zhabs kyu u la rkyen sha byin pas shu n+ya ta stong pa/ klad kor ma ni ma nu ta ste yid/ de ltar na gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i yid ces pa'i don no/ /sbyang gzhi rang gi sems kun gzhi/ de las 'phros pa'i sems byung gi rgyu ba sna tshogs pa bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed kyai rdo rje'i thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam pa hūm̐ yig cha lnga pa'i rang bzhin du gyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhis nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos tha mal rnam rtog blo bzlog dang / /bar chad bgegs las bsrung ba dang / /lha yis lha la tshogs bsags pas/ /tshogs myur rdzogs pa'i dgos pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa gang la tshogs bsag pa'i yul ni ci'i phyir tshogs zhing zhes bya snyam na/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du zhing las lo thog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba ltar/ yul de la brten nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i lo thog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i zhing yin pas na de ltar brjod pa yin la/ des na 'di la gsum ste gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa/ gang spyan 'dren pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ting nge 'dzin dang /

sngags dang / phyag rgya'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar byas/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig tu 'od zer sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ tshogs zhing rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu 'od zer sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ bar du gnas pa dang mnyam du 'od zer rnams snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam mo/ /'od zer kha dog ni rtsa rgyud dbang gi le'u las/ sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis phyung nas/ zhes gsungs pas yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs la de ltar mdzad/ 'dir sam+bu ṭi las/ rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /steng gi sgor ni g.yo zhing gnas/ /de yi 'og tu rnam par gnas/ /gzhug cing gshegs su gsol ba nyid/ /ces pa'i don 'od zer kha dog sna lnga rtse mo lcags kyu'i rnam par bzhed do/ /de yang hūm̐ gis rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / 'od zer spros pas ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs mtshon no/ /'od zer kha dog sna lngas rang gi rnam par shes pa'i bzhon par gyur pa'i 'byung ba lnga'i rlung sbyong / spro bsdus las rlung ldang 'jug gnas gsum sbyong / gnyis pa sngags ni rdo rje gur las oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa oṃ mchog ste/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ sa mā dza ni 'dus zhes pa'i don no/ /yo ga de nyid 'dus pa las/ sa ma ya dzaḥzhes pa ltar na/ sa ma ya dam tshig dzaḥbyon ces pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa phyag rgya ni/ slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i gur 'grel las/ rdo rje se gol sbyar ba yi/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /gnyis pa gang nas spyan 'dren pa la longs sku'i zhing khams dang sprul sku'i zhing khams rnams nas spyan 'dren par bshad pa yod kyang /

'dir rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes gsungs pa'i don/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku spros bral du bzhugs pa 'od zer des bskul bas/ sangs rgyas rnams gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'am/ yang na nam mkhar bzhugs pa la rang gi sgrib pas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba 'od zer des sgrib pa rnams bsal nas mthong bar byas pa tsam la spyan 'dren par bzhed do/ /gsum pa gang spyan 'dren pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pas bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad du gsungs kyang / rdo rje gur las/ bla ma sangs rgyas rnams mchod cing / /zhes bla ma dang yi dam tha dad du gsungs/ de yang rje sa chen gyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni shar gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma bzhugs pa spyan 'dren pa tsam bshad/ rje btsun gyis pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du lha dgu'i gtso bo'i gtsug tu ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i ched du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas bzhugs pa la spyan 'dren pa tsam bshad pas 'dir de ltar du bzhed pa'o/ /sbyang gzhi rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su ma dag pa'i las gsog pa'i yul gyi snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed kyai rdo rje lha dgu bla ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas nyams su len pa'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar tshogs bsag pa'i tshul la lnga ste/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa dbul ba/ rgyun bshags bya ba/ sdom pa gzung ba/ gnang ba nod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste rgyud rgya gzhung las bshad tshul/ gsungs pa'i don dngos bshad pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sam+bu ṭi las/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod nas 'di skad gsol/ /zhes dang / ḍom+bhi pa'i yum gyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od las/ mnga' bdag dbang sogs dmigs nas ni/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni mchod par bya/ /zhes sogs dang /

rje btsun gyis mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing dang yum gyi sgrub thabs rnams su gsal bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gang gis phyag 'tshal ba/ gang la phyag 'tshal ba/ ji ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i kye rdo rje bla ma dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa la gsum te/ ting nge 'dzin dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya'o/ /dang po ni/ tshogs zhing de rnams kyi yon tan mthong nas dad pa shugs byung gis kun nas bslangs te sems rtse gcig pas 'dud do/ /sngags ni na mo ni phyag 'tshal ba/ gu ru ni bla ma/ bh+yaḥni rnams so/ /yang na mo ni phyag 'tshal la/ shrī he badz+ra ni dpal kye rdo rje/ maṇ+ḍal ni dkyil 'khor/ bh+yaḥni rnams so/ /gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo ste/ sor mo bcu ni rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung bcu mtshon/ de nyid sbyar ba'i rdo rje'i sor mo ni las kyi rlung bcu dbu mar tshud nas rang rgyud la zung 'jug gi rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba mtshon/ gsum pa sbyang gzhi ni rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su phyag 'tshal bar mi 'os pa rnams la 'tshal ba dang / 'tshal bar 'os pa rnams la ma btsal ba la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dad pa shugs byung gis kun nas bslangs te/ sgo gsum gyi phyag tu bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchod pa dbul ba la gsum ste rgyud rgya gzhung las gsungs tshul/ gsungs pa'i don dngos bshad pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pa'i bar dang / rdo rje gur nas/ bla ma rdo rje can mchod cing / /zhes dang / sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ /gtso bo nas brtsams rim bzhin mchod/

/ces sogs gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de'i dngos bshad pa la gsum/ gang gis mchod pa/ gang la mchod pa/ ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /zhes pa'i don chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i rnam 'phrul gzugs kyi skur ston pa mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su kye rdo rje lha dgu bla ma dang bcas pa la'o/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu pa'o/ /dang po ni rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ phyi'i mchod pa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan te/ lha mo dkar mo ni gau rī ste/ phyag na ri dwags kyi mtshan ma zla ba'i brdas bstan pa ste byang sems dkar pos gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo chom rkun ma tsau rī ste phyag na bdud las rgyal ba nyi ma'i brdas bstan pa rak+tas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs ma ni bait+ta li ste dri chus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ghasma ri ni phyag na gsang ba'i sman 'dzin pa ste dri chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /puk+ka si ni phyag na rdo rje ste sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan te/ ri khrod ma ni phyag na ro ste bcud len grub pa'i dngul chus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bcud len ni sngon bskal pa bzang po'i dus su yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems lus la reg na skra dkar dang gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing / btung na tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa zhig la zer ro/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u ste skyes pho mo'i thod pa ltag sprod la mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa'i rnga'u chung brdung ba'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas bstan te lha mo g.yung mo ni rlung mtshams kyi grwar gnas nas 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byas pas lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud zag med ye shes kyi bde bas tshim pa'o/ /yang na g.yung mo rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma la thim nas lha thams cad rjes su chags pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam mo/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /ces pas bstan to/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ni rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su mchod par 'os pa la ma mchod pa dang / mi shes pa'i dbang gis mchod par mi 'os pa la mchod pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong byed/ skabs 'dir mchod pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa rgyun bshags bya ba la bzhi ste/ rgyud nas bstan tshul/ de'i don bshad pa/ de la cung zad dogs pa dpyad pa/ de'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bdun po yongs su 'dag par bya/ /zhes pas mdor bstan/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bstan to/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyi don yan lag bdun pa bstan te/ de yang tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis bshags pa'i yan lag bstan la/ de la stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras las skyob par nus pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo tshogs zhing lha dgu bla ma dang bcas pa ni rten gyi stobs yin te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /ces pas bstan/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la khog tu dug btungs pa lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po byed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid do snyam pa'i bshags pa byed pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/

sdig pa dag par nges shes bskyed cing dga' ba khyad par can sgom pa ni sor chud pa'i stobs te/ gsum po de tshig rkang phyi ma'i dngos shugs ci rigs pas bstan to/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gis rjes su yi rangs ba'i yan lag bstan te/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i dge rtsa la phrag dog mi byed cing rjes su yi rangs pa sgom pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gis don dam sems bskyed kyi yan lag bstan te gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems/ /bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs pas/ /rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid can/ /zhes gsungs pas stong nyid spros bral gyi ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro'i yan lag bstan te/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro /nges 'byung gi skyabs 'gro/ khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro dang bzhi las 'dir phyi ma nyid yin no/ /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis smon pa sems bskyed kyi yan lag bstan te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du nges par 'thob par bya'o snyam du bsgom pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la slob cing / khyad par du rim pa gnyis la nan tan du bgyid snyam du bsgom mo/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gis bsngo ba'i yan lag bstan te/ tshogs bsags pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas par bsngo bar bya'o snyam du bsgom mo/ /'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum du phye na/ dang po la gnyis te 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyong ba dang / mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa'o/ /de'i dang po ni/

dkon mchog gsum la zhes pas sdig bshags/ 'gro ba'i dge zhes pas yi rangs/ dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ yan lag phyi ma bzhi'o/ /rjes ni/ 'gro la zhes pas bsngo ba/ de dag gi don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dir bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang / bzang spyod nas bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la/ kha cig yan lag bdun pa la gnyis las 'dir bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa ni longs sku'i spyan sngar byed pa yin te/ longs sku ni nges par lnga ldan yin pas chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs mi dgos so/ /sprul sku ni gzhan snang la chos kyi 'khor lo mi skor ba dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pas phyi ma ni de'i spyan sngar byed pa yin no zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ rje btsun rin po ches tshogs zhing de rnams sprul pa mchog gi rnam par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rang lugs kyi mdo sngags so so'i nang nas bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par tsam la bzhed do/ /bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i nyes pa chen po dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la phrag dog dang bar chad bgyis pa dang / gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu bzung ba dang / skyabs dam pa ma bsten pa dang / gzhan don du sems ma bskyed pa dang / sbyor ba phyin ci log tu bstan pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsngos pa dang / bsngos kyang phyin ci log pa dang / dman par bsngos pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed yan lag bdun pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /bzhi pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sam+bu ṭi las 'byung ba'i rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi steng du sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las byung ba'i tshig rkang drug gi kha skong ba dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/

/de'i don bshad pa la bzhi ste/ gang la gzung ba'i yul/ gang gis gzung ba'i rten gyi gang zag dus ji tsam gyi bar gzung ba/ ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs tshig gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas tshig gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ji ltar sdom pa gzung ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa bzung ba/ so so'i sdom pa bzung ba/ don bsdus te dam bca' ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis smon pa sems bskyed bstan/ de nas/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan la/ de yang rang gis khas blangs pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi spang bya thams cad spong ba ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / lam rim pa gnyis la nan tan du slob pa ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ bsdu dngos bzhi dang 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka lngas rim pa bzhin du bstan/ de yang sh+lo ka dang pos phyi brda'i dkon mchog gsum/ nang don gyi dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam par snang mdzad ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin cing / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba yang sdom pa'i tshul khrims thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig de gsum ston pa'i slob dpon dang bcas pa bzhi po bzung ba ni mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu bstan la/

de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi rnam g.yeng yin la de ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong dgos shing / de bzhi sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin la/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sbyang gzhi ser sna yin la/ de sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis phyi bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud/ theg pa gsum ste nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams te mdor na dam pa'i chos ma lus pa bzung ba ni 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu bstan la/ der de 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'od dpag med ni gsung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin zhing / dam pa'i chos kyang gsung gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba dang / mchod pa'i las ci nus byed pa ni don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu bstan pa yin la/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ don yod grub pa ni phrin las kyi ngo bo brtson 'grus yin zhing / las de rnams brtson 'grus la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa don bsdus te dam bca' ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba ni sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstan te/ de yang sh+lau ka dang po'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis smon pa dang / tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis kyis 'jug pa sems bskyed mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bstan pa yin no/ /sh+lau ka phyi ma'i don ni nyan rang shes bya'i sgrib pa las ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / tshangs pa dang brgya sbyin la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang /

ngan song gsum gyi sems can dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / mthar sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la dgod par bya ba'am/ yang na rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa las ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbyung ba'o/ /sbyang gzhi ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa ma bzung ba/ bzung yang de las nyams pa'i snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed sdom bzung gi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /lnga pa gnang ba nod pa ni/ tshogs zhing de rnams kyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod gnas pa 'di la legs par gnas na tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur bas lam rim pa gnyis sgoms shig ces gsungs shing rang nyid kyis kyang de ltar du khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de nas tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa dang / mi dmigs par bya ba dang / rang nyid la bstim pa dang gsum las 'dir bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'brel du phyi ma nyid phyag len mdzad do/ /gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsag pa la gsum ste/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i don bshad pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang por byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa snying rje rnam bsgom zhing / gsum pa dga' ba bsgom pa dang / /kun gyi mthar ni btang snyoms so/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yis/ /sems kyi ngal ni gso bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la pha rol tu phyin pa dang thun mong du sgom tshul dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgom tshul dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/

dngos bstan gyi tshig don bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pa'i sna las lha mo puk+ka sī 'od zer sngon po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu bcas dang ldan par byas/ byams pa tshad med kyi ngo bo lha mo puk+ka sī ste sbos mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin du rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sna la lha mo ri khrod ma 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dang bral bar byas nas snying rje tshad med kyi ngo bo sha ba rī ste ri khrod ma'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin du rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sna las lha mo gdol pa mo 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dang bral bar byas nas bde ba rgyu bcas dang mi 'bral bar byas/ dga' ba tshad med kyi ngo bo gdol pa mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin tu rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs pa spros pa'i sna las lha mo g.yung mo 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa dang ldan par byas/ btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngo bo g.yung mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha mo mi spro bar 'od zer spro ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyang gzhi mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag sbyong byed tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor bsgyur nas sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i lha mo bzhis rgyas btab nas nyams su len pa'o/ /tshad med bzhi la yang 'jig rten pa'i/ nyan thos kyi/ theg chen thun mong ba/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad med bzhi dang bzhi las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid gtso bor bzung ba'o/

/tshad med ces pa'i don yul tshad med la blo tshad med kyis ngo bo tshad med bzhi sgom pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i gnas zhes pa'i don ni/ de bsgoms pa la brten nas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu lha tshangs pa la sogs pa'i mtho ris kyi rten 'thob pa dang / mthar thug gi tshangs pa sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas so/ /gsum pa de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar bsod nams tshogs bsags pa'i/ /dgos pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rgyud dag pa yi dgos pa dang / /sngon gyi rgyal dang mtshungs bya 'o/ /zhes bya ba ltar zas bzang po blug pa'i sngon du snod dag par bya dgos pa bzhin/ dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis sgom pa la/ sngon 'gro rgyu dag par bya dgos pa dang / sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas gzugs sku thob pa ltar/ rang nyid kyis gzugs sku thob pa la'ang bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa la rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bshad pa/ de'i dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yang ni stong pa byang chub sems/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ byang chub sems kyis rnam par sbyang / /zhes dang / bden dang rdzun par bcas pa yi/ /rtog pas nye bar ma gos pa/ /ma skyes pa yi sbyor ba las/ /skye ba 'dir ni rab tu brjod/ /ces dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ dang por stong nyid bsams nas ni/ /lus can rnams kyi dri ma bkru/ /zhes dang / phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ don dngos bshad pa dang / de sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ ye shes tshogs bsag gi skabs 'dir snang la rang bzhin med par sgom pa dang / snang med du sgom pa gnyis las 'dir snang med du sgom pa yin te/ rje sa chen gyis/

gang zag bdag sogs thams cad kyis/ /mi dmigs cang med stong par sgom/ /zhes dang / rtse mos snang la rang bzhin med par sgom pa dang / snang med du sgom pa gnyis las 'dir snang med du sgom pa'i lugs so zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de la'ang gang zag stong pa nyid la goms 'dris che chung gis stong nyid btsan thabs su sgom pa dang / bshig ste sgom pa gnyis las 'dir dang po yin te/ rje sa chen gyis/ de nas ye shes tshogs bsag ni/ /btsan thabs stong nyid bsgom bya ste/ /sngags ni yid la dran stobs kyis/ /zhes dang / rje btsun rtse mos dang por sngags brjod de/ de'i don dran pas stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyi ma bshig nas sgom tshul la ngor chen gyis gnad kyi zla zer du/ gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med sgom tshul gnyis/ de re re la dgag gzhi bdag ngos bzung ba dang / de 'gog byed kyi rigs pa bshad pa/ bdag med kyi don la blo 'jog pa'i tshul te don gsum gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs par mdzad la/ rtse mos gcig dang du bral gyi rigs pas stong nyid du gtan la 'bebs par mdzad/ rje btsun gyis snang ba sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa gsum gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs par mdzad do/ /kha cig snang med du bsgoms pas snang ba rgyun chad pas chad pa'i lta bar mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ mi 'gyur te ma dag pa'i snang ba rags pa tsam bkag nas sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong zung 'jug tu mnyam par bzhag pas gong gi skyon las grol lo/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ oṃ shu n+ya ta zhes pa'i oṃ ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ shu n+ya ta ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ dz+nyā na ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ badz+ra ni bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes/ swa bhā wa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ āt+ma ko3 ham̐ zhes pa ni nga'o/

/yang na oṃ ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/ shu n+ya ta ni yul rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ dz+nyā na yul can rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ at+ma ko3 ham̐ nga'o zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa ni sbyang gzhi rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng na sngar shi ba/ ma 'ongs pa na 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i bag chags ji snyed pa dang / de bzhin du snod kyi 'jig rten sngar zhig pa dang ma 'ongs pa na 'jig par 'gyur ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed ye shes tshogs bsag gi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras chos sku 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ye shes tshogs bsag gis 'chi srid sbyong ba'i tshul 'di ni mi g.yo bla med kyi rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa'i lugs srol gcig yin la/ yang ye shes tshogs bsag 'di nyid 'chi srid sbyong byed du ma sbyar bar las nyon gyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gtso bor sbyong byed du sbyor ba yang bla ma gong ma dag gi bzhed pa lugs gcig tu snang bas/ lugs gnyis ka tshad ldan re re yin par bdag gi bla mas gsungs so/ /gsum pa dgos pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ ye shes tshogs bsag byas pa yi/ /dgos pa rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /kun brtags pa yi dri ma las/ /dag par bya ba'i dgos pa dang / /gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /lha yi myu gu bskyed pa dang / /gsum pa bsod nams tshogs dang ni/ /ye shes tshogs su 'brel phyir dang / /bzhi pa chos kyi sku las ni/ /gzugs sku 'grub par bya phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang / /jo bo rjes dgos pa drug tu gsungs te stong nyid ma rtogs pa rtogs pa dang / brjed pa dran pa gso ba dang / ma brjed pa gong nas gong du rgyas pa dang / bden zhen 'gog pa dang / chos sku 'grub pa dang / gzugs sku sgyu mar 'char ba dang drug go /gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa ni/

grub chen ḍoṃ bhi pas/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du rnam sgom sngon gyi ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni smon lam rjes su dran byas nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kun btags sbyong byed de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa ye shes tshogs bsag 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang las sngon gyi snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis kun rtog sbyong byed lha so so'i dag par ldang ba'i thog mar srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa yin la/ de la gsum ste thun mong pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyud las gsungs tshul/ gsungs pa'i don bshad pa/ de sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ re phas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas/ /nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyi ni rwa ba dang / /gur bcings pa yang rnam par bsgom pa nyid/ /ces dang gur las/ de rjes srung ba'i dam tshig mchog /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don bshad pa la gsum ste/ srung 'khor gang las 'phro ba'i gzhi/ de las spros pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dngos/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan mtsho skyes lugs dang / man ngag lugs kyi yan lag bzhi pa'i skabs su nyi ma rkyang pa bsgom par bshad kyang / ḍom+bhi ba'i lugs dang 'dir yan lag drug pa'i skabs su paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ rwa rnams phyogs mdog can/ lte ba gru bzhi mthing nag la kun gzhi'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa'i don ni kha dog sna tshogs su yod pa dang / 'od zer sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang / phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa dang / phyogs bcur rwa sna tshogs gyes pa'i phyir ro/

/de yang rtse mos rten 'brel bcu gnyis mtshon pas na rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis su bzhed kyang / 'dir rje btsun gyis 'jigs tshogs lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms par byed pa mtshon pas rwa nyi shu par bzhed pas de ltar du mdzad do/ /gnyis pa de las spros pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dngos la kha cig sna tshogs rdo rje rkyang pa zhu ba las bsgom par bzhed/ kha cig sna tshogs rdo rje nyi ma dang bcas pa zhu ba las bsgom par bzhed/ kha cig sna tshogs rdo rje las rdo rje spro ba bsgom par bzhed kyang / 'dir sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po 'og tu 'phros pa las 'og thams cad rdo rje nag po'i sa gzhi nas thang brdal ba lta bu dang / phyogs mtshams su 'phros pas rdo rje nag po'i rtsig pa bar med pa'i rwa ba zlum po/ steng du 'phros pas rwa ba'i nang du rdo rje nag po'i gur rmog kha sbub pa lta bu'i rtse mor khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa kha gdengs pas mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me phung kha dog sna lnga pa g.yas skor du 'ur sgra dang bcas nas 'bar bar bsam/ de'i tshad ni dag pa rdo rje sgron me las/ srid pa'i rtse mo nas 'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar bsgom pa dang / gnyis med rdo rjes sa gzhi la thug gi bar du bsgom pa dang / mtshams rdo rjes blo la ji ltar 'tshams pa bsgom pa dang gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma dang mthun pas che ba ni tshad med/ chung ba ni dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam bsgom pa yin te rigs pas shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten dang / rang gi chos sgrub pa'i bgegs dang bar chad la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed ye shes lnga'i ngo bo srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas bsgoms pas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang /

mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'tshang rgya ba'i srod la bdud 'dul ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /zhib tu na phyi'i bar chad gdon lnga/ nang gi bar chad nad lnga/ gsang ba'i bar chad nyon mongs pa dug lnga la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rang gi sems nyid skad cig ma gcig gi rnam sprul du shes par byas nas/ rang nyid ye shes lnga'i ngo bo srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor du sgyur nas nyams su len pa yin te srung 'khor 'khor 'das dbyer med do/ /bar chad dngos grub du len pa'i gdam ngag ces bya'o/ /gsum pa sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las gsung ba'i sngags lan gsum brjod do/ /de'i don ni oṃ ni dpal te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ rak+ṣa ni srungs shig gang bsrung na hūm̐ gsum gyis mtshon pa/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor ram/ yang na rang gi lus ngag yid gsum mo/ /rdo rje gur las/ dam tshig rdo rje bsrung don du/ /sbas pa'i spyod yul 'di gsungs pa/ /zhes pa'i don thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo la gnyis te khro bo bcu so so'i mngon rtogs dang / khro bo bcu yongs rdzogs kyi mngon rtogs gnyis kyi phyi ma la gnyis te/ bdag bsrung ba dang / gnod pa phyir bzlog pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khor lo'i dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad du bsgom/ gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba steng du bsgom/ khro bo gzhan rnams zhal nang du gzigs/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba la me 'bar bas dgra bgegs bsregs pas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam/ sngags gzhan mi bzla bar rak+ṣa lan gsum gyis brtan par byed pa tsam mo/ /gnyis pa gnod pa phyir bzlog pa la gsum ste rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la lnga ste gnas gang du sgom pa/ gdan gang gi steng du sgom pa/ sa bon gang las bskyed pa/ ngo bo gang bskyed pa/

de sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sngar gyi srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sprul gzhir gyur pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje nyi ma bsgom bya ste/ /de yi 'og tu pad+ma bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du sgom pa yin te/ de'ang sa bon paṃ dang raṃ las bskyed de ḍom+bhi pas/ paṃ ser po las sna tshogs pad+ma/ raṃ nyi ma'i steng du ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bh+rūm̐ las bskyed de/ ḍom+bhi pas/ bh+rūm̐ ser po las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ zhes dang / mi thub zla bas/ der ni bh+rūm̐ yig las byung ba'i/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa la kha dog bshad pa/ dbyibs bshad pa/ tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes thig le las/ rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du ni/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bzhi pa ni/ /rtsibs bcu pa la gser gyi mdog /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo ste lte ba gsum cha/ de nas gsum cha rtsibs kyi sbom sa/ de nas rtsibs kyi rtse mo rno ba/ de yang dang po gnyis khog stong / phyi ma rtse mo shin tu rno ba ral gri so gnyis ma lta bu ste/ nā ro pa'i zhal lung las/ khog stong mi g.yo rab tu 'khor/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa tshad ni rdo rje gur las dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa de sngags kyis byin gyis brlab pa ni oṃ ni sngar dang 'dra la/ badz+ra rdo rje ste/ tsakra 'khor lo/ rak+ṣa bsrung ba/ hūm̐ gnyis bdag dang bsrung bya gzhan/ bh+rūm̐ ni dgra'i stobs 'phrog pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa bskyed pa la bzhi ste/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag skye mched dam sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag

ye shes pa dgug cing gzhug pa bsgrub pa'i yan lag dbang bskur zhing rgyas 'debs pa bsgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /dang po la gsum ste/ gnas gang du bskyed pa/ sa bon gang las bskyed pa/ de ltar bskyed pa'i lha'i ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khor lo'i lte bar steng 'og bar gsum dang / lte ba dang rtsibs kyi rtse mo'i bar 'og phyogs mu khyud la cung zad ma reg pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ hūm̐ ni bcu yi sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo bcu ni rim bzhin dgod/ /ces gsungs pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo bcu'i sa bon bstan/ gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba sa bon gang las bskyed snyam na/ ḍom+bhi pas/ bh+rūm̐ ser po las gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes gsungs pas bh+rūm̐ las bskyed de/ de'i don bh+rūm̐ la yi ge kha phral nas bshad na/ ba la la byin pas ba la stobs/ ha la ra byin pas ha ra 'phrog pa/ klad kor ma la ra byin pas ma ra dgra bo ste dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog pa zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa de ltar bskyed pa'i lha'i ngo bo bshad pa la phal cher sgrub thabs dkyus bzhin las zhal phyag dang phyag mtshan gyi khyad par ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje khro bo skyes bu che/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /snying khar mnan pa'i khu tshur mdzub/ /g.yas pa rang gi mtshon cha 'phyar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje gur las/ dbang po sngon po'i rnam pa ltar/ /gshin rje gshed ni rnam par bsam/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rdo rje ste/ /'jigs med zla ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /pad+ma'i khro bo dmar po che/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid gnag /mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing / /zhes gsungs so/ /ḍom+bhi pas dbus su gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser po/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad/ /'og tu sum+bhi'i rgyal po nag po zhes gsungs so/ /kha cig gur las/

tsha skyob rgyal po dkar po ni/ /zhes gsungs pas gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar por bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ de ni nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung las skyob pa'i gdugs dkar po can zhes pa'i don yin la kha dog bstan pa ni ma yin no/ /kha cig rdo rje gur las/ mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing / /zhes pas mtshams kyi khro bo rnams ches cher khros pa ma yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ ḍom+bhi pas gshin rje mthar byed/ shes rab mthar byed/ pad+ma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed rnams gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma khams pa can/ khro bo gzhan rnams rol pa'i sku can no zhes gsungs pas so/ /yan lag bzhi rdzogs rgyas pa'i skabs yin pas mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dang / spyi bor sku rdo rje ma la sogs pa thams cad sgom/ gsum pa ni dkyus bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ phal cher dkyus bzhin la rgyas 'debs la mi 'dra ba mang na'ang / 'dir gur gyi dngos bstan/ las mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing / /spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzin/ /gshin rje gshed ni rnam snang ste/ /pad+ma'i khro bo rnam gzigs te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thal sbyor la'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa las la sbyar ba la gsum ste/ zab pa'i gnad lnga nyams su len pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo spyod tshul/ dmod pa 'dor zhing brtan par bya ba'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ gtso bor 'pho ba'i gnad/ bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad/ lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo 'khor zhing byad ma bsgral ba'i gnad/ sngags bzla ba'i gnad do/ /dang po ni/ sngar bskyed pa ltar hūm̐ mdzad steng du bsgoms nas/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste lus sba ba/ ngag sba ba/ yid sba ba/ go bgo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i thugs khar hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i phyi la uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i sngags tshar gsum gyis bskor ba'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po'i steng gi klad kor gyi nang du bla ma/

mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su bu dang chung ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ 'og tu nor rdzas rnams gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rang gi lce rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa me 'bar bar bsam zhing / bsrung bya rnams kyi ming yig dang po ngag gi ngo bo yig 'bru'i rnam pa hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i nang du chud par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi sems dang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mdangs 'gag med hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa gsal 'debs shing 'dzin med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus la go mtshams med par rdo rjes gtams pas rdo rje go khrab tu gyur par bsam mo/ /gsum pa lha'i rnam pa'i gnad ni/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad kyi bar thad 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar nag de'i steng du dgra bgegs rnams lus rid pa/ nyam thag pa kha nas khrag skyug pa/ skra yags pa spyi bo tshugs su 'dug par bsam pa yin la/ de nas rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las khro bo lcags kyu thogs pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ phyi rol gyi dgra bgegs thams cad bkug nas de rnams la thim par bsam/ 'di yang rtsa rgyud las/ khrag ni skyug pa nyid dang yang / /'dar zhing mgo skyes grol ba dang / /kha ni 'og tu lta ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba shin tu khros nas zhabs brkyang bskum bsgyur/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra chen po brjod de/ khro bo rnams la cher gzigs pas khro bo gzhan rnams kyang cher khros pas steng 'og gi khro bo zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ gzhan rnams zhal phyir gzigs par bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa 'khor lo 'khor zhing byad ma bsgral ba ni/

'khor lo shugs drag pos g.yon du 'khor/ me rlung gis dgra bgegs rnams steng du bteg pas rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar rim pa bzhin tu gtubs/ lhag ma rnams mer bsregs/ rlung gis rjes med du btang nas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam mo/ /lnga pa sngags bzla ba'i gnad ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ zhes pa nas tsakra bar+dha'i bar gtso bor rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba gsal 'debs shing / zhar byung khro bo gzhan rnams dang 'khor lo dran pa tsam byed do/ /sarba yan+t+ra nas sarban+tu zhes pa'i bar gyis bsgrub bya gsal 'debs/ tshin+dha nas ma ra yas 'khor los dgra bgegs gtubs par bsam mo/ /hūm̐ bcus khro bo bcu gsal 'debs/ phaṭ gsum gyi steng 'og bar gsum gyi khro bo rnams ched du gsal 'debs so/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ ni kun nas dang bas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā naṃ ni kun nas dang bas chos laྎ na maḥs man+ta saṅgha naṃ ni kun nas dang bas dge 'dunྎ zhes brjod de'i rgyu mtshan ni dpung bzang las/ srid pa gsum na dkon mchog gsum po gtso/ /srid gsum bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin phyir/ /dngos grub 'dod pas sngags mgo la 'don no/ /bsod nams che dang log 'dren rmongs bya'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /oṃ ni skal ba bzang po'o/ /si tā ta pa tra ni gdugs dkar po can/ oṃ 'dra/ bi ma la dri ma med pa/ oṃ 'dra shaṃ ka ra 'byung gnas/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra badz+ra ni tshul min pa brlag pa'i rdo rje/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti ni gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ sarba thams cad/ yan+t+ra 'phrul 'khor/ man+t+ra sngags/ mu la karma ni rtsa ba'i sngags/ ban+dha naṃ ni 'ching ba/ tā ḍa naṃ ni bzlog pa/ kī la nāṃ wā ni phur bus btab/ ma ma bdag kṛ te byas pa/ ye na gal te/ ke na byed na/ tsit+ta sems/ kṛ tan+tu de dag sarban+tu thams cad/ tshin+dha gnyis btubs gnyis/ bhin+dha gnyis phug gnyis/

tsi ri gnyis ni phye mar gyis gnyis/ gi ri gnyis gyis shig gnyis/ ma ra gnyis sod cig gnyis/ hūm̐ bcu chos kyi dbyings la yul yul can cung zad med pa mtshon/ phaṭ gsum ni ngan song gsum gyi nyes pa 'joms pa zhes pa'i don no/ /bha ya na sa ni mahā ma ya'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las bshad pas 'dir rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro gang yang rung ba'i sngags kyi gsham bu la btags te bzlas na sngags de nyid kyi nus pa stong 'gyur du 'gro bar bshad pas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis phyag len la tshar gsum tsam bzla bar mdzad do/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ni ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong byed thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rten srung ba'i 'khor los sbyong / bcud kyi sems can skye gnas bzhir skye ba blangs pa ni lha dam tshig pa bskyed pas sbyong / de nas lus yongs su rdzogs pa ni skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pas sbyong / de nas sems pa nar son pa ni ye shes pa dgug gzhug gis sbyong / de nas rang gi mnga' thang la dbang bsgyur ba ni dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pas sbyong / de nas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba sna tshogs byed pa ni zab pa'i gnad lnga ldan gyis sbyong / gsum pa dmod pa 'dor zhing brtan par bya ba la gnyis te dmod pa 'dor ba dang / brtan par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ngag gi sgo nas su gang dag sogs brjod cing lus kyi sgo nas thal mo lan gsum brdab/ yid kyi bsam pas rang gi lag mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje ri rab tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa re re bsam/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgra bgegs rnams nyer gyis btsir nas mthar gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba'i zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par bsam pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/

hūm̐ gis drag bcas phyag rgyas btab/ /rdo rje 'tshir ba'i bde ba nyid/ /ces dang / de nyid kyi 'grel pa lha'i rigs kyis mdzad pa las/ lag pas nyed cing rdo rjes 'tshir bar bsam/ yang rkang pa'i 'og tu mnan pas nyed cing 'tshir bar bsam mo zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa brtan par bya ba ni/ ngag tu hūm̐ ring po brjod pas phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi khro bo rnams zhal nang du gzigs/ steng 'og bar gyi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yon brkyang du mdzad/ khro bo rnams bdag dang bsrung bya la zhi ba'i lta stangs kyis gzigs shing 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ rak+ṣa gsum brjod pas srung 'khor gyi sgom bzlas nyams su blangs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad brtan par bya'o/ /de dag ni drang don gyi srung ba'i 'khor lo yin la/ nges pa'i don du na rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su gzhan gyi dge ba sgrub pa la bar chad byas pa'i las gzugs phyi rol tu dgra bgegs kyi rnam par snang ba yin te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ rang sems bdud du snang ba ste/ bgegs kyang rang gi sems yin no/ /de'i gnyen po rang gi sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas de'i gnyen por rang gi sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid yin zhing / de'i shes rab stong pa'i cha rdo rje'i gur dang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i rnam par shar ba dang bgegs rnams tshar bcad nas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ rnam par rtog pa chen po 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de dag gis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos rnams bstan zin to/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te lus rnam par bzhag pa dang / yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag drug sgom rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rje sa chen gyis dka' 'grel las/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag la sogs pa bskyed pa'i rim pa/ yan lag drug tu sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas zhes gsungs pas/ rtsa rgyud du ming tsam bstan/ gtso bor gur las bstan pa yin no/ /de yang / sangs rgyas gnas ni rdzogs pa dang / /rnam pa lnga po sgom pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sgrub dang / /dkyil 'khor rnams ni 'god pa dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang la sogs/ /rim pa rjes su bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ ces gsungs pa ltar yan lag gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa dang / sbyang gzhi dang sbyangs 'bras kyi chos rnams drug tu 'du ba las/ sbyong byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug tu nges pa yin te/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ khams drug yul drug dbang po drug /rnam shes drug dang nyon mongs drug /kha dog drug dang rigs drug dang / /phung po dbyings dang bcas pa drug /sbyangs nas rgyal ba rigs drug po/ /thob byed yan lag drug pa yi/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyong tshul la de'i gnas tshul shes dgos pas skabs 'dir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad na/ spyir 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad bsdu na ma dag pa'i snang ba/ nyams kyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba gsum du 'dus pas/ de'i dang po ni/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng du bag chags kyi tshul du yod pas/ de'i bag chags nang rdo rje'i lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du tshang / de rnams kyi nang du rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gdugs nam mkha' la 'phyar bas grib ma sa la 'byung ba bzhin/

phyi rol tu 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba yin no/ /de yang phyi rol tu snang tshad thams cad nang rdo rje lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du tshang / de thams cad gsang ba sems nyid kyi steng du bag chags kyi tshul du tshang bas/ rang gi sems nyid gcig pu rnam pa de dang der snang ba la/ 'di ni sems/ 'di ni lus/ 'di ni phyi rol gyi don zhes tha dad du go bar mi bya'o/ /yang dag par na lus sems gnyis gla ba dang gla ba'i ril ma'am/ me tog dang me tog gi dri ltar dbyer med gnas kyang / gnas skabs su lus rten/ sems brten pa/ khams gsum yul snang ba thams cad longs spyod kyi rnam par shar ba la thabs kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i bye brag gis 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi byed pa'i cha nas kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ces kyang bya/ lam gyis ma bsgyur bas ting nge 'dzin gyi 'char sgo dang bral ba'i cha nas ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes kyang bya/ gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'i cha nas gzhi lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum zhes kyang bya/ lam gyis sbyang ba'i gzhi yin pa'i cha nas sbyang gzhi zhes kyang bya/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i cha nas sbyang bya zhes kyang bya/ sbyangs na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bor 'gyur bas na rigs sam rgyu zhes kyang bya ste/ mdor na 'di ni sems/ 'di ni lus/ 'di ni phyi rol gyi don zhes tha dad du btags kyang snang ba'i gzhi dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems nyid gsal rig gcig pur shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyams kyi snang ba ni sngar gyi sems gsal rig de nyid la smin byed kyi dbang bskur bas lha dang ye shes su bsgyur ba de nyid kyi don gtan la 'bebs pa yin la/ de yang rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng du sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i nus pa sa bon nam rgyu'i tshul du gnas pa dbang bskur la sogs pa lam gyi rten 'brel lus la sgrig pa de nyid rtogs par byed pa'i thabs yin pas na lus thabs kyi rgyud dam bshad rgyud ces kyang bya/

de nyid kyi rgyun nyams su blangs pa la brten nas snang stong dang gsal stong bde stong la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes nas snang ba thams cad de'i ngo bor 'char bas na nyams kyi snang ba zhes kyang bya/ gsal stong zung 'jug gsum mngon par byed pas na lam lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum zhes kyang bya/ de ltar na lam la ming gi rnam grangs du mar btags kyang lha dang ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems gsal rig gcig pur shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa dag pa'i snang ba ni sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyong byed bskyed pa'i rim pas lha dang gzhal yas khang du bsgyur ba dang / sbyang gzhi sems kun gzhi'i bag chags sna tshogs pa dang bcas pa sbyong byed rdzogs rim gyi bde chen du bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhis nyams su len pas de'i don lus la mngon du gyur pa ni phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud dam dag pa'i snang ba'am/ sbyangs 'bras zhes kyang bya'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyong tshul/ sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed lam gyi ngo bor snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul du bsgoms pas sbyang 'bras dag pa'i snang ba gnas gyur gyi tshul gyis thob pa yin/ de bzhin du sbyang gzhi 'khor ba sbyangs 'bras mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bor sbyong byed lam gyis bsres te dbyer med ro gcig tu nyams su len pa ni 'khor 'das dbyer med yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan zhig tu/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas na/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje sa chen gyi bum dbang ngo sprod du/ rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi/ /dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med/ /ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dbang du gyur na grol ba med/

/ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du phyi nang bsres te nyams su len pa dang / rgyu 'bras rgyas btab tu nyams su len pa dang / rigs rigs bdag 'brel ba'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa la sogs pa mtha' dag shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i lam dngos ji lta bus nyams su len snyam na lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len/ de yang gcig la mtshon na dper na sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi phung po/ sbyong byed gzhal yas khang gi rnam par nyams su len pa ni rnam pa lam byed/ de nyid rnam par snang mdzad du mos pas mos pa lam byed/ de yang 'bras dus kyi rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin snyam du bsam pa 'bras bu lam byed/ de la brten nas rang rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sdig sgrib dag par 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed ces bya/ de yang sbyang gzhi de la 'bras bur zhen nas sbyong byed lam gyis nyams su blangs pas rgyu 'bras 'brel pa can yin pas 'bras bu thob par nges pa yin te/ zhen pas zhugs na 'brel pas mi slu ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /de yang dper na nam mkha'i zla ba la zhen cing lta bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan la bltas pas nam mkha'i zla ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs la sogs pa tshul ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa nam mkha'i zla ba dang chu nang gi zla ba 'brel pa can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /skabs 'dir spyir de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong ba la sngar byon pa'i mkhas pa 'gos rngog la sogs pa kha cig sngar 'das pa'i bskal pa gsum man chad/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba'i bskal pa gsum yan chad kho na sbyang gzhir bzhed/ kha cig rang gi skye ba snga ma nas bzung bu tsha tshun chad kyi rtog pa thams cad sbyang gzhir bzhed/ phyis byon pa'i mkhas pa kha cig rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi dwangs ma mi shigs pa khyad par gsum ldan kho na sbyang gzhir byed cing de nyid sangs rgya ba yin la/ rags pa lus sangs mi rgya bar bzhed/

kha cig chos nyid bden pa rtag cing brtan la ther zug pa sbyang gzhir bzhed la/ kun rdzob 'khor bas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad med par bzhed/ kha cig sngar 'das pa'i sbyang gzhi rnams mi sbyang ste sngar bsreg pa'i bud shing slar bsregs pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ da ltar gyi sbyang gzhi de rnams mi sbyang ste grub zin pa la gnyen po'i bya ba mi 'jug pas sol ba brdar ba la dkar po mi 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /des na ma 'ongs pa rang la 'byung 'gyur gyi 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi mngal skyes khams drug ldan gyi skye 'chi bar do gsum kho na sbyong bar bzhed cing / de dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam bsgom par bzhed do/ /des na 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa la bskyed rim gyi skabs su tshogs bshad kyi dbang du byas na mngon par rtogs pa tshar gcig gis skye gnas phyed dang bzhi sbyong la/ slob bshad kyi dbang du byas na dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin re res kyang sbyong bar bzhed/ slob dpon dman pa'i zhabs kyis bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa skad cig re res kyang snod dang bcud dang lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa sbyong zhing zhes dang / mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing du bskyed rdzogs re res kyang skye ba dang 'chi ba'am snang ba dang stong pa'i rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong ba yin no zhes gsum po re res kyang skye 'chi la sogs pa'i rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong ngo / /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de lam thams cad gcig tu bsres nas bstan pa 'di ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa'i bzhed pa yin no/ /zhes pa rnams kyis don thun mong ma yin par bshad do// //gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la drug ste gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag

dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag go /dang po la bzhi ste/ gzhi'i yan lag rgyu'i yan lag rkyen gyi yan lag gnas thabs kyi yan lag go /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyud nas gsungs tshul/ gsungs pa'i don gtan la dbab pa/ de'i nang du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga zhes dang / nam mkha'i khams su bha ga bsam/ /dbus su rnam par bsgoms nas ni/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas bsgoms nas ni/ /de la sangs rgyas gnas bsam bya/ /zhes pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don gtan la dbab pa la brgyad de/ ming gi rnam grangs/ ming gi don/ rab tu dbye ba/ sa bon/ kha dog dbyibs/ mtshon tshul/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bha ga phyag rgya/ nam mkha'i khams rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i 'byung gnas yin pas na de skad ces bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ steng gi dbang du byas na zur gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug rnams so/ /de'i dang po ni/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis gshin rje gshed dgra nag tu bshad/ phyi ma rnams ni bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la brten nas paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se nas bshad la/ de yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ de yang gsum bzhi lnga dang ni/ /gru drug par ni shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa ni/ mtsho skyes kyis/ shes rab e yi rnam pa can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par bzhed do/ /lnga pa ni slob dpon pad+mas kha dog dkar por bzhed/ gzhan gyis dmar por bshad pa yod kyang / 'dir phyi dkar la nang dmar bar bzhed/ drug pa ni/

steng du zur gsum/ 'og tu zur gcig dang bcas pa/ gtor ma gru gsum mgo mjug ldog pa'i nang brus pa lta bur bzhed do/ /bdun pa ni/ phyi dkar la nang dmar bas ni thabs shes mtshon/ steng gi zur gsum gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mtshon/ 'og gi zur gcig gis snying po kye rdo rje mtshon/ rtsa ba phra ba gdengs ka che ba ni las dang po pa nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar gyi yon tan rnams gong nas gong du rgyas pa mtshon no/ /yang na steng gi zur gsum gyis rnam thar sgo gsum yang mtshon no/ /brgyad pa ni/ sbyang gzhi rang gang du skye ba'i ma dag pa'i skye gnas te/ mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na ma'i mngal/ sgong skyes kyi sgo nga / brdzus skyes kyi me tog la sogs pa/ drod sher skyes la sa gzhi la sogs pa rang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i ma dag pa'i skye gnas sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong byed rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum du bsgyur nas bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas pa'i rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa de'i nang du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dgos pa bshad pa ni/ gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ rang chos sku skye ba med pa la skye ba'i rnam 'phrul ston pa'i dgos pa yod de/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ bha ga bcom ldan sangs rgyas kyi/ /des na 'dod chags sun mi dbyung / /gang gzhan dam tshig rnam pa gsum/ /'di nyid kyi ni nang du 'dus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag la 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa dang / de byin gyis rlob byed kyi 'khor lo sgom pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyud las gsungs tshul/ gsungs pa'i don gtan la dbab pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mdor bstan gyi tshul du e waṃ ma ya zhes dang /

'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /ji ltar rig pas byin za dang / /lha rnams kyi ni rlung chen dang / /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ nam mkha' bem chen dwangs pa dang / /go skabs med dang dbyer med dang / /zhes pa rnams kyis 'byung bzhi lugs ldog gi rim pa bstan/ de yang / 'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams kyi don sa'i sngon du chu sogs bshad pa'i tshul dang / rdo rje gur las/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su ni/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /yang ni chu yang bsgom par bya/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dbang chen bsgom/ /zhes pas 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gi rim pa bstan to/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don gtan la dbab pa ni slob dpon rtse mos/ de nas rgyu yi yan lag ni/ /sa bon bzhi las 'byung ba bzhi/ /kha dog dbyibs la mtshan ma can/ /rlung nas mas rim bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'byung bzhi re re la sa bon gang yin pa/ ming gang yin pa/ kha dog gang yin pa/ dbyibs gang yin pa/ mtshan ma gang gis mtshan pa dang lnga lnga yod pa las/ dang po rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ rang rgyud la snang ba ma dag pa'i rlung gi sems bag chags dang bcas pa yaṃ yig gi rnam par shar ba ni sa bon/ de las byung ba'i ming ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ kha dog ni sngon po/ dbyibs gzhu lta bu/ mtshan ma ni 'chang bzung dang mchog ma la rlung gi rang bzhin ba dan g.yo bzhin pa yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa'o/ /de bzhin du de'i steng du raṃ yig gi rnam par shar ba'i raṃ yig ni sa bon/ ming ni me'i dkyil 'khor/ kha dog dmar po/ dbyibs gtor ma gru gsum mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu/ mtshan ma ni me'i rang bzhin raṃ yig gis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du waṃ yig ni sa bon/

ming ni chu'i dkyil 'khor/ kha dog ni dkar po/ dbyibs ni zlum po/ mtshan ma ni bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du laṃ yig ni sa bon/ ming ni sa'i dkyil 'khor/ kha dog ser po/ dbyibs dpangs cung zad dang bcas pa'i gru bzhi/ mtshan ma ni lte bar laṃ yig zur bzhi la sa'i rang bzhin rdo rje rtse gsum pa phyed pas mtshan pa'o/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul la gsum ste/ sbyang gzhi'i rnam gzhag sbyong byed ngos bzung ba/ de nyid ngo sprad de nyams su len pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten chags 'jig gnas gsum thams cad 'byung bzhi la brten nas byed cing de yang chags pa'i thog mar 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung du 'byung ba yin te/ bsdud pa las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu'i dkyil 'khor brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba'ang brten/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /bcud kyi sems can skye ba'i thog mar mngal gyi sngon 'gro 'byung bzhi lugs ldog tu 'byung ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ reg pa sra ba'i bag chags kyis/ /sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur/ /byang sems gsher ba'i rnam pa yis/ /chu yi khams ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bskyod pa las ni drod skye ste/ /'gro ba rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mngal gyi dngos gzhi ni 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gi rim par mthun pa yin te/ phyag chen thig le las/ rnam shes las ni skyes pa rlung / /de las mi ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las skyes pa chu yin te/ /de las dbang chen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor ba yis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcud kyi sems can lus gnas pa la yang rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i dbang du byas na 'byung bzhi lugs ldog gi rim pa dang mthun pa yin te/ sam+bu ṭi las/ e ni sa ru rab tu bshad/ /waṃ ni chu ru shes par bya/ /ma ni me ru rab tu bshad/

/ya ni rlung gi rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rten lus kyi dbang du byas na 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gi rim pa dang mthun pa yin te/ sam+bu ṭi las/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung / /gzhu yi dbyibs su yang dag gnas/ /sum mdor yang ni me yin te/ /gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbyibs su gnas/ /lte ba yang ni chu yin te/ /zlum po'i tshul du yang dag gnas/ /snying khar yang ni sa nyid de/ /kun nas gru bzhi sa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ma dag pa'i 'byung bzhir snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyang gzhi yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyong byed ni/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'am yum lnga'i bdag nyid kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par 'char ba ni sbyong byed yin no/ /gsum pa de nyid ngo sprad de nyams su len pa la/ kha cig 'byung bzhi lugs ldog gis mngal gyi sngon 'gro kho na sbyong ba dang / lugs 'byung sgom pas dngos gzhi kho na sbyong ba dang / skabs 'dir 'byung bzhi sgom pas ni snod kyi 'jig rten gyi 'byung bzhi kho na sbyong zhes bzhed pa yod kyang rang lugs ni snod bcud kyi 'byung bzhi gang yin yang 'dra/ lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog ji ltar yin yang rung / sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i 'byung bzhir snang ba'i rtog pa thams cad sbyong byed rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin te de yang gcig gis mtshon na/ ma dag pa'i rlung de lha mo g.yung mo'am sgrol ma'i ngo bo rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par sgom pa ni rnam pa lam byed/ de la lha mo de nyid du zhen pa ni mos pa lam byed/ de yang 'bras dus kyi lha mo dngos yin snyam du bsam pa ni 'bras bu lam byed/ de la brten nas bdag rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed yin no/

/de bzhin du 'byung ba 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /de yang 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gang yin yang skabs 'dir 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung du sgom pa sogs nas sbyong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa de byin gyis rlob byed kyi 'khor lo sgom pa la yang gsum ste/ rgyud nas gsungs tshul/ gsungs pa'i don gtan la dbab pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'khor lo zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ 'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ de yi steng du sangs rgyas bsam/ /spro na gzhal yas gnas bkod bya/ /zhes dang / rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /lus kyi dbyings kyis yi ge bskyed/ /de nas gzhal yas khang gnas bkod bya/ /zhes pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las/ dang po rgyas pa ni/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad bskyed pa dang / bsdus pa sa bon bh+rūm̐ yig tsam las bskyed kyang / 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas nas bh+rūm̐ las chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ kha dog ni sbyangs 'bras rnams kyi sku mdog gi dbang du byas nas dkar po/ sbyang gzhi'i kha dog gi dbang du byas nas ser po/ rtsibs kyi grangs ni rje btsun rtse mos phyogs brgyad kyi dbang du byas nas rtsibs brgyad du bshad kyang / 'dir rje btsun rin po ches steng 'og gnyis kyi rtsibs bsnan pas bcur mdzad pa ltar yin no/ /mtshan ma ni 'khor lo'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ yig ser pos mtshan pa'o/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi phung po/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs kyi khams so/ /sbyong byed rnam snang gi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i rnam par bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras rnam snang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/

/'byung bzhi 'khor los byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa ni gzhal yas khang la rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal 'jog sla ba'i ched du'o/ /gsum pa rkyen gyi yan lag la gsum ste/ rgyud rgya gzhung nas bstan pa'i tshul/ bstan pa'i don nyams su len pa/ de rkyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar sgom pa po 'byung ba'ang / /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo steng du bdag /srid pa bar ma'i bsam gtan bya/ /zhes dang / grub chen mi thub zla bas/ srid pa bar ma bsam byas na/ /e waṃ nyid du rab tu 'dres/ /zhes dang / sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo de steng du/ /srid pa bar ma'i bag chags bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa de'i don nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad/ nam mkhar rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim bzhin steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i steng 'og tu hoḥyig dmar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa bsgom pa yin te/ mi thub zla bas/ hoḥyig 'od zer dmar po can/ /gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gsum/ /zhes dang / slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ de nyid gsum gyi sa bon dkar dmar nag /mgo dang mjug tu hoḥyig gnyis kyis mtshan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don de yang sbyang gzhi rang gi sems nyid la ma dag pa'i bar dor snang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum sred len dang bcas pa sbyong byed kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang thabs dang shes rab kyi ngo bo yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa de rkyen du 'gyur tshul ni/

rang gi bar do'i ngo bo nam mkha' las de 'dra ba'i yig 'bru lnga mar me gcig las gnyis mched pa'i tshul du byung nas 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la 'dres pa'i sa gzhal yas khang du grub par bsgom pa yin te/ de ltar du bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rang gi sems snang tsam du shes pa dang / de las gzhal yas khang yang gnyis med ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul du shes par bya ba'i phyir yin te/ rtse mos/ de nas rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ /'byung bzhir rnam shes bsgom bya ste/ /'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang / /rang sems tsam du shes phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa gnas thabs kyi yan lag la lnga ste/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i don dngos bshad pa/ zhar byung phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad bshad pa/ nang gi gdan bshad pa/ de dag la nga rgyal gzung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ston pas dkyil 'khor 'di dag gsungs/ /gru bzhi yang dag 'bar ba nyid/ /sgo bzhi gzi brjid chen po ste/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /'phreng ba la sogs rnga yab ldan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis rnam par mdzes/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo ji ltar sngar gsungs pa/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /mtshams bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje srad bus nye bar brgyan/ /zhes dang / 'phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag 'khrugs/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje srad bus yang dag brgyan/ /re kha lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /de nas bum pa brgyad po bri/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don dngos bshad pa la sdom tshig ni/ 'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don lnga las dang po 'og gzhi'i rnam gzhag ni/ 'og la pad+ma nyi ma dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje khor yug go /zhes gsungs pa'i don bshad pa la/

pad+ma'i lte ba'i rgya ni cha phran drug cu rtsa bzhi/ dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog a bha yas ser por bshad kyang bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pas lte ba ljang la ge sar ser/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ljang khur bzhed/ 'dab ma'i grangs la bla ma rngog pa rnams sum cu rtsa gnyis su bzhed kyang / la li ta badz+ra gyis/ 'dab ma 'bum ldan de dbus su/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /kha dog ni sna tshogs pa/ zheng la cha phran gnyis pa'o/ /de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgya ni pad+ma'i lte ba dang mthun/ dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog dmar po'o/ /bri cha la ljang khur bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na rje btsun rin po ches gzhal yas khang rgyan du ma dang ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la shar bas kha dog sna tshogs pa mtshon pa'i don yin par bzhed/ yang na pad+ma'i lte ba ljang khur yod pa'i don yin te dper na dar ljang khu'i steng du nor bu me shel bzhag pa lta bu'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje ni a bhi dha na las/ ka ba'i rtse nas 'thon rtse mo/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od po che/ /zhes dang / slob dpon shan+ti pas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la/ /rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang / /zhes pa rnams kyi don sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa/ rgya cha chen bcu gnyis pa/ dpangs cha chen gcig pa/ phyogs kyi rwa rnams phyogs mdog can rtsa ba phra ba cha phran gnyis gnyis te/ de nas je sbom la song ba'i dbus ra'i dkyil gyi sbom sa la cha chen gcig logs rwa rnams kyi sbom sa la cha phran gsum gsum/ rtse mo phra sa rnams cha phran gnyis gnyis te dkyus ni cha chen gnyis so/ /de lta bu'i rwa lnga phyogs bzhir gyes tshul la byung rdzogs su 'dod pa/ rwa ngo mthong du 'dod pa/ rwa phyed mthong phyed mi mthong du 'dod pa dang gsum gyi 'dod tshul ni slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis/ shar gyi rwa la 'khor lo bris/

/zhes gsungs pas dbus rwa'i steng du lha bkod par bshad pas bkag pa yin no/ /rang lugs ni a bh+ya ka ras/ rwa yi glor yang rwa gzhan no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar g.yas g.yon du rwa gnyis gnyis sbrags mar bshad pa yin no/ /kha dog ni zhal mdog tu 'dod pa dang / kha dog gzhan du 'dod pa dang / phyogs mdog tu 'dod pa dang gsum las phyi ma nyid yin no/ /de yang 'og gzhi de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid de dag gi rnam par shar ba yin no/ /'og gi pad nyis ni thabs shes mtshon/ de'i steng gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba mthing nag gis chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mtshon la/ rwa rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa phyogs bzhir gyes pa 'dis chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la/ ye shes gzhan bzhi dang ldan pa mtshon pa yin no/ /'khor yug chos 'byung dur khrod srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sa ste phal cher bshad zin la/ dur khrod ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa logs la rgya phyed dpangs su 'dod pa dang / rgya mnyam dpangs mnyam du 'dod pa dang / dpangs su cha phran lngar 'dod pa la sogs pa yod kyang / 'dir nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rnam par dag pa gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo rgyal po las/ sa phyogs der ni rin po che sna bdun la sogs pas khang pa brtsigs pa gru bzhi pa ka ba zug pa/ sgo bzhi btod pa mnyam pa/ nyams dga' ba shin tu rnam par phye ba/ ches mdzes par byas pa/ rab tu bkra ba lta na sdug pa 'od 'bar ba thams cad skas bzhi dang ldan pa dpangs su dpag tshad gsum yod pa/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga yod pa zhig 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar lnga gsum dpangs su bzhed pa yin la/ de yang gzhal yas khang gi rtsig pa'i rgyar cha phran sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa de'i lnga cha gsum ni cha phran bcu dgu dang cha phran gcig gi lnga cha yin la de nyid de'i dpangs su bzhed pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i logs kyi rnam gzhag gi sdom tshig ni/
