logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /dra phyed mda' yab pu shu 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhal yas khang gi rtsig pa ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba nas cha chen bzhi gzhal ba'i phyi rol cha chen lnga pa'i dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab pa'i sar/ kha cig rtsig pa rim pa lnga ste steng nas steng du rtseg par 'dod kyang / 'dir nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po dkar po rnams phyi nang sbrags te rtsig pa'i dpangs cha phran bcu drug yod pa/ de'i steng du pha gu ni kha cig dmar por 'dod kyang 'dir ser por bzhed pa'i dpangs la cha phran gcig zheng la cha phran gnyis la nang rtsig pa'i ngos dang mnyam pa/ phyir cha phran phyed 'phyar ba'i gdong la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra tshom gyis spras pa/ de'i steng dra phyed kyi sa rin po che'i bre phul ni phyogs re rer brgyad brgyad/ mtshams bzhir re re ste kun dril bas sum cu rtsa drug ste/ de yang gcig la mtshon na bre phul bzhir brtsegs pa re re la dpangs cha phran gyi phyed yod pa/ zheng la 'og ma cha phran gcig gong ma rnams rim pa bzhin cha phran phyed phyed ring du song ba/ de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb bam ska rags ni dpangs la cha phran gcig gis lnga cha zheng ni bre phul steng ma dang mnyam pa ste cha phran gcig de'i phyi ngos chu srin ma ga ra'i kha nas mu tig gi dra ba 'phyang ba ste slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ dra ba ni mu tig gi chun 'phyang ste mchog dbus na yod pa'o/ /dra phyed ni mchog mtha' na yod pa'o ces/ gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i steng du bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dpangs su cha phran gcig yod pa'o/ /dbyibs ni nor bu mig gsum pa yu ba cung zad dang bcas pa'i mgo thur du bstan pa rus rgyan rnying ma'i za ra tshags sam/ spyi blug mchu med mgo thur du bstan pa lta bu'o/ /de'i steng du rin po che'i pu shu gyen la langs pa dpangs su cha phran gcig

dbyibs byang chub chen po'i mchod rten mgo thur du bstan pa lta bu'i khong seng pas khor yug tu bskor ba'o/ /gsum pa steng thog la kha cig mchod rten gyi rnam par 'dod pa/ rgyal khab kyi rnam par 'dod pa yod kyang / 'dir thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa thog phub rim pa gsum du gsungs pa ltar de'i sdom tshig ni/ steng thog ka ba shing rtsegs dang / /gdung dang thog phub rim pa gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad na ka ba'i grangs ni rin po che las grub pa phyogs re re zheng rtsig pa la brten pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ de'i tshad ni slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mtha' gcig ni rdo rje'i thig la thug pa/ mtha' gcig ni gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la rten no/ /zhes so/ /ming don ni rdo rje lta bu sa'i bsam pas/ dngos po thams cad sprul bas na/ /thams cad rdo rje'i ming du sbyar bas/ rdo rje'i ka ba zhes bya'o/ /de yang gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam phyogs mdog can dpangs su cha phran gcig gi lnga cha yod pa'i steng du tshangs thig gi phyogs g.yas g.yon du cha phran lnga lnga gzhal ba'i rtsig pa la nye ba'i phyogs/ ka ba'i rnam pa sbom la cha phran gcig yod pa/ dpangs su cha phran bcu drug yod pa brgyad btsugs pa'i steng du gzhu ring thung gnyis la cha phran gnyis yod pa/ de'i steng du cha phran gcig yod pa'i sa rdo rje'i gdung zlum pos 'khor yug tu bskor ba'o/ /de dang gser gyi gdung leb mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub pa'i sne mor cha phran gnyis 'phyar ba'i bya 'dab can no/ /rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig pa zlum po phyogs mdog can dpangs su cha phran phyed drug yod pa/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran phyed/ de'i steng du dra phyed kyi sa cha phran gcig de'i steng du dpangs cha phran gcig yod pa'i rdo rje'i thal gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris pa/

phyogs mtshams kyi re mig rnams thog phub pa'i sne mor cung zad 'phyang ba'i bya 'dab can no/ /de'i dbus su rdo rje'i gdung gru bzhi pa'i steng du rtsig pa gru bzhi kha dog sngon po dpangs su cha phran bzhi la lnga chas dman pa/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gcig gi sum cha/ de'i steng du dra phyed kyi sa cha phran gcig gi gsum gnyis yod pa/ de'i steng du rgya phibs kyis phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyi 'og ka ba'i bar gyi rdo rje'i rwa ba 'obs lta bur 'dod pa dang / thog thag tu 'dod pa dang / rwa ba tsam du 'dod pa dang gsum las 'dir phyi ma ltar rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dpangs su cha phran gcig yod pa'o/ /thog phub 'og ma'i bya 'dab kyi 'og rtsig pa'i 'gram nas dpangs dang zheng cha phran gnyis gnyis re yod pa'i 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po sgo khyud nas sgo khyud kyi bar du song ba'i steng du phyogs re rer 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi bzhis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgo'i rnam gzhag la gru gsum gcig tu 'dod pa/ zlum po gcig tu 'dod pa/ zlum po sgo brgyad du 'dod pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhir 'dod pa dang bzhi las 'dir phyi ma ltar gru bzhi sgo bzhir bzhed pa yin no/ /sgo'i zheng tshad la gzhal yas khang gi lnga char 'dod pa/ dgu char 'dod pa/ bcu char 'dod pa sogs 'byung yang / grub chen kun snying gis/ sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /sgo khyud kyang ni de yi tshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gzhal yas khang gi brgyad cha'o/ /dpangs la dar pan a tsar+yas/ ma 'gal ba ni lha yi phyir/ /ring ba'i sgo ni bshad pa yin/ /shin tu thung yang mi 'gal bas/ /mchod bya rnams kyang bstan pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don cha chen gsum du 'dod pa dang /

gnyis su 'dod pa yod kyang 'dir rta babs rnam bu bzhi'i dbang du byas pas cha chen gnyis par bzhed de/ de nas sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rtsig pa cha chen re re mdun du 'then pa ni sgo khyud/ de nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran gnyis gnyis 'then pa ni sgo 'gram/ de nas mdun du cha phran gnyis 'then pa sgo logs so/ /de'i dpangs ni cha phran dgu yod pa/ sgo logs kyi sne mor cha phran gcig dma' ba'i sar rdo rje'i gdung cha phran phyed/ de'i steng du cha phran phyed rtsig pa/ de'i steng du thog phub pa'o/ /sgo glegs 'dzud tshul ni de nyid 'dus pa las/ sgo rnams kun gyi nang du ni/ /sgo srung rnams ni dgod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgo khyud sgo 'gram gyi 'gram mtshams nas sgo glegs gnyis bral phyogs mdog can 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa 'dzud pa'o/ /lnga pa rta babs la rgyal po'i rta babs/ mchod pa'i rta babs/ rgyan gyi rta babs dang gsum las 'dir phyi ma ltar gzhal yas khang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi rta babs yin te de yang dpangs su cha chen gsum du 'dod pa dang / gnyis su 'dod pa dang / gcig tu 'dod pa dang gsum las phyi ma ltar bzhed/ de la yang snam bu bcu gcig tu 'dod pa dang / bzhir 'dod pa dang gnyis las phyi ma ltar bzhed do/ /de nas sgo glegs rnams kyi g.yas g.yon du bar stong cha phran re re yod pa'i phyi zur bzhir/ ka ba'i sboms su cha phran gcig dpangs su cha phran lnga lnga yod pa'i ka ba 'dzugs la/ ka rgyan ni ka ba'i logs su dar dpyang gi tshul dpangs zheng ka ba dang mnyam pa 'chang ba/ de'i steng du rta babs bzhi ni thig shing rtsegs pa lta bu phyi ngos mnyam pa dpangs su cha phran re re yod pa/ srid du rta babs 'og ma la cha chen bzhi yod pa/ gong ma rnams la rim pa bzhin 'og ma las cha phran re res thung du song ba'o/ /kha dog ni/ bsam gtan dag pas rta babs nyid/

/ces gsungs pa ltar bsam gtan dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu yod pas rta babs 'og ma dmar po/ bsam gtan gnyis pa na dga' ba chu lta bu yod pas rta babs gnyis pa sngon po/ bsam gtan gsum pa na dbugs 'byung rngub rlung lta bu yod pas rta babs gsum pa ljang khu/ bsam gtan bzhi pa na ting nge 'dzin mi g.yo ba sa lta bu yod pas rta babs bzhi pa ser po/ glang rgyab ni rta babs kyi mdun ngos nas mig gsum har por brus pa'i bar drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rta babs kyi snam bu gong ma'i steng gi dbus pu pad+ma'i dpangs la cha phran gcig zheng la cha phran gnyis yod pa/ 'dab ma bzhi'am brgyad kyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo'i zheng la cha phran gnyis/ dpangs la cha phran gcig rtsibs brgyad dam bcu gnyis yod pa gyen du langs pa'i steng du/ gdugs kyi yu ba dang dpangs la cha phran phyed phyed yod pa/ gdugs mgo'i zheng la cha chen gcig gi rtse mor nor bu mig gcig pa'i tog gis spras pa/ pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon cha phran re re gzhal ba'i sar ri dwags bse ru ser po nyal nas mig chos 'khor la lta ba/ de rnams kyi g.yas g.yon la sogs pa'i khor yug tu bum pa la brten pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan/ rnga yab/ gos la sogs pa rnams kyis spras pa'o/ /gsum pa zhar byung dur khrod la lnga ste/ rgyud las gsungs tshul/ de'i sgra don/ gang du sgom pa'i gnas/ ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /dbugs rgyu zhes bya'i rigs pa yis/ /dur khrod ces ni mngon par brjod/ /ces dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ ha ri ka rar ha ri gnas/ /rdul bral du ni tsu ta gnas/ /u r+ya a sho ka ni gnas/ /kem ka ṇa ru zla ba'i snying / /a tra ha sar ka rgyam pa/ /ka ran dza gnas tsa ri tra/ /lha mo'i mkhar du bha ṭa gnas/ /dza lan+dha rar ser shing gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang brgyad kyis dur khrod brgyad rim bzhin bstan to/

/gnyis pa ni/ shwa ba sa ti zhes gsungs pa'i shwa ba ni ro/ ba sa ti ni gnas te ro'i gnas zhes bya'o/ /de'i bya ba byed tshul ni ro mgo bo bcad pas 'chag pa/ dpyangs pas langs pa/ bsnyal bas nyal ba/ gsal shing phug pa gdug pa'i bya ba byed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi 'dzam bu gling gi dur khrod brgyad po dus ji tsam na byung snyam na/ rtsod dus mgo zug pa'i dus mi rnams mig ser gyis phan tshun bsad pa'i ro rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du spungs pa la brten nas dur khrod brgyad byung ba yin no/ /de yang spyir 'dzam bu gling na rnal 'byor ma stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pas de'i gnas de nyid la mtshon na stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod la/ de bsdu na sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de yang bsdu na nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de yang bcu gnyis/ de yang brgyad du 'du ba yin te dur khrod brgyad nyid do/ /de yang ha ri ki la zhes pa shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa'i yul lo/ /ha ri ta ke na'i shing zhes pa ni shi ri shing ngam/ a ru ra'i snying ste/ de gnas pa'i yul la shar phyogs gtum drag gi dur khrod ces bya la/ 'og ma rnams la'ang rim pa bzhin rgyas par shes par 'dod na bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i le'u bco brgyad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim du/ /shing sogs dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu sgom par bshad/ sdom 'byung las rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du ni/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du bsgom par bzhed do/ /phyi ma 'di la rdo rje rwa gur gyi bar du bsgom pa dang / de gnyis kyi nang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu sgom pa dang /

de'i nang chos 'byung gi phyi rol tu sgom pa dang / de'i nang gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu sgom par bzhed pa rnams su yod pa las/ skabs 'dir gtso cher thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du sgom par bzhed do/ /bzhi pa ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni sgrub thabs dkyus bzhin no/ /lnga pa de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ lus dang srid pa yongs su sbyong ba/ lha dang 'byung po dag tu 'du ba/ gtor mgron gyi gnas nges pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum ro gcig tu bsres te nyams su len pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsres te nyams su len pa'i tshul cung zad bshad na dur khrod ni sbyang gzhi yang dag pa'i 'khor ba mtshon/ de'i nang du gzhal yas khang gis sbyong byed lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /de'i nang du lha dgus ni sbyangs 'bras sku lnga ye shes lnga tshad med pa bzhi la sogs pa mtshon/ de lta bu'i dag bya dag byed zhib tu bshad na dag bya phyi nang gnyis/ dang po phyi'i dag bya ni spyir ma dag pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ nang gi dag bya sna bug gnyis gcig tu byas nas bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad/ de rnams na zug pa'i rtsa brgyad ni shing brgyad/ de la rgyu ba'i rnam shes ni phyogs skyong brgyad/ de rnams kyi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung brgyad ni zhing skyong brgyad/ de dag la 'byung ba lnga'i rlung dang ldan pa ni ro ri dang mchod rten dang me dang rlung dang sprin sna tshogs pa mtshon/ de lta bu'i dag bya de dag par byed pa'i sbyong byed ni gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad yin no/ /de dag kyang ma dag pa dang cha 'dra bar snang yang / ma dag pa dngos ma yin te/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i phyir/ sbyang gzhi sems nyid la sbyar na 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad sbyong / 'bras bu dang sbyar na dur khrod brgyad ni sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas brgyad/

shing brgyad ni byang chub kyi shing brgyad/ chu brgyad dang sprin brgyad ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje chen po/ me brgyad ni gnyis med kyi ye shes/ phyogs skyong brgyad ni sangs rgyas rab bdun byams pa dang brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad ni dgra bcom pa brgyad mtshon pa sogs slob dpon rnal 'byor pas dur khrod brgyad kyi rtog pa nas bshad do/ /bzhi pa gdan bshad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'phar ma gcig dang zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha rnams mtho dman med pa phyogs mdog can cha chen gcig yod pa/ lte ba sngon po cha chen drug yod pa'i dbus su yu ba cha phran gcig yod pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang tshun chad kheb pa/ kha dog ni/ sdom 'byung las/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /dbang ldan sngo la bden bral ljang / /lte ba ljang la ge sar ser/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / ḍom+bhi bas dmar ser du bzhed do/ /mi thub zla bas phyi dkar la nang dmar bar bzhed/ rje btsun sku mched kyis lha mo brgyad kyi sku mdog gam/ phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog la mtshams rnams mdzes tshon du bzhed do/ /pad+ma'i lte ba'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re bsam gtso bo'i gdan ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nyi mar bzhugs zhes dang / bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ lha'i bu'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ phung po'i bdud de bdud bzhi'i ngo bo gzugs khams kyi tshangs pa lha'i dbang po brgya byin gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po bdud sdig to can/ drag po dbang phyug chen po rnams mgo g.yas su bstan pa gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /lha mo brgyad kyi gdan ni rtsa rgyud las/ tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /gshin rje dang ni nor bdag dang / /bden bral dang ni thag bzang ris/

/gau rī la sogs pa yi gdan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim bzhin 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa/ shar phyogs kyi brgya byin/ nye dbang ste khyab 'jug dbang ldan gyi phyogs skyong drag po/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje/ byang phyogs kyi phyogs skyong nor bdag lho nub kyi srin po/ nub kyi phyogs skyong lha ma yin gyi dbang po thag bzang ris rnams mgo g.yon du bstan pa/ gdong gyen du phyogs pa thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /dgos pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud bzhi gdan du byas pa ni bdud bzhi rtsad nas 'joms pa mtshon/ lha mo brgyad kyis dregs pa can brgyad gdan du byas pa ni rje btsun rtse mos/ gdan brgyad sgom pa bdud bzhi dang / /'byung bzhi'i rnam rtog spangs rtags yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa de dag la nga rgyal 'dzin pa ni/ sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs kyi phung po/ sa'i khams/ mig gi dbang po/ mig gi rnam par shes pa/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed rnam snang gi ngo bo gzhal yas khang du bsgyur nas bsgoms pas 'bras dus kyi gzhal yas khang thob par 'gyur te/ de yang 'khor 'das dbyer med du bsres te lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pas/ 'bras dus kyi gzhal yas khang la nga rgyal 'dzin cing sngags bzla ba yin te sngags kyi don ni/ oṃ ni dam bca' ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ ni la ya ni pho brang / badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bha wa ni rang bzhin/ āt+ma ko3 ni bdag ham̐ ni nga'o zhes pa'i don to/ /gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de rnam snang ni sangs rgyas kyi sku'i ngo bo yin la/ sku de gsung dang thugs la sogs pa'i rten byed pa ltar/ gzhal yas khang pa'ang sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs pa'i gnas sam rten yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ni/

rdo rje gur las/ rnam pa lnga ru bsgom par bya/ /dang po skyes bu bsam de nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sprod/ /dri za nye bar zhugs nas ni/ /khu ba rjes su dran par bya/ /mtshams kyi lha mos bskul bar bya/ /'khor lo'i 'dren pa bskul nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas su 'khod/ /phyi nas rjes chags rdo rje ste/ /ye shes rnam par gzhug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la lnga ste/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su sgom pa/ snod bcud sbyong ba/ mig sogs byin gyis brlabs pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bskyed pa/ bskyed nas 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum thig ler zhu ba/ zhu ba glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs pa/ de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yi/ /rnam pa lnga po sgom pa nyid/ /ces pa'i don la drug ste/ mngon byang gi ngo bo bshad pa/ grangs nges bshad pa/ go rim bshad pa/ sgom tshul gyi gnad bshad pa/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro tshul/ de la dogs pa dpyad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi rgyu bshad pa/ de las byung ba'i mngon byang dang po gnyis bshad pa/ mngon byang phyi ma gsum so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ grangs/ 'god tshul/ kha dog rgyu/ phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ a li bco lnga la a tsheg drag can bsnan pa'i a li bcu drug pa phrag gnyis/ ka li sum cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du ya ra la wa sogs yi ge drug bsnan pa'i ka li bzhi bcu phrag gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ a li phrag gnyis te steng 'og mgo sprad sgom pa/ phyi nang rim bzhin g.yas skor g.yon skor du sgom pa yod kyang 'dir sbyang gzhi'i dbang du byas nas a li bcu drug phrag gcig g.yas skor/

phrag gcig g.yon skor du sgom pa yin la/ de yang a gnyis bdud kyi mgo bor 'dzoms pa/ a tsheg drag can gnyis bdud kyi rkang pa'i mtshams su sgom pa'o/ /ka li'i 'god tshul yang de bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ a li phrag gnyis ni mu tig gi rdog ma'am/ nor bu chu shel ltar ches cher dkar zhing 'od 'phro ba'o/ /ka li phrag gnyis ni mar me'i phreng ba'am nor bu me shel ltar ches cher dmar zhing 'od 'phro bar bsam/ bzhi pa rgyu ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i nang gi khams dkar po ni a li'i rgyu'am sbyang gzhi yin la/ de bzhin du khams dmar po ni ka li'i rgyu'am sbyang gzhi yin no/ /lnga pa phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan la a li phrag gnyis 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnal 'byor pa'i rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas g.yon gnyis nas spyi gtsug gi bar zla ba yar ngo mar ngo la khams dkar po a li bcu drug gi rnam pas rim bzhin 'pho ba bcu drug bcu drug yod pa'am/ yang na thabs dang shes rab gnyis gnyis kyis phye bas sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /ka li phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnal 'byor pa'i nang gi khams dmar po la 'byung ba bzhi nam mkha'i khams dang lnga yod cing / 'byung ba bzhi po re re la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba 'byung chung bzhi yod pa dang / nam mkha'i khams la dga' ba bzhi yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ bde ba nam mkha' nyid kyi khams/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ nang du gcig ni gnas pa der/ /bzhi po de nyid nye bar gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nyi shu po re re la'ang rdul gyi cha dang / khu ba'i cha dang gnyis gnyis phye bas bzhi bcu'o/ /bzhi bcu po re re la'ang shes rab stong pa'i cha thabs bde ba'i cha gnyis gnyis phye bas brgyad cu'o/ /mdor na sbyang gzhi rnal 'byor pa'i khams dkar dmar la sum cu rtsa gnyis dang brgyad cur nges pas/ sbyangs 'bras la'ang mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yod pa'i dbang gis sbyong byed yi ge la a li sum cu so gnyis dang ka li brgyad cu yod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de las byung ba'i mngon byang dang po gnyis bshad pa la gnyis te/ mngon byang dang po bshad pa dang / gnyis pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ci'i phyir me long lta bu zhes bya/ ci'i phyir rnam pa zla bar bsgom/ ci'i phyir rgyu a li las bskyed ce na/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar me long lta bu zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ye shes de la chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba'i phyir te/ ye shes grub pa las/ ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan la/ /rang nyid nges par lta ba bzhin/ /de bzhin chos sku'i ye shes ni/ /snang ba me long zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ye shes de gzugs kyi phung po dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i bdag nyid kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa rnam pa zla bar sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rnam pa zla bar sgom sla ba dang / zla ba dri ma dang bral bar mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ kha sbyor las/ yid gnyis kun las rnam grol ba/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'phrog /nyon mongs dri ma kun las 'das/ /zla mtshungs sems ni zla ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa a li las bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ a li zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de gzugs kyi sku'i rnam par byung ba na mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan par 'byung ste/ kha sbyor las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan 'dir/ /a sogs gzugs kyis 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mngon byang gnyis pa la'ang gsum ste/ ci'i phyir mnyam pa nyid/ ci'i phyir nyi mar sgom/ ci'i phyir rgyu ka li las bskyed ce na/

dang po ni/ de la mnyam nyid ces bya ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes des chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ ye shes grub pa las/ de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes ni/ /rang nyid dang ni 'gro ba yi/ /dngos nyid gcig par thugs chud par/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de tshor ba'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur pa'i bdag nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa rnam pa nyi mar sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ phyis nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyi mas mun pa sel cing sems can la phan 'dogs pa ltar/ ye shes des ma rig pa'i mun pa sel zhing sems can la chags pas rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa rgyu ka li las bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ka li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de gzugs sku'i rnam par byung ba na dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ldan par 'byung ste/ kha sbyor las/ sangs rgyas yon tan ka sogs kyi/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mngon byang phyi ma gsum po so sor bshad pa la gsum ste/ mngon byang gsum pa bshad pa/ bzhi pa bshad pa/ lnga pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni mngon byang gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po so sor rtog pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang lha'i phyag mtshan sa bon nyid/ /so sor rtogs par brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal bas chos thams cad ma sgrib par gsal bar mkhyen pa'i cha nas de skad ces gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa rnam pa phyag mtshan du bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyag mtshan de dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa ma 'dres par snang ba ltar/ ye shes des chos thams cad ma 'dres par rtogs pa'i phyir/ mngon byang gsum pa 'di la grub chen mi thub zla bas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang /

aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan pa bskyed par bzhed kyang / rtsa rgyud kyi phyag mtshan bkod pa'i skabs su/ snying por skyes pa'i thod pa nyid/ /mdog dkar cha gsum par ni bri/ /zhes dang / dbus su thod pa dkar po ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / aṃ las gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la aṃ gis mtshan pa bskyed par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa mngon byang bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po bya ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ye shes de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas sems can gyi don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rnam pa 'dres par bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan gong dang mtshungs so/ /gsum pa mngon byang lnga pa la gnyis las/ dang po chos dbyings ye shes su gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ye shes de sgrib pa thams cad dang bral bas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam pa lhar bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lha'i rnam pa de la yan lag dang nying lag la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa ltar ye shes de la ye shes kyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i lha'i sku mdog ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /ces pas bstan cing de'i phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa grangs nges bshad pa ni/ sbyong byed kyi lam mngon byang lngar grangs nges pa yin te/ sbyang gzhi phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang / skye gnas bzhi'i rim pa la sogs pa re re la lnga lngar grangs nges pa'i phyir/ sbyang 'bras rigs lnga ye shes lngar grangs nges pa yin no/ /gsum pa go rim bshad pa ni/

skye gnas bzhi'i rim pa dang mthun par rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim gyi dbang du byas te bshad na/ de yang mngal skyes lta bu la mtshon na thog mar pha'i khams dkar po 'og tu 'phen pa ni mngon byang dang po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ de'i steng du ma'i khams dmar po 'bab pa ni mngon byang gnyis pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du bar do'i rnam par shes pa zhugs pa ni mngon byang gsum pa phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa sgom pa/ khu khrag gnyis dang bar do'i rnam shes gcig tu 'dres pa ni mngon byang bzhi pa nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres par sgom pa/ mngal gyi gnas skabs su yongs su rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa ni mngon byang lnga pa lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pas mtshon/ bzhi pa sgom tshul gyi gnad bshad pa ni/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprad pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin la/ de yang thun mong ba tshogs bshad kyi dbang du byas na mngon byang dang po gnyis kyis pha ma'i pha ma sbyong / rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa ni rang nyid kyi mngal dngos sbyang ba'am yang na mngon byang dang po gnyis kyis mngal skyes dang drod gsher skyes sbyong / nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig le gong bur gyur pas ni sgong skyes sbyong / de las lha'i skur bskyed pa ni brdzus skyes sbyong ba yin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa slob bshad kyi dbang du byas nas zhib tu sbyar te bshad na sbyang gzhi phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ lus ngag yid yon tan bya ba dang bcas pa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dbyings dang bcas pa lnga tshan gcig tu byas pa/ nyon mongs pa lnga/ rlung lnga/ rtsa lnga/ yi ge lnga/ khams lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ nad lnga/ gdon lnga/ skye gnas bzhi po re re la'ang lnga lngar phye bas lnga tshan bco lnga la sogs pa ma dag pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed mngon byang lnga'i ngo bor sbyong tshul snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul du bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga/

ye shes lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa gnas gyur gyi tshul du thob pa yin no/ /de yang gcig la mtshon na sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi phung po/ sa'i khams/ lus/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ nyon mongs pa gti mug mngal skyes kyi pha'i khams/ drod gsher skyes kyi gsher/ sgong skyes kyi pha/ brdzus skyes kyi stong pa'i cha la sogs pa sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed rnam pa zla bar sgom pa ni rnam pa lam byed/ de me long lta bu'i ye shes su sgom pa ni mos pa lam byed/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes dngos yin snyam du sgom pa ni 'bras bu lam byed/ de la brten nas bdag rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed ces bya la/ de rnams sbyang gzhi de lta bu rnam pa zla ba ngo bo me long lta bu'i ye shes su zhen nas bsgom pas zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam zhes bya/ de yang rgyu 'bras 'brel pa can yin pas 'bras bu nges par thob pa ni 'brel pas mi slu ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyor tshul rnams 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du sbyang gzhi tshor ba'i phung po/ nam mkha'i khams/ yon tan/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid/ ser sna dang nga rgyal/ skyes gnas bzhi'i mngal skyes kyi ma'i khams dmar po/ sgong skyes kyi ma'i cha/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod/ rdzus skyes kyi gsal ba'i cha rnams sbyong byed rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ rnam pa ka li las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /sbyang gzhi 'du shes kyi phung po/ me'i khams/ ngag yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ skye gnas bzhis skye ba len pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa'i cha rnams sbyong byed 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/

/sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyi phung po/ rlung gi khams/ bya ba/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog skye gnas bzhir skye ba len tshul gyi mngal skyes dang sgong skyes kyi dbang du byas na bar do'i rnam shes dang khu khrag 'dres pa/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod gsher dang bar do'i rnam shes 'dres pa/ rdzus skyes kyi gsal stong tsam dang bar srid 'dres pa'i cha rnams sbyong byed don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rnam pa nyi zla sa bon dang bcas pa 'dres pa'i thig le'i gong bur gyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len par byed do/ /sbyang gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po/ chu'i khams/ yid/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi chos nyid du 'dzin pa'i cha/ nyon mongs zhe sdang / skye gnas bzhir skye ba blangs pa'i lus grub pa'i cha rnams sbyong byed mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bskyed nas lam byed rnam pa bzhis nyams su len pa yin no/ /de yang sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed rnams kyis snang ba bsgyur ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin sbyangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras de rnams gnas 'gyur gyi tshul gyis thob pa yin te/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed de rnams sbyangs 'bras de rnams kyi rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sems can thams cad la sbyang gzhi de rnams rang grub tu yod pas sems can thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa mi rigs snyam na thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pas 'khyams pa yin la/ 'di lta bu'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ rang gi khams dkar dmar gnyis la brten pa'i rnam shes ro gcig pa'i tshul gyis lus la brten nas gnas pa la rgyu dus kyi dbang gis smin par byas/ lam dus kyi bskyed rim gyi skabs su mngon byang lngar bsgoms pas las rung du gyur nas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba yin te/

rdzogs rim gyis gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi'i gtso bo ni khams dkar dmar gnyis rnam shes dang gsum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa de la dogs pa dpyad pa ni/ zla ba la sogs pa de rnams me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa yin nas sgom pa yin na grub zin bsgrub pa yin la/ ma yin nas sgom na sprang po rgyal por rlom pa ltar sgom pas 'grub par mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ yin pa la chos nyid dam rnam pa yin pa dang / dngos yin pa gnyis las dang po ltar min pas sgom pas kyang mi 'grub pa'i skyon med la/ dngos ma yin pas grub zin bsgrub par 'gyur ba'i skyon med do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba 'du shes gsum ldan/ dngos gzhi lha mo spro ba/ rjes gsal gdab pa'o/ /dang po la lha'i 'du shes/ sngags kyi 'du shes/ chos kyi 'du shes/ zhar byung de gsum gyi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang rig ma bdag med ma'i nga rgyal brtan cing rnam pa gsal bar sgom pa yin la/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal gyi chags pa skye ba'i yul skyes pa dang bud med du snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ yab yum gyi mkha' stong pa'i ngang las sa bon a las tha mal rang rgyud pa'i 'dod chags kyis ma gos pas pad+ma/ snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags pas na kha dog dmar po/ bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshad med pa bzhi mtshon pas 'dab ma brgyad/ yul rang bzhin gyi skye ba med pa mtshon pas ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa'o/ /de byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags don ni oṃ ni mchog ster ba/ pad+ma ni sgra ji bzhin pa/ su kha ni bde ba/ dha ra ni 'dzin pa/ ma hā ra ga ni 'dod chags chen po/

su kha dha ra ni bde ba ster ba/ tsa tur a nan+da ni dga' ba bzhi/ bha ga ni pad+ma/ bi shwa ni sna tshogs/ hūm̐ gsum ni sku gsum/ kar+yaṃ ni bya ba/ ku ru ni mdzod/ ṣ+wa me ni bdag gi'o/ /yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas stong pa'i ngang las sa bon hūm̐ las mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pas mi phyed pas na rdo rje/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas na kha dog sngon po/ sems dpa' lnga'i rang bzhin yin pas rtse lnga pa/ yul can gnyis med kyi ye shes mtshon pas na lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o/ /de byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags don ni/ oṃ ni gong dang 'dra/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ ma hā dwe ṣa ni zhe sdang chen po/ tsa tur ā nan+da ni dga' ba bzhi/ da ya ka ni ster ba/ kha ka ni mkha' 'gro ma/ mu kha e ka ra swa ni gdong gcig pa/ na tha ni mgon po/ hūm̐ gsum man sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal pa'i skye bo pho mo'i mtshan mar snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rdo rje dang pad+ma'i rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba la brten nas lha mo brgyad phyung ste sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa bsgrub par bya snyam du bsam pa yin la/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal pa'i 'dzag bde la zhen nas 'khrig pa spyod 'dod kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed chos kyi 'du shes kyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ ji ltar 'du shes gsum sgom pa/ /tha mal rnam rtog zhi byed de/ /lus dang bha ga bsam pa kun/ /mchog tu gyur pa byas pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i lha mo spro ba la lnga ste/ lha mo'i rgyu spyan 'dren pa/ de thig ler bskyed pa/

de sa bon brgyad du sgyur ba/ de lha mo brgyad du sgyur ba/ de kha nang nas spro ba'o/ /dang po la gang gis spyan 'dren pa ni/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i rtsa sgo gnyis nas bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha la sogs pa dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis so/ /gang spyan 'dren na rigs lnga'i ngo bo 'od zer kha dog lngar spyan 'dren pa dang / yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / rlung bcu'i ming can rigs lnga tsam spyan 'dren pa la sogs pa yod kyang / 'dir phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rigs lnga yab yum bcu'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa'o/ /lam gang nas spyan 'dren na yab kyi spyi bo dang shangs bug g.yas g.yon gsang gnas la sogs nas spyan 'dren par yod kyang 'dir bar srid 'jug tshul dang mthun par yab kyi zhal nas spyan 'dren par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum rnams yab kyi thugs kar byon/ phyi nang gi yab yum snyom par zhugs pas rjes chags kyi mes thugs ka'i rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu/ byang sems kyi dwangs ma dngul chu'i mdog lta bu sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi khar bab/ thig le cha brgyad du gyur par bsam/ gsum pa ni/ de rnams gaṃ tsaṃ la sogs pa sa bon brgyad du gyur par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ sa bon rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur par bsam/ lnga pa ni/ yum gyi mkha' nang gi lha mo rnams yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung nas phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du 'khod par bsam/ sbyong byed de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i spun zla dang ming sring du snang ba'i bag chags dang / khu khrag 'dres pa mngal gyi gnas skabs ches cher 'phel ba dang / de las lus grub pa de phyir btsas pa la sogs pa rim bzhin sbyong ba yin no/ /gsum pa rjes de dag gsal gdab pa la gsum ste/ rgyud las gsungs tshul/

gsungs pa'i don sgom tshul/ de la spros pa bcad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ grong khyer nyams dgar khyod dang nga / /dga' bas lhan cig rol ba las/ /dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /bsrub dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /chom rkun ma yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas lho yi sgo ru ni/ /chom rkun ma ni sgo srung ma/ /bo la ka k+ko la sbyor bas/ /ro langs ma yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas nub kyi sgo la ni/ /bdud 'joms ma ni rnam par gnas/ /dga' ba chen po'i snyoms 'jug las/ /ghasma ri yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas byang gi sgo la ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas/ /gnyis kyis bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /puk+ka si yang phyung nas ni/ /phyung nas dbang ldan mtshams su yang / /drag po'i gzugs can ma nyid gnas/ /yang ni bsrub pa'i sbyor ba las/ /'tsher pa'i mtshams su ri khrod ma/ /srin po'i mtshams su gdol pa mo/ /rlung mtshams su ni g.yung mo nyid/ /ces pa'i bar gyis lha mo rnams phyogs mtshams gang du 'god pa bstan/ gau rī kha dog nag mor 'gyur/ /chom rkun ma ni btsod dang mtshungs/ /ro langs ma ni gser btso bzhin/ /ghasma rī ni margad bzhin/ /puk+ka sī ni dbang sngon mtshungs/ /ri khrod ma ni zla nor 'od/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo sangs ma/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs ma zhes brjod/ /ces pa rnams kyis sku mdog bstan/ dkar mo'i g.yas na gri gug ste/ /de bzhin g.yon nya ro hi ta/ /chos kun ma g.yas cang te'u ste/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na phag pa nyid/ /ro langs ma g.yas rus sbal te/ /g.yon pa yi ni pad+ma'i snod/ /ghasma rī yi g.yas na sbrul/ /g.yon pas rnal 'byor lhung bzed nyid/ /puk+ka si g.yas seng ge ste/ /g.yon pas dgra sta de bzhin no/ /ri khrod ma g.yas dge slong ste/ /g.yon na bsil byed de bzhin no/ /gdol pa mo g.yas 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pas thod pa de bzhin no/

/g.yung mo'i g.yas na rdo rje ste/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis phyag mtshan bstan to/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ni/ /dkar mo la sogs phyag gnyis ldan/ /spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du ste/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /zhes pa rnams kyis lha mo rnams kyi bzhugs tshul dang rgyan la sogs pa bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don sgom tshul la gnyis te/ don dngos dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du gdan gyi snying khar lha mo rnams rim bzhin gsal 'debs pa yin te/ de yang shar du lha mo gau rī ste rang bzhin gyis dag cing spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa mtshon pas dkar mo/ chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa mtshon pas sku mdog nag mo/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa bcad nas sems can gyi nyon mongs pa gcod pa mtshon pas g.yas gri gug sems can rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las 'don pa mtshon pas g.yon nya ro hi ta zhes pa dmar mo khrab can 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor tsau rī ste ser sna 'jur gegs kyi nor 'joms shing brku bas na chom rkun ma/ sems can la rjes su chags pas na sku mdog dmar mo/ sems can rnams gti mug gi gnyid las slong ba mtshon pas g.yas cang te'u 'dzin pa/ gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems can mtshon pas g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu lha mo bait+ta lī ste gzung 'dzin gyi srog song ba'i rjes su rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su langs pas na ro langs ma/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas sku mdog ser po/ 'dod chags kyis gdung ba'i sems can mtshon pas g.yas rus sbal 'dzin pa/ de zhi ba'i thabs g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du lha mo ghasma rī ni gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa za bar phod pas na za phod ma/

phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas sku mdog ljang khu/ zhe sdang gis gzir ba'i sems can mtshon pas g.yas sbrul/ de zhi bar byed pa'i mtshon byed thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du lha mo puk+ka si ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis thugs rgyud gang bas lha mo sbos mo/ chos dbyings las mi 'gyur bas na sku mdog sngon mo/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sems can mtshon pas na g.yas seng ge de gcod par byed pas g.yon dgra sta kha bo che 'dzin pa'o/ /shar lhor lha mo sha ba rī ste gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas ring du dben pas na ri khrod ma/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sku mdog dkar mo/ bdag tu mi 'dzin pas g.yas dge slong / nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa las grol ba'i g.yon bsil byed 'dzin pa'o/ /lho nub tu lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī ste gzung 'dzin gyi srog gcod pas na gtum mo/ sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas na sku mdog sngo sangs/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas g.yas 'khor lo/ nyon mongs pa'i tha ba slog pas g.yon thong pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub byang du lha mo ḍom+bhi ni gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gis mi reg pas na g.yung mo/ phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ de yang brla gnyis man chad zhabs gnyis ljang khu/ sum mdo dmar po/ lte ba dkar po/ brang ser po/ mgrin pa yan gyi dbu sngon po/ 'di ni nang gi 'byung bzhi'i rim pa dang mthun no/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms pas g.yas rdo rje/ gdug pa can gyi sems can sdigs pas g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /lha mo thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas na zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pas na phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang brnyes pas spyan gsum pa/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/

nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu/ rigs lnga'i ngo bor rnam par dag pas rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pas mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan/ a li ka li lnga bcu dbyings su dag pas na thabs kyi rang bzhin mi mgo skam po lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnams kyi phung po sa chu me rlung dang brgyad sbyong byed me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtog pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyom tshad med dang brgyad kyi ngo bo lha mo brgyad kyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /sku mdog sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi zhe sdang ste sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo kha dog nag por bsdus nas nyams su len pa'o/ /de bzhin du sbyang gzhi gti mug nga rgyal/ ser sna/ 'dod chags/ phrag dog rnams sbyong byed me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtog pa/ bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes rnams kyi ngo bo kha dog dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu rnams sgom mo/ /phyag mtshan sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi zhe sdang ste sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo gri gug rdo rje/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga dgra sta la sogs par sgom/ sbyang gzhi gti mug sbyong byed me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo 'khor lo la sogs par sgom/ sbyang gzhi nga rgyal dang ser sna/ sbyong byed mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo rin po che la sogs par sgom/ sbyang gzhi 'dod chags/ sbyong byed so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo pad+ma dang thod pa lcags kyu la sogs par sgom/

sbyang gzhi phrag dog sbyong byed bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas sgom pa'o/ /phyag mtshan gyi srog chags rnams ni sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga la sogs pa/ sbyong byed sku lnga ye shes lnga la sogs pa mtshon pas mtshon don ches cher zab pa yin no/ /rnam 'gyur ni mtshon bya 'khor ba/ mtshon byed mya ngan las 'das pa mtshon pas 'khor 'das dbyer med du nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa spros pa bcad pa la/ rtsa rgyud las/ dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du 'god par bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ rtsa rgyud las/ de ltar gsungs pa'i don ni sgo brgyad po so so'i thad kyi pad 'dab kyi steng du lha mo rnams 'god pa'i don yin te/ de ltar ma yin na phyag mtshan bkod pa'i skabs su lha mo brgyad kyi phyag mtshan pad 'dab kyi steng du 'god par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lha mo brgyad la gau rī la sogs pa'i mtshan 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na rgyu mtshan yod de/ sngon byung ston pa he ru kas gdul bya drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas btul ba'i tshe rigs bzhi dang yum bzhis lha mo brgyad du sprul nas dbang phyug gi chung ma brgyad btul bas gdul bya de rnams kyi ming 'dul byed rnams la btags pa yin/ dper na 'jig rten na ri dwags gsod pa'i rngon pa la ri dwags pa zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /de yang a bhi dha na las/ gdul bya'i ming gis 'dul byed la grags 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gau rī dkar mo/ tsau rī ser po/ bait+ta lī dmar por 'byung rigs pa las/ de ltar mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ ye shes re re la'ang ye shes lnga lnga tshang bas nang tshan gyis ye shes so so'i kha dog gi rnam par shar ba yin zhing /

de yang gau rī me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ ye shes de'i nang tshan chos dbyings ye shes kyi kha dog nag por shar ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum thig ler zhu ba la lnga ste/ rgyu gang zhu ba/ rkyen gang gis zhu ba/ rnam pa ji lta bur zhu ba/ de la nga rgyal bzung ba/ de dag gi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched thams cad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bde ba skyes pa/ dri za zhugs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyom par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems dwangs mas sku'i cha shas thams cad yongs su gang bas thugs rgyud la zag med bde chen gyi ye shes skyes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar skyes pa'i tshe rang bar srid kyi ngo bo nam mkha'i yig 'bru lnga yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i rkyen gyis rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched yig 'bru lnga dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas 'od du zhu ba'o/ /de dag gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i sems snang pha ma nyal po sngar byas pa/ ma 'ongs pa na byed par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyom par zhugs pas sbyong / sbyang gzhi rang gis sngar byas pa/ ma 'ongs pa byed par 'gyur ba'i bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum sred len dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs thabs shes kyi ngo bo yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par shar bas sbyong / sbyang gzhi rang gi bar srid dang pha ma'i khu khrag 'dres pa sbyong byed yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched dang yig 'bru lnga ro gcig tu 'dres pa 'od du zhu bas sbyong /

gsum pa ni/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thig le zlum po kha dog sngo skya bde ba'i cha yab zhu ba/ stong pa'i cha yum zhu ba dbyings yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos/ yab zhu ye shes yum zhu dbyings/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam pa thig le'i rnam par gnas pa la nga rgyal bzung nas de byin gyis rlob byed kyi sngags brjod de/ sngags don ni oṃ ni mchog ster ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ a nu rā ga ṇa ni rjes su chags pa/ badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bhā wa ni rang bzhin/ āt+ma ko3 ni bdag nyid/ haṃ ni nga zhes pa'o/ /de'i sbyang gzhi phung po lnga'i chos nyid du 'dzin pa/ yul drug gi nang nas chos/ dbang po drug gi nang nas yid kyi dbang po/ rnam shes drug gi nang nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ rigs drug gi nang nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs/ kha dog drug gi nang nas nag po la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo thig ler bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ de ltar gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad bsdus nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro la/ 'bras dus su chos sku thob par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa zhu ba glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs tshul la/ rje btsun rtse mos/ dang po gtso bo thig le la/ /bzhugs pa lha mo bzhi rnams kyis/ /mgon med pas ni gtso bo dang / /'phrad par 'dod pas glu yis bskul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la lnga ste/ gang la bskul ba/ gang gis bskul ba/ ji ltar bskul ba/

de ltar bskul ba'i dgos pa/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam pa thig le'i rnam par gnas pa de la'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis bskul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / lha mo gang gis bskul ba gsal bar bshad/ rgyud rdo rje gur las/ mtshams kyi lha mo bskul nas ni/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'bras dus su sangs rgyas rnams chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni lam dus su tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa la brten nas 'byung ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'dir tshad med bzhi dag pa'i ngo bo mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sna tshogs glu yis mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar glus mchod pa'i tshul gyis bskul ba yin te/ de yang ngo bo bde chen gyi ye shes rnam pa glu'i gdangs kyi rnam par shar ba yin la/ glu'i mchod par 'gyur ba'i tshul ni thugs rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas so/ /glus bskul ba'i tshul ni rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa ltar na/ puk+ka sis thugs rje chen po'i tshul gyis dang / sha wa ris gnad la bor ba'i tshul gyis dang / tsaṇ+ḍa lis sngon gyi thugs dam bskul ba'i tshul gyis dang / g.yung mos thugs dgongs yongs su mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis bskul ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ man ngag snye ma'i dgongs pa gnas skabs su gdul bya snod rung du gyur pa med na sangs rgyas rnams chos sku de bzhin nyid kho na'i ngang la bzhugs/ yod pa'i tshe sangs rgyas rnams gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang sgo bstun nas glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bzhengs par bzhed do/

/de yang don la sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro don mdzad pa la bskul dgos pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas rnams sems can rnams la dus drug tu ye shes kyi gzigs pa thogs med du 'jug pa'i phyir/ de yang glus ma bskul bas sangs rgyas rnams bzhengs su mi btub pa dang de la yi chad pa la sogs pa med kyang / 'jig rten na che bar grags pa'i spyod pa la 'jig rten pa rnams mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / de dang sgo bstun nas de ltar tshul bstan pa yin no/ /de dag gi sbyang gzhi mngal gyi gnas skabs su sas rten/ chus bsdud/ mes smin/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa ni/ sbyong byed 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bas sbyong ngo / /mngal gyi gnas skabs su mer mer po dang / nur nur po dang / tar tar po dang / gor gor mo dang / 'khrang gyur po rnams ni sbyong byed thig le la sa bon du gyur pas sbyong / mngal gyi gnas skabs su lus yongs su rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa ni sa bon las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs pas sbyong ngo / /lnga pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ hūm̐ dang aṃ ni rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la rdeb pa dang / /lha dang lha min sdigs par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar glus bskul bas sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du gyur pa'o/ /lnga pa sku mdog dang zhal phyag gi rnam pa gsal gdab pa la gsum ste/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i don sgom pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /zhes dang / rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che/ /g.yas pa la ni kun+da mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/

/spyi bo'i zhal ni gtsigs pa can/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhis che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba ltar/ /zhes dang / glang po rta bong glang rnga mong / /zhes sogs dang / sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don sgom pa la gsum ste/ sku mdog dang zhal phyag sogs gsal gdab pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu gsal gdab pa/ yum gsal gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ he ni snying rje chen po ste/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bde stong dbyer med thabs shes zung 'jug gi bdag nyid nges don gyi kyai rdo rje 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bzhengs pa ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum thabs kyi mtshon don gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ de yang sku mdog sngon po ni chos kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba med pa/ zhal brgyad kyis rnam par thar pa brgyad dag pa/ 'di la rdo rje snying 'grel gyi yig snar sngon drag po dbang phyug gi 'khor rnams la sa'i zhal dang / de bzhin du chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / drag po'i zhal rnams yod pas de dag gi nga rgyal gcog pa dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog 'joms par bshad do/ /rtsa zhal sngon po mdun du gzigs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du chags pa'i zhal gsum gsum/ de yang dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag cing / spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral bas g.yas zhal dang po dkar po/ thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas g.yon zhal dmar po/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas zhal lhag ma rnams bung ba ltar nag pa/ thabs shes gnyis su med pas steng zhal dud kha mgrin pa dang bcas pa mdun du gzigs pa/ khams gsum la gzigs shing dus gsum mkhyen pas zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i spyan dbus ma'i g.yon gyen du langs pa'o/

/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong du byas pa ni dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa la dpa' bas mche ba'i myu gu bzhi gtsigs pa'o/ /phyag gi gyes tshul la kha cig steng 'og tu rim bzhin brtsegs par 'dod pa ni rtsib ma'i logs la phyag skyes pa'i skyon yod do/ /kha cig phrag pa dang 'brel ba'i dpung pa gnyis/ de re re la phyag gnyis gnyis yod par 'dod pa ni dus 'khor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i brda chad yin pas 'dir 'brel cung zad kyang med do/ /des na rang lugs ni kha che rin chen rdo rjes/ phyag bzhi pa la dpung pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mgrin pa dang 'brel ba'i sog pa bcu drug de dang 'brel ba'i phyag yongs su rdzogs pa bcu drug ste rim pa bzhin du mdun rgyab tu gshibs nas yod par 'dod/ phyag bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug des bzung ba'i thod pa bcu drug gi mtshon don shes rab dang sbyar na stong nyid mi rtog pa'i ye shes te/ yul dang yul can zung du 'jug pa'o/ /thabs dang sbyar na dmigs med kyi snying rje bcu drug mtshon pas thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams kyis bzung ba'i thod pa'i nang gi srog chags brgyad ni/ rdo rje gur las/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khong skam mdze dang bir tsi ka /mchin pa mtsher pa'i nad rnams la/ /glang po la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nad brgyad dag pa mtshon/ sngon byung la sbyar na bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi nad zhi bar byas pa yin pas rjes 'jug rnams kyis de ltar du nyams su len dgos/ srog chags rnams kha nang du lta ba ni sems can rnams kyi nad rang nyid la len pa mtshon/ thod pa'i nang du chud pa ni de ltar bsdus pa de bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur ba mtshon/ g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad kyis bzung ba'i thod pa'i nang gi lha brgyad ni/

gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal las/ sku'i dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod phrin las yon tan brgyad pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang phyug gi don brgyad mtshon/ sngon byung la sbyar na bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan la 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos pa bsgrubs pa yin pas rjes 'jug rnams kyang de ltar du nyams su len dgos/ sems can rnams la dbang phyug gi don stsol bas phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'o/ /ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pas mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ a li ka li lnga bcu dbyings su dag pas shes rab kyi rang bzhin mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ phar phyin drug dag pas rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi mtshon pas zhabs bzhi pa/ de'i bzhugs tshul la kha cig mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa rgyab ma gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon bskyangs te bzhi ka gdan la reg par 'dod/ kha cig mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par 'dod/ kha cig mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs par 'dod/ 'dir rang lugs ni dpyi gnyis la zhabs gnyis gnyis mdun rgyab tu yod pa'i g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskums pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bzhed do/ /rtsa rgyud 'bro 'gyur las/ nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dpang 'gyur las/ nyi mar bzhugs shing gar stabs ldan/ /zhes gsungs pas thun mong ma yin pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa gar gyi nyams dgu gsal gdab pa la gsum ste/ sku'i nyams/ gsung gi nyams/

thugs kyi nyams so/ /dang po ni/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /zhes gsungs pa la sgeg pa ni sku la mtshan dpes spras shing lta bas chog mi shes pas gdul bya 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ dpa' ba ni bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du sku brjid cing che bas gdul bya zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ mi sdug pa ni zhal mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur du mas gti mug 'dul bar byed/ gnyis pa gsung gi nyams ni/ dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /zhes gsungs pas/ dgod pa ni rab tu dgyes pa chags pa'i bzhad sgras 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ drag shul ni rab tu gtum pa'i hūm̐ phaṭ la sogs pa'i drag shul gyi nga ros zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ 'jigs su rung ba ni bdag tu 'dzin pa 'jig pa'i phyir grag stong skye ba med pa'i sngags kyi nga ros gti mug can 'dul bar byed do/ /gsum pa thugs kyi nyams ni/ snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pas snying rje ni sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin par bzhed pas thugs brtse ba chen pos 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ rngam pa ni byams pa chen pos thugs khros shing zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ zhi ba ni rig stong dbyer med kyi ngang nas log lta dang ldan pa'i gti mug can 'dul bar byed do/ /gsum pa yum gsal gdab pa ni rdo rje ni stong pa/ bdag med ma ni chos dang gang zag gi bdag gis stong pas na bdag med ma ste de'i phyag mtshan gsal 'debs pa ni mngon rtogs kyi dkyus bzhin no/ /mtshon don ni gong gi lha mo brgyad kyi bshad pa dang mtshungs so/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ lha yi sku mdog sbyang gzhi dang / /sbyong byed 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprad pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin la/

de yang sbyong byed zhal brgyad kyis sbyang gzhi rnam shes tshogs brgyad sbyong / phyag bcu drug gis 'pho ba bcu drug gam/ skye mched bcu gnyis skye rga na 'chi dang bcas pa bcu drug sbyong / spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis ni dbang po nyer gnyis gsal stong dang bcas pa sbyong / zhabs bzhis ni skye gnas bzhi sbyong / zhal gyi mche ba zla ba phyed pas bdag tu 'dzin pa sbyong / mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal ni nyer len gyi phung po lnga la brten nas sdug bsngal gyi phreng ba 'khor mar 'byung ba sbyong / mdor na sbyang gzhi 'khor ba sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa ste dbyer med du nyams su len pa dang / rnam 'gyur la sogs pa dug gsum sbyong tshul yang gong du bshad pa ltar skabs 'dir yang sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sems dpa' gsum brtsegs sgom tshul ni/ rdo rje gur las/ thams cad kyi ni sngags 'di yis/ /snying khar ye shes gnas su 'god/ /ces dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sems kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du yod pa las/ dang po rgyas pa ni/ rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs gar sa bon gyis mtshan pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ 'bring po ni/ sa bon las 'byung ba'i phyag mtshan ye shes sems dpa'/ de la mtshan pa'i sa bon ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste 'di gnyis rje btsun chen po'i yum gyi sgrub thabs su gsungs so/ /bsdus pa ni/ rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i steng gi thig le ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste de ltar gsum las 'dir phyi ma nyid yin no/ /de'i sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum/ sbyong byed sku gsum gyi ngo bo sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi rnam par bsgyur nas sbyong ngo /

/gsum pa snod bcud sbyong ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ spro ba dang ni sdu ba las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rtse mos/ de yang lha dgu'i thugs kha nas/ /rang rang sa bon las 'od 'phros/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso 'khor rnams kyi rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam par rlung 'gyus nas/ phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig sna bug g.yas nas 'phros pa snod bcud la phog pas snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud lha dgur gyur nas rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu 'od zer rnams sna bug g.yon nas zhugs rang rang gi sa bon la thim par bsam/ sbyong byed 'dis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyong ba yin no/ /bzhi pa mig sogs byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes pa nas/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / rdo rje gur las/ mig la sogs par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas su 'god/ /ces dang / yang de nyid las/ gti mug rdo rje mig la 'god/ /ces pa nas/ gnas gsum du ni gnas par sgom/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i don la lnga ste/ gang la dgod pa'i gzhi/ gang dgod pa'i grangs/ ji ltar dgod pa'i tshul/ de ltar dgod pa'i dgos pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon shān+ti pas yab yum tsam la dgod par bzhed/ grub chen ḍom+bhi pa dang / dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pa dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' dbyer med kyi dkyil 'khor la dgod par bzhed/ grub chen mtsho skyes kyis yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la dgod par bshad kyang / 'dir dam tshig pa lha dgu la 'god/ de yang gtso bo'i rtsa zhal gyi spyan g.yas g.yon la sogs pa dbang po drug gi sgo dang gnas gsum du 'god par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ shān+ti pas lha nyi shu rtsa bzhi bsgom par bzhed/

dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pas nyer gcig sgom par bzhed pa la sogs pa yod kyang 'dir skye mched drug gi lha mo dang / rdo rje gsum ste dgu sgom par bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ kha cig rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa dang / kha cig ā li bco lngas bskyed pa sogs yod kyang 'dir gshin rje gdong drug las/ mig sogs byin gyis brlab pa la/ /gti mug rdo rje ma las bsrung / /dbang sbubs stong par byas nas ni/ /snying po'i ming gi yi ge las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang sbubs rnams stong par sbyangs nas rang rang gi ming yig thig les brgyan pa las bskyed par bzhed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar go cha bkod pa yi/ /dgos pa rnam pa gsum yin te/ /tha mal rnam rtog blo bzlog dang / /mngon shes lnga ni 'char ba dang / /bar chad bgegs las bsrung phyir ro/ /zhes pa rnam pa gsum gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ gti mug rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sbyong / /zhes pa dang / dgos pa gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las/ gti mug rdo rje'i sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje'i mig ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ dgos pa gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di ni go cha sems dpa' che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa sbyong byed de rnams kyis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i skye mched drug dang / gnas gsum du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong ngo / /lnga pa ye shes pa bzhugs pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dam tshig 'khor lo 'bar chen der/ /ye shes 'khor lo myur gzhug bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ de'i don la lnga ste ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa/ de la mchod bstod bya ba/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ de'i dgos pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po la gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa/ gang spyan 'dren pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin/

sngags dang / phyag rgya gsum gyis te gong du tshogs zhing gi skabs su rgyas par bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren te de'i ngos 'dzin yang tshogs zhing gi skabs su bshad zin to/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin pa'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang / rang rgyud la 'byung 'gyur gyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa gnyis las 'dir dang po ltar bzhed de/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ 'od zer 'phros nas mngon grub pas/ bskul nas phyag 'tshal rang lus gzhug /zhes dang / mngon grub pa ni spyan drangs nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la yang / nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nam mkha' gang ba'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang / rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ltar bzhed de phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de la mchod bstod bya ba la gnyis te mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bstod pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod de gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyis bstod de 'og nas rgyas par 'chad do/ /gsum pa dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ lcags kyu nyid kyis dgug bya zhing / /zhags pa nyid kyis gzhug par bya/ /lcags sgrog dag gis zhabs dag bcings/ /dril bu dkrol bas dbang du bya/ /zhes pa dang / sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las/ gau rī la sogs lha mo bzhis/ /dgug gzhug bcings dang dgos pa bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar de la gsum ste/ ting nge 'dzin/ sngags dang / phyag rgya'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i sna las lha mo gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pa 'phros pas lha rnams kyi thugs kar reg pa'i skad cig gis ye shes pa rnams srung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs par bsam mo/

/lha mo tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pa spros pas lha rnams kyi mgrin par reg pa'i ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa'i smin mtshams su thim par bsam/ lha mo bait+ta lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pa spros pas lha rnams kyi zhabs la reg pa'i ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ lha mo ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu thogs pa spros pa'i dril bu khrol ba'i sgras dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis/ byang chub ma thob bar du mi 'bral bar gnas par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa sngags ni/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥl sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ yo ga de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi nas bshad pa gnyis las 'dir dang po nyid phyag len la mdzad do/ /bzhi pa dgos pa ni/ dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /lcags ni gser du byed pa ltar/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcug pa yis/ /mi'i lus la sangs rgyas byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni/ sbyong byed de rnams kyis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa sbyong ba yin no/ /'di yan chad rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag yin la/ de rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang bde chen gyi ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ de bzhin du yan lag 'di'ang mngon rtogs kyi rtsa ba bde chen gyi ye shes kyi rdo rje chags pa lam du byed pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la gsum ste/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i don nyams su blang ba/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rang gi thugs kar sa bon bsam mo/ /sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis byung nas zhes pa nas/

spyi bor rang gi rigs kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ dbang ni rig ma brgyad rnams kyi/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gang la blang ba'i yul/ gang gis blang ba'i rten/ ji ltar blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa dang / de la mchod bstod bya ba/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa/ gang gi rnam par spyan 'dren pa/ gang du spyan 'dren pa'o/ /dang po dang gnyis pa ni gong du bshad zin pas rtogs sla'o/ /gsum pa la kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / gdan gsum dngos su tshang ba'i lha'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma yin la/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems pa brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gtso bo'i smin mtshams kyi thad kyi nam mkhar bai ḍūr+ya'i lha snam gru bzhi pa rim pa gnyis kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar rang la kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang tu don yod grub pa rnams byang chub mchog la sogs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /de'i shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma ki nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma ste 'khor lo la sogs pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol lha snam dang po'i shar du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang sa'i snying po/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang phyag na rdo rje/ nub tu spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs/ byang du sgrib pa rnam sel dang kun tu bzang po ste/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /lha snam de nyid kyi shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma/

lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma/ shar gyi g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma/ g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma rnams me long la sogs pa'i rang rtags kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lha snam phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og rnams su khro bo bcu rang 'od kyi rig ma dang bcas pa rnams gong du srung 'khor gyi bshad pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba la gnyis te/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bstod pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs te gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs te zhe sdang dang gti mug sogs ni sbyang gzhi/ rdo rje ni gnas gyur pa ste sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog ni sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa de rnams sbyong byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis kyis sbyangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras sku lnga ye shes lnga thob pa las mi 'da' ba'i don no/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub ces pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad khyed la brten nas 'byung ngo zhes pa'i don no/ /rdo rje can kun zhes pa ni rigs lnga dang drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang bcas pa'o/ /bdag dgyes mdzod ces pa ni bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob ces pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes pa dang / a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa gang gis dbang blang ba'i rten ni/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med pa'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar blang ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ dbang blang ba'i tshul dngos/

rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa/ de la rtsod pa spong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ skabs 'dir dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig tu len te/ de yang dbang lha la gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga khro chags kyi rnam pa he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas/ phyag bcu drug gis zla ba ltar dkar ba'i ye shes kyi bum pa zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa dang bcas pa cung zad yo bar bzung bas/ sangs rgyas rnams zhes sogs gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ de'i tshe yum bzhis ko la i ri la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyis phun sum tshogs pa sogs shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char 'bebs/ lha mo drug gis 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo bcus tsham rngam dang bcas pa'i hūm̐ phaṭ la sogs pa'i sngags kyi nga ros byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar chad thabs cad ring du bskrad pa'o/ /dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs kyi don bskyed rim sgom pa mthar phyin pa na rgyan drug lhar gsal bas so/ /dbang gi chu rgyun gyis mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag lam bdag byin rlabs sgom pa la dbang / lam de nyams su len pa'i gtso bo gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa yin pas de'i mtshon don rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i yi ge sgom pas so/ /dbang gi chu rgyun gyis snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor yid kyi dri ma dag lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgom pa la dbang / lam de nyams su blangs pa la brten nas dbang po drug yul drug la lhug par 'jog pa la dbang bas de'i mtshon don skye mched drug dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pas so/

/dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang / dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs sgom pa la dbang / des dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs la rtsa rgyud las/ phyag rgya rtags dang mtshan ma dang / /'dis ni rigs ni mtshon par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyas 'debs 'dis rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad mtshon nus shing / 'di 'chol na dngos grub nyams pa la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs yod pas 'di ma 'chol ba gal che ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ rigs 'chol sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub med cing sgrub po'ang med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di la lnga ste/ ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya/ lus la sems kyi rgya/ sems la lus kyi rgya/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya/ 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya'o/ /de yang sems rnam par dag pa la yid kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pa ni ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya/ gau rī gzugs phung rnam par dag pa dang / puk+ka si sa rnam par dag pa lus kyi ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad la sems rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pa lus la sems kyi rgya/ tsau rī ni tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa dang / sha wa ri chu rnam par dag pa yid rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa la lus rnam par dag pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyas 'debs pa ni sems la lus kyi rgya/ bait+ta lī 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang / gdol pa mo me rnam par dag pa rgyu 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag med la/ 'bras bu ser sna rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rgyas 'debs pa ni rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya/ ghasma ri 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang /

g.yung mo rlung rnam par dag pa 'bras bu phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo don yod grub pa la/ rgyu 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag med kyis rgyas 'debs pa ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya'o/ /rigs bdag rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa rang rang gi rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis rgyas 'debs dgos te/ rdo rje gur las/ spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /de yang rdo rje mdog nag po/ zhes dang / spyi bor chos kyi 'khor los mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /de ltar na ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams dag pa'i lhar sgom pa ni kun btags la gzhan dbang gi rgya/ lha de rnams kyi spyi bor rang rang gi rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa ni gzhan dbang la gzhan dbang gi rgya/ rigs bdag de rnams kyi spyi bor rang rang gi rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis rgyas 'debs pa ni gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgya'o/ /rigs bdag de rnams dus kyi 'khor lo sprul sku'i rnam pa can du bshad kyang / 'dir yum dang zhal sbyor gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam pa can du bzhed do/ /gsum pa rtsod pa spong pa la kha cig phyogs kyi lha mo rnams phung po rnam par dag par bshad pa'i khungs med cing / rin chen 'byung ldan dang bait+ta lī gnyis dri rnam par dag pa dang / 'od dpag med dang ghasma rī gnyis ro rnam par dag pa yin pas lha mo de gnyis kyi rgyas gdab pa ni ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgyar song ngo zhes zer ba ni/ dang po ma grub ste rgyud 'bum pa'i dgongs pa slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis bstod pa nyi shu par phung po khams ni rnam dag pa/ /zhes gsungs pas phyogs kyi lha mo rnams phung po rnam par dag pa dang / mtshams kyi lha mo rnams 'byung ba rnam par dag par bshad pas so/ /phyi ma yang 'gal ba med de lha mo de gnyis kyi rgyas gdab kyang gsum sbrags su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/

/'o na lus sems gnyis la rgya nyis sbrags dang / rgyu 'bras gnyis la rgya gsum sbrags su yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rgyu 'bras gnyis po rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gtso bo yin pas so/ /kha cig dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig la thob pa'i tshad ldan gyi khungs med do snyam na mi 'thad de/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis rim pa ji lta bar rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / rnam par smin pa dang / rnam par nyed pa dang / mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma bzhi rnams thob pa dang / dga' ba dang / mchog dga' dang / dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi mtshon pa dang / dgod pa dang / lta ba dang / 'khyud pa dang / gnyis gnyis te dri ma bzhi rnams dag pa ni slob dpon dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab dang / mchog tu bde ba chen po mthar thug pa ste dbang bzhi pa rnams blangs so/ /zhes pa'i don mas rim bzhin du bshad na dbang rang gi ngo bo gang yin na slob dpon sogs bzhi/ dri ma gang dag na dgod pa sogs bzhi/ des nyams myong gang skye na dga' ba sogs bzhi/ dus nam gyi tshe thob na rnam pa sna tshogs pa sogs skad cig ma bzhi'i dus su thob pas skyon med du 'grub bo/ /'o na man ngag lugs 'di gtso cher rgya gzhung la mi brten pas ji ltar 'chad snyam na/ rtsa rgyud las/ dgod pa dag pa slob dpon nyid/ /lta ba gsang ba de bzhin no/ /lag bcangs la ni shes rab nyid/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud la yang de nyid/ /ces dang / dbang ni bzhi yi grangs kyis ni/ /dga' ba la sogs rim shes bya/ /sna tshogs dang po'i dga' ba nyid/ /rnam smin la ni mchog dga' nyid/ /rnam nyed dga' bral dga' ba nyid/ /mtshan bral lhan cig skyes dga' nyid/ /ces pas bstan to/ /de ltar dbang bzhis dri ma sbyong nus pas na rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi dbang gi zab don thams cad 'dir 'dus pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyang gzhi rnam par shes pa'i phung po chu'i khams kha dog sngon po mi bskyod pa'i rigs/

nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa'i bar dang / rang gi mnga' thang gzhis 'byor pa ci tsam yod pa la dbang bskur ba sngar byas pa/ ma 'ongs pa na byed par 'gyur ba/ da ltar byed bzhin pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dbang bskur ba'i yan lag tu bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas sbyangs 'bras khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /sngags don ni phal cher sngar dang 'dra/ a bhi ni mngon par/ ṣe ka ta ni dbang bskur ba'o/ /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbang gi gtso bo chu'i dbang yin pa dang / mi bskyod pa yang chu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dbang bskur cing thob pa na gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod pa de bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa yang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag la gsum ste/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshul/ gsungs pa'i don bshad pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de sngags don la nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha dang dang po'i sha /kyai rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ yang ni bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i snod ni thod pa dum bu gsum pa shis te/ sdom 'byung las/ dum gsum bsgrub la dngos grub ster/ /zhes pas bstan/ de'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ni/ dpal sam+bu ṭi las/ dang po skye dgu'i bdag po brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis pa sgrol ma ste/ /gsum pa la ni rab mchog brjod/ /bzhi pa la ni mang po skyes/ /lnga pa la ni stobs zhes bya/ /zhes pas bstan no/ /ye shes lnga'i yig 'bru lnga bskyed pa ni/

de nyid las/ rigs lnga rnams kyi sngags 'di dag /ye shes lnga yi rab dbye ba/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhu btul byas te kha dog ltar bskyed pa ni/ de nyid las/ 'bud pa sbar ba bskyed pa ni/ /khyad par du yang skol ba nyid/ /shel gyi gzugs su bskyed bya ste/ /de phyir thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags ni/ de nyid las/ has ni kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /hos ni dri ni 'jig par byed/ /hris ni brtson 'grus 'jig par byed/ /ces pas bstan to/ /bdud rtsi myang ba dngos ni de nyid las/ de la bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ /rdo rje lce yis myang bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan no/ /gnyis pa gsungs pa'i don bshad pa la gnyis te/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa/ brlabs pa de myang ba'i tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ bdud rtsi dngos su bsham pa'am med kyang rung / bsam pa tsam gyi'ang rung ste de a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i rlung du snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed don grub kyi ngo bo rnam pa yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i mer snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo rnam pa raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong byed a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par bsam/ de'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga bskyed pa ni mngon byang lngas bsdus pa las/ thod pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes las mngon par byang chub pa/ de'i steng du gau ku la sogs pa'i yig 'bru lnga las ba glang la sogs pa'i sha lnga sgom pa ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i bcud kyi sems can mtshon/
